items.name: 30° Hip Roof
items.extract: A 30° hip roof is a constructed object where the roof slopes at a 30° angle, forming a pyramid-like shape.

items.name: 30° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: 30° inverted roof support wall is an inverted version of the 30° roof support wall and requires a foundation for the inverted roof support wall to be built on top.

items.name: 30° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: 30° inverted triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: 30° Roof
items.extract: A 30° roof is a constructed object that does not require a foundation. The 30° roof can be supported with 30° roof support walls and measures four metres long and one metre high. Two built 30° roof support walls (either tier 1 or tier 2) can be spaced evenly apart to support the 30° roof when building a simple house.

items.name: 30° Roof Support Wall
items.extract: 30° roof support wall is a constructed object where players can place roofs on top. This wall requires a foundation for the roof support wall to be placed.

items.name: 30° Stairs
items.extract: 30° stairs is a constructed item that does not require a roof and does not require a stable foundation. Since the stairs are at a 30° angle, players who want to connect two floors in their house must place the bottom of the stairs two floor tiles away from the top floor.

items.name: 30° Thick Beam
items.extract: 30° thick beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other built structures.

items.name: 30° Thin Beam
items.extract: 30° thin beams are constructed objects that can improve the stability of 30° stairs, roof support walls, and roofs.

items.name: 30° Triangle Roof
items.extract: A 30° triangle roof is a constructed object that can be placed alongside 30° roof support walls to make a fully covered roof.

items.name: 30° Valley Roof
items.extract: 30° valley roof is a constructed object where the roof slopes down at a 30° angle, forming an inverse pyramid-like shape when placed.

items.name: 45° Hip Roof
items.extract: A 45° hip roof is a constructed object where the roof slopes at a 45° angle, forming a pyramid-like shape. This may be useful for creating roofs on the top corners of a house.

items.name: 45° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: A 45° inverted roof support wall is a constructed object that is a 45° roof support wall, but is flipped 180° on its horizontal axis. A 45° inverted roof support wall may be useful to support upper floors and structures.

items.name: 45° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: 45° inverted triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: 45° Roof
items.extract: A 45° roof is a constructed object that does not require a foundation. However, the 45° roof support wall requires at least one point of contact to be connected. Two built 45° roof support walls (either tier 1 or tier 2) can be spaced evenly apart to support the 45° roof when building a simple house.

items.name: 45° Roof Support Wall
items.extract: 45° roof support wall is a constructed object that is not required to have a roof upon creation and does not require a foundation. However, the 45° roof support wall has three points of contact (one on each corner) and requires at least one point of contact to be connected. Two built 45° roof support walls can be evenly spaced apart to support a 45° roof when making a simple house.

items.name: 45° Stairs
items.extract: 45° stairs is a constructed item that is not required to have a roof and does not require a stable foundation. Since the stairs are at a 45° angle, players who wish to connect two floors in their house will need to place the bottom of the stairs at the furthest edge of the bottom floor and connect it to the base of the top floor; this will use two stairs. The square tile and the wall are both 4 metres long (in either direction), such that the measurement for each stair is approximately 2.8 metres long.

items.name: 45° Thick Beam
items.extract: 45° thick beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other constructed objects. There is currently no castle variant for the 45° thick beam.

items.name: 45° Thin Beam
items.extract: 45° thin beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other constructed objects.

items.name: 45° Triangle Roof
items.extract: 45° triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: 45° Valley Roof
items.extract: A 45° valley roof is a constructed object where the roof is an inverted version of the 45° hip roof.

items.name: 60° Hip Roof
items.extract: 60° hip roof is a cottage-constructed object that acts as a corner roof for smaller house structures.

items.name: 60° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: 60° inverted roof support wall is a tier 2 constructed object and is also a 60° roof support wall but flipped 180° along the horizontal axis. This may be useful for supporting upper floors and other higher structures.

items.name: 60° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: 60° inverted triangle roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage set that is an inverted version of the 60° triangle roof. Inverted triangle roofs may be useful for building Saw-tooth roofs.

items.name: 60° Roof
items.extract: 60° roof is a cottage-constructed object that is five metres high and four metres long. The 60° roof is five metres high and four metres long, and can be supported by two 60° roof support walls for stability.

items.name: 60° Roof Support Wall
items.extract: 60° roof support walls are tier 2 constructed objects where they can support 60° roofs when two support walls are placed.

items.name: 60° Thick Beam
items.extract: 60° thick beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other built structures.

items.name: 60° Thin Beam
items.extract: 60° thin beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other constructed objects.

items.name: 60° Triangle Roof
items.extract: 60° triangle roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage set that is used to provide shelter with two 60° roof support walls on each side. Triangle roofs may be useful for building Saw-tooth roofs.

items.name: 60° Valley Roof
items.extract: 60° valley roof is a cottage-constructed object that is 5 metres high and 4 metres wide. It may be beneficial to place 60° roof support walls as shown in the picture below to fill in any gaps.

items.name: A Brutal Bladehead
items.description: A powerful looking blade, broken beyond repair. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A brutal bladehead is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the thane's authority. They can be collected by killing a Garou thane.

items.name: A Corroded Serrated Blade
items.description: The rusted remains of a symbol of authority. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A corroded serrated blade is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the chieftain's blade. This vestige is found by the chest near the Heartstrings' starting tree.

items.name: A Cracked Bronze Vanity Mirror
items.description: Shows the worst possible side of yourself. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: A cracked bronze vanity mirror is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the ring of recoil when studied.

items.name: A Cruel Goblin Blade
items.description: A rusted blade with a wicked edge. Barely usable now, but perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A cruel goblin blade is a vestige found on Goblins within Bramblemead Valley that unlocks the ability to create goblin "Swingslash".

items.name: A Mysterious Crescent Carving
items.description: What's left of a staff that feels soaked in sorrow. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A mysterious crescent carving is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the grieving moon staff. This is a rare drop from killing Garou druids; it may be recommended to go to Lougrim's Shrine at Stormtouched Highlands due to three druids spawning there.

items.name: A Simple Broken Bow
items.description: The remains of a longbow damaged in a dragon attack. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A simple broken bow is a vestige that unlocks creation of the adventurer's longbow.

items.name: A String of Sinew
items.description: Sinew, bound tightly enough to be dangerous. Useless now, but perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A string of sinew is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the hunter stagbow. They are received as a rare drop by Garou hunters.

items.name: A Threadbare Grain Sack
items.description: An odd bundle of scratchy sackcloth. It's unsettling to hold. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: A threadbare grain sack is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the bag of Noggin'.

items.name: Abraxus Ring
items.description: A ring that once belonged to a powerful necromancer.
items.extract: The Abraxus ring is a ring that is a quest reward for completing the What Remains is Written secondary quest. Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring has a chance to reduce the rune cost of utility spells when cast.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: Has a chance to reduce the rune cost of utility spells when cast

items.name: Abysmal Whip
items.description: It's... not quite finished.
items.extract:
The abysmal whip is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be created at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe, Abyssal Remains, can be acquired by killing an Abyssal Demon. It can be ascended at a mystic forge with ascension cores. Note, if you ascend the Abysmal Whip to power level 8, and upgrade it to the Abyssal Whip, it will be brought down to Power Level 7.
This weapon's special effect is that regular attacks also build up bleed, and after five rapid hits, it will proc 28 damage at power level 4 and 40 damage at power level 7, despite only listing 25 for each. As this weapon deals slash damage, compared to swords, its attacks are slightly slower but slightly harder; however, its forward lunge distance is much shorter, and since enemies are knocked back significantly by most attacks, they will often be knocked out of this weapon's combos. It also does not have increased block without a shield compared to other similar weapons.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: ATTACKS build up BLEED on enemies (25)

items.name: Abyssal Ashes
items.description: The sinister remnants of an abyssal creature.
items.extract: Abyssal ashes are dropped from killing the abyssal demon. They currently have no use.

items.name: Abyssal Demon Trophy
items.extract: The Abyssal Demon Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Abyssal Remains
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: Abyssal Remains is a vestige dropped by an Abyssal Demon, required to create the Abysmal Whip.

items.name: Abyssal Spine
items.description: The spine from a deceased abyssal demon.
items.extract: Abyssal spines are dropped from killing the abyssal demon and are a key material for players wishing to craft the abysmal whip.

items.name: Abyssal Whip
items.description: A brutal weapon crafted from the spine of a terrifying Abyssal Demon.
items.extract: The abyssal whip is a power level 7 one-handed masterwork melee weapon that can be created at a blacksmith's bench. To create this, it requires the Abysmal Whip to be wielded when interacting with a dragonkin statue near the Fight Cave. It is located directly North, in the lava.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * '''Abyssal Snare''' (50) Launches DEMONIC ENERGY that homes in on a target, dealing DAMAGE and KNOCKING them DOWN * '''Barbed Attacks'''' build up Bleed on Enemies. (25) * '''Reckless''' Can only BLOCK using UNARMED BLOCK

items.name: Acrid Adhesive
items.description: A resilient adhesive that can withstand high temperatures.
items.extract: Acrid adhesive is a basic item processed from kalphite ichor at the kiln.

items.name: Adamant Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from adamant.
items.extract: Adamant arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft adamant barbed arrow, poisoned adamant arrow, and adamant fire arrow.

items.name: Adamant Bar
items.description: A sturdy metal used for crafting weapons and armour.
items.extract: Adamant bars are a processed material created with three adamantite ore and three coal inside a blast furnace.

items.name: Adamant Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from adamant.
items.extract: Adamant barbed arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Adamant Bolt
items.description: A crossbow bolt with an adamant tip.
items.extract: Adamant bolts are a power level 7 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Adamant Crossbow
items.description: A solid crossbow reinforced with adamant.
items.extract: A adamant crossbow is a power level 7 crossbow crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Adamant Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of adamant crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a adamant crossbow.
items.extract: Adamant crossbow limbs are used for creating a adamant crossbow.

items.name: Adamant Dagger
items.description: Short, sharp and to the point.
items.extract: The adamant dagger is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Fire Arrow
items.description: Burning arrows with tips forged from adamant, coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Adamant fire arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Adamant Greataxe
items.description: A big two-handed axe made of adamant.
items.extract: The adamant greataxe is a power level 7 two-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Greatsword
items.description: A strong and massive blade made of adamant.
items.extract: The adamant greatsword is a power level 7 two-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Helmet
items.description: A durable adamant helmet forged for the strongest of warriors.
items.extract: Adamant helmet is a power level 7 armour piece.

items.name: Adamant Logging Axe
items.description: A strong woodcutting axe, good for trees that hit back.
items.extract: An adamant logging axe is a power level 7 logging axe that can cut yew trees. Making one requires 8 adamant bars, 6 maple logs, and 4 desert thread, and requires a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Adamant Mace
items.description: An adamant mace designed to crush your enemies.
items.extract: The adamant mace is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Med Helm
items.description: A sturdy adamant helm built for serious combat.
items.extract: The Adamant Med Helm is a power level 7 helmet. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Adamant Bar, 4 Scorch Leather, 1 Desert Cloth, 1 Refined Obsidian, 1 Gypsum Wax, and 1 Garou Weave. The recipe for this item is obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition and having an adamantbar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Adamant Pickaxe
items.description: A sturdy pickaxe made of adamant.
items.extract: Adamant pickaxe is a power level 7 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers along with runite ore and luminite ore, dealing 84 damage to minable ores, and 168 with a critical swing.

items.name: Adamant Platebody
items.description: A sturdy set of adamant chest armour, forged for the strongest of warriors.
items.extract: Adamant platebody is a power level 7 armour piece.

items.name: Adamant Platelegs
items.description: A sturdy set of adamant leg armour, forged for the strongest of warriors.
items.extract: Adamant platelegs are a power level 7 armour piece.

items.name: Adamant Scimitar
items.description: A fast, curved, and very efficient sword.
items.extract: The adamant scimitar is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Shield
items.description: Solid protection, slightly heavy.
items.extract: Adamant shield is a power level 7 shield. Players will need to have scorch leather to unlock the adamant shield in the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Adamant Spade
items.description: A durable spade made from Adamantite.
items.extract: An adamant spade is a power level 7 spade unlocked the first time the player picks up an adamant bar. It is crafted at the blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress instantly to the next plot clearing stage.

items.name: Adamant Sword
items.description: A reliable blade made of adamant.
items.extract: The adamant sword is a power level 7 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Adamant Warhammer
items.description: A heavy warhammer forged from adamant.
items.extract: The adamant warhammer is a power level 7 two-handed melee weapon

items.name: Adamant Watering Can
items.extract:
NOTE: This watering can distributes 40 units of water per use.  Since a plot only requires 50 units of water to be fully watered, you essentially waste 30 units of water per plot if watering manually.  The best use case for this can is with the Humidify spell, since it holds more total water.
The adamant watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots and has a capacity of 350 units.
The can may be filled with either dirty water or clean water, but not both at the same time. When the can is filled, it may not be filled with the opposite type until it is emptied. Players can empty the can at any time and fill it with a different water type. To fill the can, the can must be filled at a water source. Players cannot use the physical items dirty water or clean water to fill the can.
Along with bodies of water, players may fill the can at the rain catcher, well, water barrel, or large water barrel.
Fully hydrating a farming plot requires 50 units of water.

items.name: Adamantite Ore
items.description: Mined from adamantite deposits. It can be smelted into bars at a Blast Furnace.
items.extract: Adamantite ore is a basic Mining material mined from adamantite ore nodes, which can be found all over the Umbral Sands region. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of coal in a blast furnace to produce adamant bars.

items.name: Adhesive
items.description: Glue friendly or else I'll take away the glue and then nobody will have any glue to glue with!
items.extract:
Adhesive is a product as well as a crafting item.  It is created by adding swamp tar to the kiln.  Adhesive is made in a one-to-one ratio, with one swamp tar creating one adhesive.
Adhesive has multiple uses as a crafting material in the production of fuel pellets, hard leather, tanner's kits, and weapon barbs.

items.name: Advanced Spinning Wheel
items.extract: The advanced spinning wheel is a crafting station that can be used to craft Vis Fibres.

items.name: Advanced Tannery
items.extract: The advanced tannery is a more advanced tannery that is used to craft more advanced materials. Players must receive yew logs in their inventory for the first time to unlock the advanced tannery.

items.name: Adventurer's Leggings
items.description: Basic and comfortable attire fit for a new adventurer.
items.extract: Adventurer's leggings are a basic item that can be crafted using 6 coarse animal fur at the crafting table.

items.name: Adventurer's Longbow
items.description: The bane of deer everywhere.
items.extract: The adventurer's longbow is a power level 2 longbow which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige: a simple broken bow, found in a chest inside of Finn's Cave.

items.name: Adventurer's Tunic
items.description: Basic and comfortable attire fit for a new adventurer.
items.extract: Adventurer's tunic is a basic item that can be crafted using 9 coarse animal fur at the crafting table.

items.name: Advert-Inna-Bottle
items.description: An advert that details how to make an 'Ava's Accumulator'.
items.extract: An Advert-Inna-Bottle is both an NPC and an item, once the player interacts with the NPC first. Both the NPC and the item are related to the quest, Animal Magnetism, where reading it reveals that it is a message from Ava with the ingredients on how to craft Ava's accumulator.

items.name: Aetheric Fundamentals, a Primordial Primer
items.description: A study on elemental forces and their interactions with runic energies.
items.extract: Aetheric Fundamentals a Primordial Primer is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. This book is found at the top level of Silverthorn Keep behind the green dragon and to the right of the curse seal from Withering Heights.

items.name: Agility Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Agility is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Agility cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn with a level 99 Agility. It can be crafted at the crafting table. This cape, while worn, gives the player a small chance to not consume stamina for jumping, dashing, or evading.
Trimmed versions can be made the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Agility Flag
items.extract: Agility flags are a reward for completing the Thunder Assault Agility course at silver or gold tier and can be built by the player. To build it, players must have at least 1 oak log, 1 padded cloth, and 1 warped feather.

items.name: Agility Orb
items.extract:
Agility orbs are a decorative buildable that is unlocked by reaching either silver or gold record times on the Grave Run Agility course. Once unlocked, the player can build their own agility orbs in their bases.
To build it, players will need 1 wild anima, 1 warped feathers, and 1 air rune.

items.name: Air Rune
items.description:
Equippable as ammo when using a magic weapon.

A symbol of blustering winds, essential for air-based magic and other spells. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract: Air runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 1 Runecrafting or higher, and can deal between 13-22 base damage, along with whatever staves the player equips. Air runes can also be used in spells, such as Windstep, Axtral Projection, Enchant Weapon: Air, Superheat, and Tempest Shield.

items.name: Air Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Air rune is a constructed decoration that is unlocked once the player has received air rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Amulet of Accuracy
items.extract: The amulet of accuracy is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet grants players a 15% increase in critical damage and critical weakpoint damage.

items.name: Amulet of Defence
items.description: A mystical amulet that strengthens your defences.
items.extract: The amulet of defence is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet increases players' armour value of all three damage types by 5 for each piece (head, torso, and legs).

items.name: Amulet of Glory
items.extract:
The amulet of glory is an amulet that boosts melee, magic, and ranged critical damage while also increasing defence. While worn, the amulet provides an additional +5 defence to all combat styles and a 25% increase to critical damage for magic, melee, and ranged attacks.
To unlock the recipe, players must find and study the commemorative coin vestige.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: Increased MELEE, MAGIC, and RANGED CRIT DAMAGE. Increased DEFENCE.

items.name: Amulet of Magic
items.extract: The amulet of Magic is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet grants players increased magic damage by a factor of 12.5%. The recipe is unlocked through Death's Exchange for 350 soul fragments. There, it's called "Softly Vibrating Orb".

items.name: Amulet of Strength
items.extract: The amulet of strength is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet increases the player's melee damage with both one-handed and two-handed weapons by 12.5% each.

items.name: Amylase Crystal
items.description: A crystallised mass of amylase enzymes, can be used as a reagent potions.
items.extract: Amylase crystal can be obtained by opening Agility course reward packs. It is used in making stamina potions.

items.name: An Educational Blade
items.description: A crude wooden blade and handle, what's left of a child's toy turned to weaponry. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: An educational blade is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the wooden training sword. This is found on the eastern side of the Temple of Saradomin roof.

items.name: An Ember-Edged Remnant of Cloth
items.icon: An Ember Edged Remnant of Cloth.png
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it
items.extract: An ember edged remnant of cloth was a vestige that unlocks the fire cape.

items.name: Ancestral Hat
items.description: Woven with ancient knowledge and arcane tradition. The hat is old, the magic within is older.
items.extract: Ancestral hat is a power level 8 magic armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Ancestral Leggings
items.description: Enchanted garments that carry the legacy of generations of powerful spellcasters.
items.extract: Ancestral leggings is a power level 8 magic armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Ancestral Robes
items.description: Robes worn in the pursuit of magical mastery, embroidered with symbols whose meaning has long been forgotten.
items.extract: Ancestral robes is a power level 8 magic armour piece, crafted using materials found within the Scorned Wilderness raid zone.

items.name: Ancestral Staff
items.description: A staff carved from powerful magic wood, prized for its affinity with arcane energies.
items.extract: The Ancestral Staff is a Power level 8 magic weapon. it can be crafted at a Mystic Forge using 12 Magic Logs, 6 Harmonised Compound, 2 Vis Cloth, 3 Dragonstone, and 2 Draconic Vis Wax

items.name: Ancestral Wand
items.description: Forgotten magic lingers within this wand, waiting for a capable hand to awaken it.
items.extract: The Ancestral wand is a power level 8 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 magic logs, 5 harmonised compound, 2 vis cloth, 2 dragonstone, and 2 draconic vis wax.

items.name: Anchovy Bait
items.description: Cute little cannibal fish love some anchovy bait. Irresistible to Herring. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Anchovy bait is a power level 3 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching herring. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Angler's Hat
items.description: A rather dapper looking cap that upon catching a fish has a chance to not reduce the amount of fish in the node.
items.extract: Angler's hat is a power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. Wearing it provides a 10% chance to not deplete a fishing node when catching a fish. The recipe is learned by unlocking Experienced Angler at level 70 Fishing.

unlockedBy.description: Unlock the recipe for a fishing hat. While worn, you have a 10% chance per catch to not deplete a fish in the fishing spot.

items.name: Anima-Infused Bark
items.description: Tree bark infused with magical energy.
items.extract: Anima-infused bark is a basic crafting item that is required to create wild anima. Anima bark can be found on the ground around the anima trees and certain crystal trees located throughout the Fractured Plains biome. Players can interact with the item by picking it up, receiving 7 Woodcutting experience. Anima-infused bark can respawn after 72 minutes.

items.name: Animal Bone
items.description: A sturdy bone from a sizable creature.
items.extract: Animal bones are retrieved from killing animals such as cows, deer, and sheep. They can also be found on the ground in a cave in the Stormtouched Highlands. Players can also receive it by casting Bark To Bones on a tree. Upon receiving a bone for the first time, players can unlock the tannery and the stone range.

items.name: Animal Hide
items.description: Gathered from big creatures, this hide is essential for crafting leather equipment.
items.extract: Animal hide is a basic item gathered from animals like cows, deer, and wolves. It can be put into the tannery to create leather.

items.name: Animal Hide Scraps
items.description: Gathered from small creatures, too small to be processed into leather by itself.
items.extract: Animal hide scraps are gathered from rats, kebbits, and chinchompas to create leather.

items.name: Animated Feather
items.description: To a fish, this feather looks like a long-lost love. Makes Armoured Catfish enamoured. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Animated feathers are a power level 6 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching armoured catfish. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Anti-Dragon Shield
items.description: This provides partial protection from dragonbreath attacks.
items.extract:
The anti-dragon shield is a power level 3 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining the recipe from Vertentis Kara, the dragonkin vault in the Whispering Swamp. It is also one of the rewards for completing the Dragon Slayer quest, and is used as a material to craft the dragonblight shield, dragoncurse shield and the dragonfire shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect allows the user to block incoming dragon fire without being staggered. This includes the sweeping breath attack that all dragons perform, as well as the poison spit from green dragons, the spinning fire from Imaru, the lightning ball from blue dragons, and the fireball from red dragons and Fuzan. This does not include any ground-based effects like Velgar's poison breath/barrage and earth spikes, Imaru's wither projectiles and spikes, and Fuzan's lava floor. Notably, despite not being listed, this special effect is also present on the dragonblight shield and dragoncurse shield but not on the dragonfire shield.
All of that being said, Tempest Shield will block all incoming damage (excluding any ground-based attacks), including the projectiles and spikes that weren't blockable even with the special effect, and that is available even with two-handed weapons. Otherwise, all vestige and masterwork shields can be ascended to the highest power level and will have the same block value, with the exception of the fallen hoplite's aspis which has 3 more and the toktz-ket-xil which has 6 less. Therefore, the optimal shield choice will come down to their special effects, and this shield may often be chosen as it can block dragonfire but will not interfere with staggers caused by parries, unlike the other dragon shields.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: DRAGON BREATH RESISTANCE When actively BLOCKING, this shield is able to BLOCK incoming DRAGON FIRE.

items.name: Antifire Potion
items.description:
PERK: Antifire

NEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects
items.extract: Antifire potion applies the perk Antifire, which removes Burning stacks and grants 33% resistance from Burning buildup for 300 seconds (5 minutes). It is crafted with irit, blue dragon scale dust, and glass vessel.

items.name: Antipoison Potion
items.description: Removes poison and grants resistance to it. Made with irit and poison ichor.
items.extract: An antipoison potion applies the perk Antipoison II, which removes Poison effects and grants 66% resistance from future Poison effects, compared to 33% resistance from Antipoison. It is crafted with irit, poison ichor, and glass vessel.

items.name: Antler
items.description: A cartilaginous extension of a deer skull.
items.extract: Antlers are obtained by killing deer and are used in drinks, weapons, and armour.

items.name: Apprentice Hat
items.description: A comfortable hat made from linen, perfect for adventurers who are practicing magic.
items.extract: Apprentice hat is a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Apprentice Leggings
items.description: Provides basic protection for trainees in the magical arts.
items.extract: Apprentice leggings are a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Apprentice Robe
items.description: Provides basic protection for trainees in the magical arts.
items.extract: Apprentice robe is a power level 2 magic armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Arcane Infusion
items.description: Puts the whiz in wizard.
items.extract: Arcane infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Arcane Aligned, which reduces the stamina cost of magic attacks by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, antler, and harralander in a stone range or Cooking Range. It is learned by unlocking Teamonger at level 14 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Arcane Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: An arcane infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating an arcane infusion.

items.name: Arched Window Wall
items.extract: An arched window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Archery Target
items.extract: An archery target is a  constructed object that is unlocked at level 5 Ranged. Players can test their accuracy and can land critical hits; however, players will not gain any Ranged experience.

items.name: Armadyl Banner 01
items.extract: Armadyl banner 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl banner 01.

items.name: Armadyl Banner 02
items.extract: Armadyl banner 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl banner 02.

items.name: Armadyl Banner 03
items.extract: Armadyl banner 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl banner 03.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 01
items.extract: Armadyl flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 01.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 02
items.extract: Armadyl flag 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 02.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 03
items.extract: Armadyl flag 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 03.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 04
items.extract: Armadyl flag 04 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 04.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 05
items.extract: Armadyl flag 05 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 05 found within Dowdun Reach or bought from Evil Emporium.

items.name: Armadyl Flag 06
items.extract: Armadyl flag 06 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Armadyl flag 06.

items.name: Armchair
items.extract: An armchair is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the armchair.

items.name: Armour Bench
items.extract:
The armour bench is a crafting station that allows the creation of head armour, body armour, leg armour (all styles: melee, magic, ranged), cape slot equipment (capes + other). This replaces, in part, the functionality of the smithing anvil, crafting table, and the jeweler's bench.
The armour bench is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

items.name: Armour Mannequin
items.extract:
An armour mannequin is a buildable object at level 40 Artisan, which players can mount up to five pieces of armour. Players can quickly swap armours at mannequins and can even store some capes on them (Pioneer's cape the dragonbane cape and Fellhollow cape). If a certain piece of equipment is already on a mannequin, players can add another piece of the same type. For example, if the reinforced helmet is on the mannequin, players can also add a Dragonkin mage hood. This results in only the latter being shown.

In addition, players cannot store the following:

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the armour mannequin and cape rack, allowing you to display all of your armour sets and capes with pride!

items.name: Arrowhead of Ancient Origin
items.description: Still sharp. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The arrowhead of ancient origin is a vestige that unlocks creation of the amulet of accuracy.

items.name: Artisan Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Artisan is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Artisan cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Artisan. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Ascension Core
items.description: Used to upgrade Masterwork Weapons and Vestiges from a lower Power level to Power Level 4.
items.extract:
Ascension cores are items used and crafted in the mystic forge to ascend masterwork weapons from their base power level to the next tier. They are made by combining ascension shards or by collecting them as rewards for completing Nightmare Crucible instances in Umbral Sands. For most cores, players can gain core shards by killing mini-bosses (such as red dragons, green dragons, and blue dragons).
The only core that cannot be crafted thus far is the power level 7 ascension core, which can only be acquired by completing the Nightmare Crucible.

Bug: After upgrading an item with a core, there is a visual bug where the stats will appear not to increase.

items.name: Ascension Shard
items.description: Used to craft a Tier 4 Ascension Core
items.extract:
Ascension shard is a basic item used to craft ascension cores, which are in turn used to upgrade masterwork weapons into stronger forms.
There is currently no use for Power Level 7 shards, as cores earned directly from completing the Nightmare Crucible.

items.name: Ash Battlestaff
items.description: A magical weapon carved from ash wood.
items.extract: The ash battlestaff is a power level 2 magic weapon. It can be created at a crafting table using 12 ash logs, 6 rune essence, and 2 coarse thread. Unlocked after building Spinning Wheel.

items.name: Ash Chest
items.extract:
The ash chest is a small storage container for up to 32 item slots. Players can unlock the small chest by receiving ash logs in their inventory for the first time and unlocking the skill perk Creature Comforts. Players can also name their chest, up to 16 characters long. To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their chest and check the "Linked" checkbox in the chest interface. This will allow players to craft up to a 12-metre radius away from the chest.
Players can also lock their chest by opening the interface and checking the Private checkbox at the bottom.

items.name: Ash Farming Plot
items.extract:
The ash farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. Ash farming plots must be placed on the ground without a roof overhead. In addition, ash farming plots have three stages of weeds that players must dig after setting an ash farming plot on the ground.
It is the best farming plot to plant the following: 

Cabbage seeds
Flax seeds
Harralander seeds
Marentill seeds
Potato seeds
Redberry seeds
Wheat seeds

items.name: Ash Logs
items.description: Pieces of wood collected from branches, saplings and Ash trees.
items.extract: Ash logs are obtained by chopping down ash trees, picking them up off the ground, uprooting saplings, or chopping down thorny vines.

items.name: Ash Palisades
items.extract: Ash palisades are defensive structures that are built to protect a player-built structure. Palisades have high defence so that players are protected from Goblin raid events and other aggressive monsters.

items.name: Ash Palisades Gate
items.extract: Ash palisades gates are defensive structures that are built to protect a player-built structure. Players can place either a tier 1 or 2 door between the two pallisade beams and can also mix the two. Palisades gates have a high defence so that players are protected from Goblin raid events and other aggressive monsters.

items.name: Ash Pile
items.description: There seems to be something solid in the ash pile.
items.extract: Ash pile are a drop from a lesser demon and contains cursed essence, vile ashes, and infernal fragments.

items.name: Ash Plank
items.description: Basic building material.
items.extract: Ash planks are made by using ash logs on a sawmill. Ash planks can be used for construction or as an alternative to creating charcoal.

items.name: Ash Rod
items.description: A sturdy fishing rod, effective in Brynmoor.
items.extract: The ash rod is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. You must reach Fishing level 3 to unlock this recipe.

items.name: Ash Shortbow
items.description: A shortbow carved from ash wood.
items.extract: Ash shortbow is a power level 2 Shortbow that can be crafted at a Crafting Table.

items.name: Ash Tree Seed
items.description:
Ash tree seeds.

Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
items.extract:
An ash tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow an ash tree. 
Ash tree seeds have a power level of 1.

items.name: Ash Wand
items.description: A simple wand carved from ash wood. Every mage starts somewhere.
items.extract: The Ash wand is a power level 2 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a crafting table using 6 ash logs, 3 rune essence, and 1 coarse thread.

items.name: Astral Rune
items.description: Astral runes are used for casting advanced magic spells and attacks. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract: Astral runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 3 Runecrafting or higher. Astral runes are used in enchanting weapons, finding/gathering resources easily, accessing chests, and providing shelter.

items.name: Astral Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Astral rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received an astral rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Attack Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Attack is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Attack cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Attack. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Ava's Accumulator
items.description:
A bagged chicken ready to serve you, magnet in claw. 

Increases Arrow Recovery Chance and automatically picks up recovered arrows.
items.extract: Ava's accumulator is an armour item equipped in the cape slot. It is a reward from Animal Magnetism, and additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest. Ava's accumulator adds a 10% chance of recovering arrows when worn.

items.name: Avantoe
items.description: Can be used for potions.
items.extract: Avantoe is an herb obtained by harvesting Avantoe plants. It can be farmed by planting avantoe seeds in a willow farming plot, with iron secateurs providing an increased yield when harvesting.

items.name: Avantoe Seeds
items.description:
Equip and use these seeds to scatter them in a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Fellhollow plots.
items.extract:
Avantoe seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Avantoe seeds can be used to grow avantoe in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a willow farming plot. 
Planting avantoe seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming.

items.name: Azure Metal Contraption
items.description: A contraption made from strange blue metal. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Azure metal contraption is a consumable item that unlocks the creation of Blurite Crossbow Limbs, the blurite crossbow, and blurite bolts. This is found in a chest, located under a cliff near the northern border of the Fractured Plains, west of the main river. This cliff is located near a broken bridge and has surrounding wolves, garou hunters, and garou druids; players are recommended to bring armour, a high-tiered weapon, to help navigate through this area.

items.name: Bag of Flour
items.description: Cultivated grains ground to a fine powder.
items.extract: Bag of flour is a power level 2 processed material, which means it can be cooked at a kiln into bread starting at Cooking Level 12, and not burnt into burnt bread at level 27. It can be grinded from wheat with a grindstone.

items.name: Bag of Noggin'
items.description: The only thing this protects is your identity.
items.extract: The bag of Noggin' is a piece of power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige, a threadbare grain sack, found in a chest in Bramblemead Valley.

items.name: Baked Potato
items.description: Fluffy and delicious, if only you had some butter.
items.extract: The baked potato is a power level 1 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten. They can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Ball of Wool Thread
items.extract: A ball of wool thread is a decoration that is unlocked by creating wool thread.

items.name: Bandos Banner 01
items.extract: Bandos banner 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos banner 01.

items.name: Bandos Banner 02
items.extract: Bandos banner 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos banner 02.

items.name: Bandos Banner 03
items.extract: Bandos banner 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos banner 03.

items.name: Bandos Flag 01
items.extract: Bandos flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 01.

items.name: Bandos Flag 02
items.extract: Bandos flag 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 02.

items.name: Bandos Flag 03
items.extract: Bandos flag 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 03.

items.name: Bandos Flag 04
items.extract: Bandos flag 04 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 04.

items.name: Bandos Flag 05
items.extract: Bandos flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 05.

items.name: Bandos Flag 06
items.extract: Bandos flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Bandos flag 06.

items.name: Bandosian Amulet
items.description: A goblin artefact, found on a druid.
items.extract: Bandosian amulet is a quest item for Goblin Diplomacy. It is one of two amulets, found in a reliquary in some Bramblemead ruins, while the other is found on a garou druid in the Whispering Swamp caves.

items.name: Barbed Appendage
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The barbed appendage is a vestige that unlocks the kalphite carapace legs.

items.name: Barrel Cactus Seeds
items.description:
A Barrel Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.
items.extract: Barrel cactus seeds are a type of Umbral Sands Seed, used in the Farming skill. Barrel cactus seeds can be used to grow Barrel Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a yew farming plot.

items.name: Barrel of Granite
items.extract: A barrel of granite is a decoration that is unlocked by mining and receiving granite for the first time.

items.name: Barrel of Sandstone
items.extract: A barrel of sandstone is a decoration that is unlocked by mining and receiving sandstone for the first time.

items.name: Barrel of Stone
items.extract: A barrel of stone is a decoration that is unlocked by mining and receiving stone for the first time.

items.name: Barrel Pile
items.extract: A barrel pile is a decoration that is made with 60 ash logs, creating six barrels piled in the shape of a pyramid. The barrel pile does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors. The barrel pile is 4 metres long and 3.75 metres high.

items.name: Barricade
items.extract: A barricade is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks. Barricades are only available on Creative Mode.

items.name: Barricade End
items.extract: A barricade end is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks. Barricade ends are only available on Creative Mode.

items.name: Battle-Scarred Black Metal
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian shield. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The battle-scarred black metal is a vestige that unlocks the black shield. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

items.name: Beast-Training Notes
items.description: Notes, from the beastmasters of Dowdun Reach, on how to train various creatures.
items.extract:
Beast-training notes are Notes collected from the three Targets Rat Master Skrexis, Houndmaster Rexiton and Summoner Flament for the quest Wanted!.
Hand them in to Vannaka for your reward!

items.name: Bed
items.extract:
The bed is a buildable piece of furniture used to rest and set the player's respawn point in the world. If used at night, players will skip to daytime and regain their full rest meter; if used during the day, players will lie in place and slowly regain their rest meter over time. The bed requires 8 ash planks and 4 rough cloth to craft, and must be under a roof and enclosed with three walls to be used.
Placing and claiming this bed will offer a "bonus" radius of 20m, preventing monsters from spawning within this area.

items.name: Bed Roll
items.extract:
The bed roll is a buildable piece of furniture used to rest and set the player's respawn point in the world. If used at night, players will skip to daytime and regain their full rest meter; if used during the day, players will lie in place and slowly regain their rest meter over time. The bed roll requires 3 ash logs and 3 coarse animal fur to craft, and must be under a roof and enclosed with three walls to be used.
Placing and claiming this bed will offer a "bonus" radius of 20m, preventing monsters from spawning within this area.

items.name: Bedraggled Spellbook
items.description: An ancient book of spells by Agatha's mail-order magic service. "Guaranteed to put warts on your nose, or your money back!"
items.extract: The bedraggled spellbook is a quest item that is found during the Mirror, Mirror quest. Players will need to return this book to Edna as well as 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments.

items.name: Beef & Tomato Stew
items.description: Hearty, healthy & delicious.
items.extract: Beef & tomato stew is a consumable food item that provides 60 health and 65 sustenance. It is made with grilled tomatoes, steak, and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Beef & Tomato Stew (decoration)
items.extract: A beef & tomato stew is a decoration that is first unlocked by successfully cooking a beef & tomato stew.

items.name: Beltfish Broth
items.description: A potent soup made from beltfish.
items.extract: Beltfish broth is a consumable food item that provide 130 health and 25 sustenance. It is made with steamed beltfish, peach, and fried cabbage and despite being a filling meal, can only be cooked in a cooking range.

items.name: Berry Compote
items.description: A fruity medley of cooked berries. A great, sweet treat for enjoying in the wild.
items.extract: Berry compote is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining redberries and dwellberries at a cooking pot. When consumed it provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making a berry compote.

items.name: Berry Drizzle Pan-Seared
items.description: Made by combining smoked herring, seared anchovies and dried dwellberry.
items.extract: Berry drizzle pan-seared is a consumable food item that provides 160 health and 65 sustenance. It is made with smoked herring, seared anchovies, and dried dwellberries in a cooking range.

items.name: Bird Nest
items.description: I wonder what's inside...
items.extract: Bird nests are drops found when felling trees. They contain assortments of skilling items that are dropped on the floor once opened. The ability to find bird nests is unlocked at 16 Woodcutting. In addition, opening a bird nest will provide 20 Woodcutting experience.

items.name: Bittercap Mushroom
items.description: A tasty mushroom. Can be used in a variety of cooking recipes.
items.extract: Bittercap mushrooms are a power level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into grilled mushrooms starting at Cooking Level 12, and not burnt into burnt mushroom at level 27. They can also be used to make weak antipoison potion. They can be gathered from bittercap mushroom (plant)s in the Whispering Swamp and Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Black Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The black adventurer's cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Black Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of Black crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Black Knight Crossbow.
items.extract: Black crossbow limbs are a component in creating the shadow crossbow. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Black Desert Cape
items.description: A black cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The black desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the black memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Black Dragon Hide
items.description: Obtained from felling black dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.
items.extract: Black dragon hide is a basic material dropped by Black dragons which can be tanned to create Black Dragon Leather.

items.name: Black Dragon Leather
items.description: Made by tanning black dragonhide. A key component for ranged armour.
items.extract: Black Dragon Leather is a processed material created with one black dragon hide, one dragon blood and one ground rune essence in the advanced tannery that can be used to craft power level 8 equipment.

items.name: Black Dragon Trophy
items.extract: The Black Dragon Trophy is a decoration that can be obtained through the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Black Dragonhide Body
items.description: Tough, flexible black dragonhide armour trusted by hunters who prefer to strike from afar.
items.extract: Black Dragonhide Body is a Power level 8 ranged armour piece crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Black Dragonhide Chaps
items.description: Crafted from resilient black dragonhide, these leggings allow swift movement while providing excellent protection.
items.extract: Black dragonhide chaps is a power level 8 ranged armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Black Dragonhide Coif
items.description: Fashioned from black dragonhide, this helm offers protection without hindering an archer's awareness.
items.extract: Black dragonhide coif is a power level 8 ranged armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Black Greataxe
items.description: A hulking greataxe made from black metal.
items.extract:
The black greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bloodstained hilt, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments, or acquired from chest (dowdun reach). It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is 4-7% increased damage compared to other greataxes at similar power levels, but it has the same 15% increased stamina cost as thane's authority.
This makes it flatly better than thane's authority, but unless it hits certain enemy breakpoints (i.e. killing an enemy in two hits instead of three), it may not be better than a mithril greataxe or adamant greataxe.

items.name: Black Knight Helmet
items.description: A metal helm worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach
items.extract:
Black Knight helmet is a power level 6 melee armour that can be created at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the bloodstained black visor vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Black Knight Platebody
items.description: A heavy chestplate worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach
items.extract:
Black Knight platebody is a power level 6 armour piece that can be created at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the shard of black pauldron vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Black Knight Platelegs
items.description: Sturdy leg armour worn by the Black Knights of Dowdun Reach.
items.extract:
Black Knight platelegs is a power level 6 armour piece that can be created at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the grim black codpiece vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Black Knight's Fortress Reward Pack
items.description: A cloth shoulder bag[sic]
items.extract: The Black Knight's Fortress reward pack is a reward for completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest, containing the Tome of the Titan and Titan's Wrath.

items.name: Black Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The black memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the black desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Black Metal Bar
items.description: A bar of reforged black metal scraps. Used to make Black Knight gear.
items.extract: An black metal bar is a component of a variety of armour and weapons.

items.name: Black Metal Scraps
items.description: Dropped from Black Knights. Can be reforged into black metal at a Blast Furnace.
items.extract: Black metal scraps is dropped from Black Knights. Six scraps can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one black metal bar. Alternatively, players can create different coloured chandeliers and torches.

items.name: Black Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps that can be searched through. Little bits of Black Knight are in there.
items.extract: Black salvage piles are drops from defeating Black Knights. Nine salvage piles can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace, to create one black metal bar.

items.name: Black Shield
items.description: A shield popularised by the Black Knights and made from black matal.
items.extract:
The black shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the battle-scarred black metal vestige, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. Unlike the black weapons, the shield cannot be found in chests in Dowdun Reach. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
This shield does not have a special effect, despite being an ascendable vestige.
Given how long it takes to acquire black metal bars, this shield should only be crafted and/or ascended for the sake of fashion.

items.name: Black Sword
items.description: A sword in the style of the Black Knights, forged from black metal.
items.extract:
The black sword is a one-handed power level 6 melee weapon. The recipe is unlocked after studying the shattered black blade vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect deals 15% increased damage against mages, which includes garou druids, skeletal necromancers, zamorakian acolytes, and mages of zamorak. The latter two are also weak to slash damage, dealing an additional 25%, for a total of 44% increased damage.
This weapon has the same damage ranges when the same power level as the wooden training sword, but the toktz-xil-ak has slightly higher damage values in addition to having an additional chance to crit. The zombie axe also deals slash damage, but though it does more per hit, it uses the mace attack style which is slower. Therefore, this weapon is the ideal choice against mages, the toktz-xil-ak is best against other enemies weak to slash damage, otherwise the zombie axe is best in every other situation.

items.name: Blacksmith's Bench
items.extract: The blacksmith's bench is a buildable facility where players can only create weapons that are higher tiered than stone equipment. The blacksmith's bench replaced the smithing anvil in the game, and is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar in the player's inventory.

items.name: Blast Furnace
items.extract:
This page is about the furnace capable of smelting higher tiered materials. For the normal version, please see furnace.
The blast furnace is a facility used to process ores into bars. It requires fuel pellets to operate, which can be obtained by combining charcoal, adhesive, and coarse animal fur at a blacksmith's bench. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it, and it must not have a roof above it to function.
It can only be built once the player has unlocked the recipe after obtaining coal for the first time.

items.name: Blightwood
items.description: Logs cut from ancient trees or roots.
items.extract: Blightwood can be found in Bloodblight Swamp. The wood can be chopped from the pale blightwood root on larger trees in the swamp. To chop the blightwood root, players will need an iron logging axe or better.

items.name: Blightwood Battlestaff
items.description: A magical weapon fit for a Wizard.
items.extract: Blightwood battlestaff is a power level 4 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

items.name: Blightwood Longbow
items.description: A finely crafted longbow, powerful and precise.
items.extract: Blightwood longbow is a power level 4 Longbows that can be crafted at the fletching bench, once the recipe is unlocked by cutting and picking up blightwood and swamp thread.

items.name: Blightwood Shortbow
items.description: A finely crafted bow, fast and reliable.
items.extract: The blightwood shortbow is a power level 4 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Blightwood Wand
items.description: Fashioned from blightwood, its magic feels unsettlingly eager to obey.
items.extract: The Blightwood wand is a power level 4 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 blightwood, 3 wild anima, 2 swamp thread, and 2 vault shard.

items.name: Bloodblight Cape
items.description: A cloak commemorating a dragon's vengeance.
items.extract: The Bloodblight cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bloodblight Cape Pattern, found in a chest behind a broken wall in the Bloodblight Castle.

items.name: Bloodstained Black Visor
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian helmet. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The bloodstained black visor is a vestige that unlocks the Black Knight helmet. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

items.name: Bloodstained Hilt
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The bloodstained hilt is a vestige that unlocks the black greataxe. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

items.name: Bloodwood Sap
items.description: Harvested from bloodwood trees found in the toxic swamp in Ghornfell.
items.extract:
Bloodwood sap can be found by logging the red formations on the bloodwood tree in the southernmost area of the Bloodblight Swamp, that is located in the middle of a garou camp.
Bloodwood sap is required for progression in the quest Dragon Slayer, as it is a component of the challenge horn.
Players will need to use an iron logging axe or higher to harvest this material from the bloodwood tree.

items.name: Bludgeoning Obsidian Construct
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The bludgeoning obsidian construct is a vestige that unlocks the TzHaar-ket-om. It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Ket in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Blue Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The adventurer's cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft. The recipe to craft the cape can be obtained by purchasing it from Death for soul fragments. When making the cape, there are options for several colour variants, those being: Blue, Red, Yellow, Purple, Green, Black, Orange, Pink, and White.

items.name: Blue Chandelier
items.extract: A blue chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

items.name: Blue Desert Cape
items.description: A Blue cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The blue desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the blue memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands. It is also an awarf after completing Mapping The Sands I

items.name: Blue Dragon Leather
items.description: Made by tanning blue dragonhide. A key component for ranged armour.
items.extract: Blue dragon leather is a processed material created from tanning blue dragon hide.

items.name: Blue Dragon Scale
items.description: Obtained from felled lesser blue dragons. Can be ground into blue dragon dust.
items.extract: Blue dragon scale is dropped from blue dragon. One scale can be ground into two blue dragon scale dust.

items.name: Blue Dragon Scale Dust
items.description: Ground from blue dragon scales. Integral to making antifire potions.
items.extract: Blue dragon scale dust is a processed material used to make antifire potions.

items.name: Blue Dragon Trophy
items.extract: The Blue Dragon Trophy is a decoration that can be obtained through the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Blue Dragonhide
items.description: Obtained from felled Lesser Blue Dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.
items.extract: Blue dragon hide is a basic material dropped by blue dragons which can be tanned to create blue dragonhide leather.

items.name: Blue Dragonhide Body
items.description: Ranged body armour crafted from blue dragonhide. Form-fitting, yet intimidating.
items.extract:
Blue dragonhide body is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

items.name: Blue Dragonhide Chaps
items.description: Flexible ranged leg armour crafted from blue dragonhide.
items.extract:
Blue dragonhide chaps is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

items.name: Blue Dragonhide Coif
items.description: Lightweight ranged headgear crafted from blue dragonhide.
items.extract:
Blue dragonhide coif is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining blue dragon hide.

items.name: Blue Dyed Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The blue dyed cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Blue Hex Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The blue hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Blue Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The blue memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the blue desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Blue Standing Torch
items.extract: Blue standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: blue standing torch recipe.

items.name: Blue Standing Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The blue standing torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Fellhollow region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the blue standing torch.

items.name: Blue Torch
items.description: A trusty lightsource[sic] - now in blue.
items.extract: The blue torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished blue remnants.

items.name: Blue Wall-mounted Torch
items.extract: Blue wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: blue wall-mounted torch recipe.

items.name: Blue Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The blue wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Dowdun Reach region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the blue wall-mounted torch.

items.name: Blurite Bar
items.description: A rare bar of refined blurite, thought to be a myth.
items.extract: A blurite bar can be made in a furnace by smelting three blurite ore. This bar is used in the smithing anvil to create blurite limbs for a blurite crossbow and make the blurite bolts in the fletching bench.

items.name: Blurite Bar (decoration)
items.extract: A blurite bar is a decoration that requires one blurite bar. The blurite bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Blurite Bolts
items.description: Crossbow Bolts made from Blurite.
items.extract: Blurite bolts are power level 4 ammunition that can be fired with a blurite crossbow or higher. They are crafted at a fletching bench after unlocking the recipe with the vestige: azure metal contraption.

items.name: Blurite Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow made from Blurite, thought to be a myth.
items.extract:
The blurite crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned after studying the azure metal contraption found in a chest in northwest Fractured Plains. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is -25% Reload Duration, making it reload faster than other crossbows. It also lists -25% durability, but it has the same amount as an iron crossbow.
The dorgeshuun crossbow can only fire bone bolts, so if specifically wanting to fire metal or enchanted bolts, this is one of the best options to do so. The shadow crossbow's special effect is 15% increased damage to weakpoints, which is a multiplicative modifier when considering weakpoints, 3/3 ranged armour, and the amulet of glory, but it fires slower than normal crossbows, making it much slower than this or the dorgeshuun crossbow. One of the benefits of crossbows is the flinch they cause on each hit, and the faster crossbows will do that more often.

items.name: Blurite Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of blurite crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Blurite Crossbow.
items.extract: Blurite crossbow limbs are used in crafting blurite crossbows. They are crafted at a blacksmith's bench after unlocking the recipe with the vestige: azure metal contraption.

items.name: Blurite Ore
items.description: A chunk of rare and unrefined blurite.
items.extract: Blurite ore is a basic Mining material found by mining the blurite ore nodes in the Takla Kara vault. Players can smelt this ore in a furnace to make blurite bars.

items.name: Bolt of Coarse Thread
items.extract: A bolt of coarse thread is a decoration that is unlocked by creating coarse thread.

items.name: Bone Bolts
items.description: Lightweight, but very sharp. Can be fired using the Dorgeshuun Crossbow.
items.extract: Bone bolts are a power level 5 ammunition that can only be fired from Dorgeshuun crossbows. Bone bolts are unlocked after completing the quest, Even More Restless Ghosts. Unlike other bolts that split their damage between the crossbow and the bolt, all of it is on the crossbow so that it ascends properly.

stats.label: Special action
stats.value: HITS cause BLEED build up on targets

items.name: Bone Club
items.description: A primitive weapon made from bone, perfect for smashing other bones.
items.extract: The bone club is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

items.name: Bone Crossbow Limbs
items.description: Crossbow limbs made from powerful bone. Used in crafting the Dorgeshuun Crossbow.
items.extract: Bone crossbow limbs can be created at a blacksmith's bench and can be used to craft a Dorgeshuun crossbow.

items.name: Bone Dagger
items.description: A sinister weapon, crafted from the bones of fallen creatures.
items.extract: The bone dagger is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

items.name: Bone Pickaxe
items.description: A basic mining tool made from tough animal bone. It is hard enough to mine copper and tin deposits.
items.extract: A bone pickaxe is a power level 2 pickaxe that can be crafted at a crafting table. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with copper ore, and tin ore, dealing 15 damage to minable ores, and 30 damage with a critical swing. To unlock the recipe, players must have acquired animal bones.

items.name: Bookcase
items.extract: A bookcase is a type of decoration that is unlocked by receiving ash logs in the player's inventory. The bookcase has five shelves where players can fit small objects (e.g., lying books, standing books, and open books) on top.

items.name: Bow of Elidinis
items.description: This ancient bow is a relic of Elidnis: Goddess of the Moon, Rivers, Growth and Fertility.
items.extract:
The bow of Elidinis is a power level 7 masterwork longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is received as a reward for completing the Mapping The Sands II quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its first special effect is Blessing of Elidinis, which makes arrows also deal water magic damage in addition to ranged damage. Kills with water magic have a chance to drop water orbs that provide some health and a little hydration when picked up. Its special action is Lunar Rain, which costs 6 stamina and deals water magic damage over the targeted area for a short time. This is considered a Magic attack rather than a Ranged one, providing Magic XP and benefitting from the lesser magic potion and 3/3 magic armour's set effect increasing the chance of getting critical strikes instead of Ranged XP and weakpoint modifiers. However, its other special effect is Purity of the Moon, which prevents the use of barbed, poisoned, and fire arrows when using this bow.
Similar to the zombie axe, this weapon deals both ranged and water damage simultaneously. Unlike most other damage modifiers, this damage is additive, which means that attacking an enemy weak to one but resistant to the other will result in more damage done than expected, but less than an enemy neither weak nor resistant to either. When comparing this bow to the hunter stagbow against KotHaar specifically, it deals slightly more, but the stagbow fires slightly faster. Therefore, when not using Astral Rain, in all other situations, the hunter stagbow is the ideal longbow to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * LUNAR RAIN: Call down a BARRAGE OF ARROWS that fall like rain and deal DAMAGE over the TARGETED AREA, with a chance of spawning a WATER ORB. * BLESSING OF ELIDINIS: Arrows deal WATER DAMAGE. Kills with water arrows have a chance to drop WATER ORBS that provide HEALTH REGEN when picked up. * PURITY OF THE MOON: Cannot use POISON, BLEED and FIRE ARROWS.

items.name: Bowl of Onions
items.extract: A bowl of onions is a decoration that is unlocked by learning the PLAN: bowl of onions recipe.

items.name: Bowl of Peaches
items.extract: A bowl of peaches is a decoration that is unlocked by learning the PLAN: bowl of peaches recipe.

items.name: Braised Catfish
items.description: If your feline hungry, eat a catfish. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]
items.extract: Braised catfish is a consumable food item that provides 120 health and 30 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw armoured catfish on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in stuffed catfish.

items.name: Braised Undead Eel
items.description: Makes you queasy but does wonders for hunger. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]
items.extract: Braised undead eel is a consumable food item that provides 60 health and 25 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw undead eel on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in fish fry.

items.name: Bramblemead Cape
items.description: A cloak to remember simpler times.
items.extract: The Bramblemead cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bramblemead Cape Pattern, found in a chest atop the Runecrafting Guild. Using only Windstep to reach the chest is considerably difficult; it is recommended to do this in combination with building foundations.

items.name: Bramblemead Magpie Perch
items.extract: Bramblemead Magpie Perch is a decoration.

items.name: Bread
items.description: Crusty brown outside, pillowy white inside.
items.extract: Bread is a power level 2 food. It can be created by using a bag of flour on a kiln. It heals 20 health and provides 30 sustenance when consumed.

items.name: Brewing Cauldron
items.extract: The brewing cauldron is used to brew various potions that can boost the player's abilities, increase experience gained, grant immunities to status effects, or restore their health. It will display all known recipes in its crafting menu and will draw from nearby linked storages. It does not have any shelter restrictions and can be placed without a foundation. It is learned when picking up clay for the first time.

items.name: Broken Titan's Wrath
items.description: The shattered remnant of the Black Knight Titan's sword.
items.extract:
The broken Titan's Wrath is a quest item dropped by the Black Knight Titan. This can be refined at a blacksmith's bench to create the Titan's Wrath.
Note: This item remains a quest item even after completion of Black Knight's Fortress. Subsequent drops of this item will be placed in the quest item tab of the inventory automatically.

items.name: Broken Wooden Crate
items.extract: A broken wooden crate is a decorative item unlocked by learning the PLAN: broken wooden crate recipe. The broken wooden crate does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Bronze Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from bronze.
