items.extract: Bronze arrows are power level 3 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Bronze Bar
items.description: A versatile crafting material, smelted from bars of copper and tin.
items.extract:
A bronze bar is a material used to craft weapons and armour. It is created by smelting 3 copper ore and 3 tin ore at a furnace. 
Receiving the bronze bar in the player's inventory will unlock the following:

Loom
Sawmill
Blacksmith's bench
Armour bench
Mystic forge
Tanner's kit

items.name: Bronze Bar (decoration)
items.extract: A bronze bar is a decoration that requires one bronze bar. The bronze bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Bronze Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from bronze.
items.extract: Bronze barbed arrows are bronze arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Targets that are hit by a bronze barbed arrow will be inflicted with the bleed debuff. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Bronze Bolts
items.description: Crossbow bolts made from bronze.
items.extract: Bronze bolts are a power level 3 ammunition that can be fired from bronze crossbows.

items.name: Bronze Crossbow
items.description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Bronze.
items.extract: A bronze crossbow is a power level 3 Crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Bronze Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of bronze crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Bronze Crossbow.
items.extract: Bronze crossbow limbs are used in crafting bronze crossbows. They are crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Bronze Dagger
items.description: A small blade forged from bronze, suitable for close combat.
items.extract: The bronze dagger is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

items.name: Bronze Fire Arrow
items.description: Burning arrows with tips forged from bronze coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Bronze fire arrows are bronze arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by a bronze fire arrow will be inflicted with the burning debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Bronze Greatsword
items.description: A two-handed bronze sword for those who prefer power over speed.
items.extract: The bronze greatsword is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

items.name: Bronze Helmet
items.description: A helmet forged from bronze.
items.extract: A bronze helmet is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Bronze Leaf
items.description: A thin sheet of purest bronze, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into bronze bars.
items.extract: Bronze leaves are a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions or create bronze bars. To obtain these, players must either collect them from bronze (or better) reward packs or recycle bronze bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

items.name: Bronze Logging Axe
items.description: A woodcutter's tool, forged from bronze.
items.extract: The bronze logging axe is a power level 3 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The bronze logging axe can cut the same trees as the previous tiers, along with oak trees. Deals 20 damage when felling applicable trees, and 30 when overhead chopping to split them.

items.name: Bronze Mace
items.description: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked bronze mace.
items.extract: The bronze mace is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

items.name: Bronze Med Helm
items.description: A simple bronze helm that's seen more training grounds than battlefields.
items.extract: The Bronze Med Helm is a power level 3 armour piece. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Bronze Bar, 2 Hard Leather, and 1 Wool Thread. The recipe for this item is obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition and by having a bronze bar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Bronze Medal
items.extract: Bronze medal is a building decorative trophy that players can build once they have completed all available Agility courses at bronze or higher records.

items.name: Bronze Pickaxe
items.description: A trusty tool for mining, made from sturdy bronze.
items.extract: The bronze pickaxe is a power level 3 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with iron ore, as well as sandstone, and granite, dealing 34 damage to mineable ores, and 68 with a critical swing.

items.name: Bronze Platebody
items.description: A heavy chestplate made from bronze.
items.extract: A bronze platebody is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Bronze Platelegs
items.description: Heavy platelegs made from bronze.
items.extract: Bronze platelegs Is a power level 3 armour piece that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Bronze Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps that can be searched through. Seems like it's just a pile of bronze offcuts.
items.extract: Bronze salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one bronze bar.

items.name: Bronze Shield
items.description: Steadily block and parry attacks with this basic, dependable bronze shield.
items.extract: The bronze shield  is a power level 3 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Bronze Spade
items.description:
A basic Spade made from bronze.

Used to clear farming plots.
items.extract: A bronze spade is a power level 2 spade that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress by 40% to the next plot clearing stage. Therefore, it will take three digs to progress one stage.

items.name: Bronze Sword
items.description: A well-balanced bronze blade.
items.extract: The bronze sword is a power level 3 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

items.name: Bronze Warhammer
items.description: A heavy-hitting, two-handed weapon crafted from bronze.
items.extract: The bronze warhammer is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon that is crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

items.name: Bronze Watering Can
items.extract:
The bronze watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots, it has a capacity of 250 water and a watering rate of 25 per action.
The can may be filled with either dirty water or clean water, but not both at the same time. When the can is filled, it may not be filled with the opposite type until it is emptied. Players are able to empty the can at any time and fill it with a different water type.
To fill the can, the can must be filled at a water source. Players cannot use the physical items dirty water or clean water to fill the can.
Along with bodies of water, players may fill the can at the rain catcher, well, water barrel, or large water barrel.

items.name: Brynmoor Falcon Perch
items.extract: Brynmoor Falcon Perch is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Hills Tapestry
items.extract: Brynmoor Hills Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Lake Flora Tapestry
items.extract: The Brynmoor Lake Flora Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Lake Tapestry
items.extract: Brynmoor Lake Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Swamp Night Tapestry
items.extract: Brynmoor Swamp Night Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Swamp Tapestry
items.extract: Brynmoor Swamp Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Swamp Toxic Tapestry
items.extract: Brynmoor Swamp Toxic Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Brynmoor Valley Tapestry
items.extract: The Brynmoor Valley Tapestry is a decoration unlocked by those who purchased the Deluxe Edition or Deluxe Edition Upgrade.

items.name: Bucket of Milk
items.description: A bucket of milk from a stubborn cow.
items.extract: The bucket of milk is a quest item for the Cook's Assistant quest. To obtain it, players must interact with the cow just outside of the quest starting area, in a pen.

items.name: Build Protection Totem
items.extract: The building protection totem is a constructed object that provides griefing protection when in a multiplayer world. Players can activate the totem, protecting their nearby built objects (up to a 20-metre 3D radius) until they deactivate the totem. Each player can only have up to 8 protection totems and does not require any items. However, building another protection totem after reaching the limit will instead result in receiving a message: "Placement limit reached for this piece."

items.name: Bundle of Undead Twigs
items.description: [[Manktongue]] needs these undead twigs to make [[Ava's accumulator]]
items.extract: A bundle of undead twigs is a quest item obtained during the quest Animal Magnetism. The item acquired upon interacting with the "red" undead tree in the middle of Bloodblight Swamp, near the abyssal demon.

items.name: Bunny Cactus Seeds
items.description:
A Bunny Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.
items.extract: Bunny cactus seeds are a type of Umbral Sand seed, used in the Farming skill. Bunny cactus seeds can be used to grow Bunny Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a yew farming plot.

items.name: Burnished Belt Buckle
items.description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Burnished belt buckle is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the necromancer's robe bottom.

items.name: Burnt Anchovies
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt anchovies is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw anchovies at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for Composting.

items.name: Burnt Beltfish
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt beltfish are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw beltfish, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

items.name: Burnt Bread
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt bread is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking bread or guaranteed when intentionally overcooking bread at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Cabbage
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt cabbages are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking cabbage at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Cactus Steak
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: A Burnt Cactus Steak is a burnt version of the seared cactus steak, giving players 20 soulscourge when eaten.

items.name: Burnt Cadavaberries
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract:
Burnt cadavaberries are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking cadavaberries at a campfire or grill, providing 10 sustenance and 45 soulscourge when consumed, and have no uses beyond being eaten for food. 
Currently, these are unable to be composted, and it is uncertain if this is intentional or due to a bug with the release of the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Catfish
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt catfish is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw armoured catfish at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Desert Sole
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt desert sole are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw desert sole, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

items.name: Burnt Dwellberries
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt dwellberries are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking dwellberries at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Egg
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt eggs are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking eggs at a campfire or grill.They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Fillet
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract:
Burnt fillets are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw bird meat at a campfire or grill, providing 10 sustenance when consumed. However, burnt fillets, like any burnt food, can be used as compost at a compost bin.
Players can also receive burnt fillets as a drop from chopping down dead trees.

items.name: Burnt Flank
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt flanks are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw bestial meat at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Giant Krill
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt giant krill is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw giant krill at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Haunch
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt haunches are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw game meat at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Herring
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt herring is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw herring at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Infernal Eel
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt infernal eel is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw infernal eel at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Lobster
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt lobster is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw lobster at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Maple Syrup
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt maple syrup is a power level 4 consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking maple sap at a campfire or grill, and guaranteed when cooking maple syrup. It requires a Cooking level lower than 50 to burn from maple sap, and guaranteed with a level lower than 41. It provides 15 sustenance when consumed. Despite being a power level 4 item, it can only be deposited into a compost bin and not a super compost bin.

items.name: Burnt Monkfish
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt monkfish are consumable burnt food that have a chance to be made when cooking raw desert sole, providing 15 sustenance when consumed. It can also be used as compost in a compost bin.

items.name: Burnt Mushroom
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt mushrooms are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking a mushroom at a campfire or grill, provide 10 sustenance when consumed. and have no uses beyond being eaten for food, or compost with the planned release of the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Onion
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt onions are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking an onion at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Peach
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt peaches are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking a peach at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Potato
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt potatoes are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking a potato at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Pumpkin
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt pumpkin is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking pumpkin at a campfire or grill, provides 15 sustenance when consumed, and has no uses beyond being eaten for food.

items.name: Burnt Rat Roast
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt rat roasts are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw rat meat at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Redberries
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt redberries are a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking redberries at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed. They have no uses beyond being eaten for food, but have a compost level of 10 at a compost bin.

items.name: Burnt Salmon
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt salmon is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw salmon at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Sardine
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt sardine is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw sardine at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Shrimp
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt shrimp is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw shrimp at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Steak
items.description: A little too well done.
items.extract: Burnt steaks are a consumable burnt food item that have a chance to be made when cooking raw farm meat at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed or can be used for compost with the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Tomato
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt tomatoes are a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking tomatoes at a campfire or grill. They provide 10 sustenance when consumed. They have no uses beyond being eaten for food, but are planned to be usable for compost with the release of the Farming skill.

items.name: Burnt Trout
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt trout is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw trout at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Undead Bass
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt undead bass is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw undead bass at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Undead Eel
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt undead eel is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking raw undead eel at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Burnt Undead Steak
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: A burnt undead steak is a burnt version of undead meat. Restores 25 sustenance, gives 45 soulscourge and gives the ravenous effect, which lasts for 150 seconds.

items.name: Burnt Watermelon
items.description: Too well done, but still edible.
items.extract: Burnt watermelon is a consumable burnt food item that has a chance to be made when cooking watermelon or guaranteed when intentionally overcooking watermelon jerky at a campfire or grill. It can be eaten or used for composting.

items.name: Cabbage
items.description: Yuck I don't like cabbage.
items.extract: Cabbages are a power level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fried cabbage starting at Cooking Level 12, and not burnt into burnt cabbage at level 27. They can also be used to make weak Focused Cooking potions and Focused Cooking potions. They can be gathered from cabbage plants in Bramblemead Valley and cabbage (Farming) from cabbage seeds.

items.name: Cabbage Seeds
items.description:
Cabbage Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract:
Cabbage seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Cabbage seeds can be used to grow Cabbage in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot.
Planting cabbage seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming.

items.name: Cactus Fibres
items.description: Pipe cactus, sans water.
items.extract: Cactus fibres is a material item created at a tannery, and is a requirement to make desert cloth.

items.name: Cactus Steak
items.description: A moist and sweet botanical edible. It has a fresh floral fragrance.
items.extract: Cactus steak is a power level 5 raw ingredient. Despite the description, this item is not edible without being cooked.

items.name: Cactus Water
items.description: A brackish but refreshing beverage.
items.extract: Cactus water is a consumable drink item that provides 25 hydration and grants the perk Frosted Flavours that grants resistance to scorch buildup for 300 seconds.

items.name: Cadavaberries
items.description: Can be eaten raw, but wouldn't recommend it. Can be cooked alone or as an ingredient in cooking meals.
items.extract: Cadavaberries are a consumable food item that provides 10 sustenance but also 20 Soulscourge, which will cause damage over time if it builds to 100. They are also a power level 4 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried cadavaberries starting at Cooking Level 41, and not burnt into burnt cadavaberries at level 50. They can be collected from cadavaberry bushes in Fellhollow and Farmed from cadavaberry bush (Farming) grown from cadavaberry seeds.

items.name: Cadavaberry Infusion
items.description: A refreshing fruity drink. Excellent for hydration.
items.extract: Cadavaberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 900 seconds. It is made with clean water and dried cadavaberries in a cooking range.

items.name: Cadavaberry Seeds
items.description:
A handful of Cadavaberry Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Fellhollow plots.
items.extract: Cadavaberry seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Cadavaberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild cadavaberry bushes.

items.name: Campfire
items.extract:
A campfire can be built using 4 ash logs and 4 stones. It is used to cook basic foods using ash logs or charcoal as fuel. After building a campfire, one ash log will already be in the fuel slot. Cooking with a campfire may result in burnt food, depending on the type of food and the player's Cooking level.
It must not have a roof above it to function.

items.name: Cape Hook
items.extract: A cape hook is a type of furniture that can store and display one cape, similar to the cape rack.

items.name: Cape Rack
items.extract: The cape rack is a type of furniture that can store only one cape. The cape rack is unlockable at level 40 Artisan.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the armour mannequin and cape rack, allowing you to display all of your armour sets and capes with pride!

items.name: Carnivorous Chinchompa Trophy
items.extract: The Carnivorous Chinchompa Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Carved Bone Animal Lure
items.description: Seems eager to be elsewhere. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The carved bone animal lure is a vestige that can be studied to unlock the ring of pursuit.

items.name: Cauterised Undead Steak
items.description: A technically edible steak. Morally? That's another question[sic]
items.extract: Cauterised undead steak is a power level 4 food item that provides 2 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perks Ravenous and Steadfast Stomach, which drains hydration and sustenance 20% faster and grants resistance to Wither effects for 150 seconds. It can be cooked from undead meat at either a campfire or a grill, and is used in dubious meat pie.

items.name: Chair
items.extract: A chair is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the chair.

items.name: Challenge Horn
items.description: An ornate dragonkin horn, traditionally used to challenge someone to a duel of honour. Bring it to the dragonkin altar to challenge Velgar.
items.extract: A challenge horn is a quest item used in the Dragon Slayer quest. It can be created at a blacksmith's bench. The horn can be used at the top of Velgar's Rise to summon Velgar.

items.name: Chandelier
items.extract: A chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

items.name: Charcoal
items.description:
Produced by burning wood in a kiln.
Charcoal is a very efficient fuel.
items.extract:
Charcoal is a form of fuel created by processing wood at a kiln. Charcoal provides facilities 3 minutes of fuel time, serving as an improvement over using wood as a fuel source. In addition to being a fuel source, charcoal is a reagent for other items and buildings.
Note: Twice as much charcoal can be produced if first milling logs into planks.

items.name: Cheeky Fryup
items.description: A surefire hangover cure.
items.extract: Cheeky fryup is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perk Foreman's Feast, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with rat roast, baked potato, and fried egg in a stone range or a cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Amateur Culinaromancer at level 16 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Cheeky Fryup (decoration)
items.extract: A cheeky fryup is a decoration that is unlocked after successfully cooking a cheeky fryup.

items.name: Chef's Hat
items.description: What a silly hat.
items.extract: The chef's hat is a power level 1 headwear whose recipe is obtained when a player reaches level 40 Cooking and obtains the perk Yes, chef!.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks recipe for Chef's Hat, craftable at the Crafting Station.

items.name: Chewed Blue Cloth
items.description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.
items.extract: The chewed blue cloth is a vestige that unlocks the blue dyad cape. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

items.name: Chewed Green Cloth
items.description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.
items.extract: The chewed green cloth is a vestige that unlocks the green dyad cape. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

items.name: Chewed Pink Cloth
items.description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The chewed pink cloth is a vestige that unlocks the pink dyad cape. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

items.name: Chewed Red Cloth
items.description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.
items.extract: The chewed red cloth is a vestige that unlocks the red dyad cape. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

items.name: Chewed Yellow Cloth
items.description: Some dodgy-looking scraps of what seems to be a cape. Perhaps you could lear from it.
items.extract: The chewed yellow cloth is a vestige that unlocks the yellow dyad cape. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 150 infernal fragments.

items.name: Chieftain's Blade
items.description: The sword of a goblin chieftain, used to spread war in the name of the Big High War God.
items.extract:
The chieftain's blade is a power level 3 one-handed weapon, created by combining 10 bronze bars, 2 antlers, and 2 animal bones at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige a corroded serrated blade, found in a chest atop the same plateau where you start the Heartstrings quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
It has even lower damage ranges than the wooden training sword, making it the least valuable weapon to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL Hits with SWORD ATTACKS * Reduced DAMAGE

items.name: Chipped Obsidian Construct
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The chipped obsidian construct is a vestige that unlocks the obsidian helmet.

items.name: Chitinous Carapace
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The chitinous carapace is a vestige that unlocks the kalphite carapace chest.

items.name: Clay
items.description: Essential for pottery and construction, dig it up from nearby water sources.
items.extract:
Clay is a basic Mining material that can be mined from clay nodes. It can be used at a pottery wheel to craft a variety of items, which must then be fired using a kiln. Note that clay can be worked directly, and does not need to be made into soft clay.
Receiving clay from any source is required to unlock the pottery wheel, kiln, and brewing cauldron.

items.name: Clay Decoration
items.description: A figurine made of clay. Now hardened.
items.extract: A clay decoration is an item that can be crafted by using three pieces of clay on a pottery wheel to produce a clay decoration (unfired), and then using the unfired clay decoration on a kiln to create the finished clay decoration.

items.name: Clay Decoration (Unfired)
items.description: A figurine made of clay. Still wet.
items.extract: Clay decoration (unfired) is an item that is unlocked after mining and receiving clay for the first time. Players can fire the clay with a kiln, creating a fired clay decoration.

items.name: Clay Mould
items.description: A blank canvas for creating enchanted amulets; just add precious metals and gems.
items.extract: A clay mould is a clay mould that is fired in a kiln and is used as an ingredient at the jeweler's bench for making trinkets.

items.name: Clay Mould (Unfired)
items.description: Bake this in a kiln to create an amulet mould.
items.extract:
An unfired clay mould is a resource that is created by combining three clay on a pottery wheel. It can be fired at a kiln to create a clay mould.
The recipe to make the unfired clay mould is unlocked upon first building a jeweler's bench.

items.name: Clay Slab
items.description: Unknown <small>([https://dragonwilds.runescape.wiki/w/Clay_Slab?action=edit edit])</small>
items.extract: A clay slab is an item that is not currently found in the game. An unfired clay slab exists in the cache, implying that the fired clay slab may come from the unfired version.

items.name: Clay Slab (Unfired)
items.description: Unknown <small>([https://dragonwilds.runescape.wiki/w/Clay_Slab_(Unfired)?action=edit edit])</small>
items.extract: A clay slab is an item that is currently not in the game.

items.name: Clay Vessel
items.description: This bowl is empty.
items.extract: Clay vessels can be created with clay vessel (unfired) at a kiln, and can be used at a brewing cauldron to hold potions.

items.name: Clay Vessel (Unfired)
items.description: A formed clay bowl, ready to be fired in a kiln.
items.extract: A clay vessel (unfired) can be created with clay at a pottery wheel. Can be fired using a kiln to make a clay vessel.

items.name: Clean Water
items.description: A source of hydration, free from the taint of natural water sources.
items.extract: Clean water is a consumable drink item that provides 25 hydration on drinking. It can be used to make infusions.

items.name: Cloying Damp Cowl
items.description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The cloying damp cowl is a vestige that unlocks the shadowscale hood.

items.name: Coal
items.description: Typically found in rocky areas and caves. Combine with metal ores at an upgraded smelter to create higher tiered metal bars.
items.extract: Coal is a basic Mining material mined from coal nodes, which can be found all over the Fellhollow, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands regions. It is used as a secondary ingredient for ores smelted in a blast furnace.

items.name: Coarse Animal Fur
items.description: It's not much, but it'll keep you warm. Required to craft a basic bed.
items.extract: Coarse animal fur is a basic item gathered from killing kebbits and rats. Players can also receive 1-2 furs from bird nests. Players who receive coarse animal fur in their inventory for the first time unlocks the creation of the bedroll.

items.name: Coarse Net
items.description: Made with two coarse threads at a crafting table. Rough but effective.
items.extract: The coarse net is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor.

items.name: Coarse Thread
items.description: Spun from flax at a Spinning Wheel.
items.extract: Coarse thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using either 1 flax or 3 coarse animal fur, either of which will create a single coarse thread.

items.name: Coarse Thread Bin
items.extract: A coarse thread bin is a decoration that is unlocked by creating coarse thread.

items.name: Coarse Thread Pile
items.extract: A coarse thread pile is a decoration that is unlocked by creating coarse thread.

items.name: Coclear Malificarum
items.description: A sealed scroll full of forbidden magics.
items.extract: Coclear Malificarum is a quest item obtained on the ground by Ulgo the zogre. It is slightly north-west of the chest, by the large bones. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. It is located in the north-east section of Coalridge Pass.

items.name: Coiled Desert Rope
items.extract: Coiled desert rope

items.name: Commemorative Coin
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The commemorative coin is a vestige that unlocks the recipe for the amulet of glory. It can be received as a drop by red dragon in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Community Cape
items.description: A symbol of dedication and support, this cape is granted to those who leave a lasting mark on the community.
items.extract: The community cape is a basic item having no special requirements, and can be created at a crafting table.

items.name: Compost Bin
items.extract:
A compost bin is a Farming object that players can create to turn unwanted items (burnt food, vegetables, and other acceptable items) into compost. It takes five seconds to convert a compostable item into compost. Once compost has been processed at the bottom of the bin, players must wield their compost bucket before interacting and filling it with compost.
Note that players cannot destroy their compost bin whilst there is compost stored inside.
Level 10 Farming is required to unlock the recipe.

items.name: Compost Bucket
items.description:
Contents: Compost: [X]/150

A wooden bucket used to carry a variety of compost. Pour its contents out over a Farming Plot to fertilize your plants!
items.extract:
The compost bucket is a tool created at the crafting table. Level 10 Farming is required to unlock the recipe. It can be used to take out compost and super compost from the compost bin and super compost bin, respectively, at a maximum of 150 units per bucket held in the inventory.
When used on a farming plot, 10 units of either compost or super compost will be used until a total of 50 units have been used to fully fertilize a plot.

items.name: Construction Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Construction is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Construction cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Construction. It can be crafted at the mystic forge.
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Cooking Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Cooking is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Cooking cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Cooking. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Cooking Range
items.extract:
The cooking range can be used to create more complex dishes than can be made on the campfire or grill. It functions like the stone range, but can craft a wider variety of recipes when unlocked at level 16 Cooking. It requires a roof above it to function.
NOTE: To learn the recipe (see it in the build menu), you MUST interact with the basic campfire at a certain cooking level, on top of having obtained all the materials required to build it.
See food for lists of perk-less, perk, and all other types of food and to compare their health, sustenance, and weight ratios.

items.name: Cooling Arcane Infusion
items.description: Puts the whiz in wizard.
items.extract: Cooling arcane infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Arcane Aligned and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of magic attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, anima-infused bark, and toadflax in a cooking range.

items.name: Cooling Evasive Infusion
items.description: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.
items.extract: Cooling evasive infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perks Evasion and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of dodging by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, shocking plant bulb, and snapdragon in a cooking range.

items.name: Cooling Ferocious Infusion
items.description: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.
items.extract: Cooling ferocious infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Ferocious Fighter and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of physical attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, dragon tooth, and toadflax in a cooking range.

items.name: Cooling Fleet-Footed Infusion
items.description: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.
items.extract: Cooling fleet-footed infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Fleet Footed and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of sprinting by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, onion, and snapdragon in a cooking range.

items.name: Cooling Relentless Infusion
items.description: A tasty tipple that'll put a quiver in your quiver.
items.extract: Cooling relentless infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration as well as the perks Relentless Ranger and Frosted Flavours, which reduces the stamina cost of ranged attacks by 33% and grants resistance to Scorch buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with cactus water, shrapnel, and toadflax in a cooking range.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Mined from copper deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
items.extract: Copper ore is a basic Mining material mined from copper ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Tin to produce bronze bars.

items.name: Corpse Cotton
items.description: Drops from a volatile bulbous plant that explodes when hit. Can be spun at the spinning wheel to create fine thread.
items.extract: Corpse cotton is a drop from zogres and corpse cotton plants which is used to create fine thread.

items.name: Corpse Cotton Seeds
items.description:
Corpse Cotton seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
items.extract: Corpse cotton seeds are a type of seed, used in the Farming skill. They can be used to grow Fellhollow's corpse cotton plants in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in willow farming plot. Planting the seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience Farming. Corpse cotton seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild corpse cotton plants.

items.name: Corroded Curved Blade
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it
items.extract: The corroded curved blade is a vestige that unlocks the keris weapon. This vestige can be found in a chest after the Kalphite Queen boss fight in the south-western vault found within Umbral Sands.

items.name: Corroded Jewellery
items.description: A sinister piece of jewellery, corroded and burned. Perhaps you can learn something from it.
items.extract: Corroded jewellery is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the unholy symbol. This vestige is given to the player after completing the quest, Wanted! in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Corroded White Visor
items.description: A battered helmet. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Corroded white visor is a vestige that unlocks the recipe for the white full helm.

items.name: Corrupted Essence Sample
items.description: A strange sickly essence, linked to the corruption in Dowdun Reach. It writhes as you look at it.
items.extract: A corrupted essence sample is a quest item dropped by corrupted ravens. Collecting one can start the Biohazard secondary quest, but after the quest, you can turn in ten of these to Putrilius for infernal fragments.

items.name: Crafting Table
items.extract: The crafting table can be used to create and repair tools, weapons, ammo, armour, and capes. It does not have any indoor/outdoor restrictions and can be placed without a foundation.

items.name: Crate
items.extract:
A crate is a tier 1 constructed object that does not have restrictions to build indoors/outdoors and does not require a foundation to build. The crate is the smallest storage container for up to 16 item slots. To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their crate and check the "Linked" checkbox in the crate interface. This will allow players to craft up to a 12-metre radius away from the crate.
Players can also lock their crate by opening the interface and checking the Private checkbox at the bottom.

items.name: Cross Slit Wall
items.extract: A cross slit wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Crucible Engram of Betrayal
items.description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.
items.extract: The crucible engram of betrayal is an item  that you can receive after  slaying several mini-bosses. The item is used to enter the Nightmare Crucible

items.name: Crucible Engram of Helplessness
items.description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.
items.extract: The crucible engram of helplessness is an item  that you can receive after  slaying several mini-bosses. The item is used to enter the Nightmare Crucible

items.name: Crucible Engram of Humiliation
items.description: A key to a specific Nightmare Crucible.
items.extract: The crucible engram of humiliation is an item  that you can receive after  slaying several mini-bosses. The item is used to enter the Nightmare Crucible

items.name: Crystal Bow
items.description: A powerful Shortbow fashioned from crystal of elven origin.
items.extract:
The crystal bow is a power level 3 masterwork shortbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Heartstrings quest. It can then be crafted at a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special attack is called Shattershot, costing 43 stamina and shoots an area-of-effect cone of arrows a short distance that deals one third of the weapon's base damage to every target hit. Each target hit is stuck with crystal needles that explode after a short time for a set 50 damage. More needles can be stacked before the previous set explodes. This special attack does not require arrows to fire and can penetrate solid objects.
This weapon fires slightly slower than other shortbows despite dealing very similar damage when at the same power level, even when compared to the undead ranger's bow which is supposed to have increased damage as its special effect. This weapon has the same durability as the other ascendable shortbows, which makes the wild scout's shortbow with its 10% faster draw speed the ideal choice of shortbow to ascend if not using shattershot.

It can be found within the Vekchenven Kara vault which is behind a waterfall within the Lake of Lost Souls region of Fellhollow. The curse fragment is at the end of the vault and can be obtained after defeating the zogre. items.name: Dorgeshuun Crossbow
items.description: The signature weapon of the Dorgeshuun Goblin tribe. It fires Bone bolts and is surprisingly well made!
items.extract:
The dorgeshuun crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is obtained from the quest Even More Restless Ghosts. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is a hidden -25% Reload Duration, making it reload faster than other crossbows. It also can only fire bone bolts, which can similarly only be fired from this crossbow. Unlike other crossbows and bolts that split the damage between them, all of it is on the crossbow. This is to ensure that the weapon ascends correctly, and isn't forced to use weaker bolts than other crossbows. The bone bolts additionally build bleed, and with three hits in a short time, deal 40 damage. This damage does not scale with power level.
Excluding the bleed damage from the bone bolts, this weapon has the same base damage, reload speed, and durability as the blurite crossbow at similar power levels. With that in mind, the choice comes down to what bolts are desired, particularly enchanted bolts, as the difference is entirely down to their effects. The shadow crossbow is a notable mention as it can squeeze more damage out of enchanted bolts with +15% weakpoint damage, but it does so far slower than this or the blurite crossbow.

items.name: Draconic Staff
items.description: An ancient dragonkin staff used by the mages of old.
items.extract:
The draconic staff is a power level 4 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the parts of a sinister-looking staff, which can be found in a chest on the western wall outside of Skeklac Kara, the dragonkin vault in Ashien's Watch. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is +15% critical strike chance which equates to an average 1.0375x damage increase, but it also has -15% durability. Unlike the dragonbone dagger, this weapon does have reduced durability compared to the blightwood battlestaff (its comparable weapon) which has 1300 to this weapon's 1100.
However, when compared to the staff of light and necromancer's staff at equivalent power levels, it always has a 0.4 - 0.5 lower rune damage multiplier. In order for the increased chance to crit to have a higher average damage increase, the rune multipliers would need to increase to higher than 12 while maintaining the 0.4 - 0.5 difference (in other words, this staff would need a rune multiplier of 12.3 and +15% critical strike chance to have the same average damage as the necromancer staff if it had a rune multiplier of 12.8).

items.name: Dragonblight Shield
items.description: The Spirit of Velgar lives on within this shield, corrupting your enemies.
items.extract:
The dragonblight shield is a power level 4 masterwork shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a noxious draconic visage from the Dragon Slayer reward pack by completing Dragon Slayer or from turning in Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man afterwards. One of the required materials is an anti-dragon shield and one is included in the reward pack. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect causes a cloud of poison to appear after a parry that only affects enemies. The damage per tick is based on the power level of the shield, dealing 4 damage per tick at power level 4, 5 at power level 5, and 6 at power level 6 and 7, and 7 at power level 8. This damage ticks 15 times, once per second, and the effect has an internal cooldown of 20 seconds. This damage does not interrupt a stagger caused by a parry. Despite not being listed, this shield also has Dragon Breath Resistance, the special effect of the anti-dragon shield, which provides the ability to block dragon fire.
Venomous Trapper (the upgrade for Snare) is available at any time—once unlocked—for a few runes, and can also hold enemies in place, with only a 60 second cooldown. It applies the highest 6 damage per tick poison damage that the power level 6 and 7 shield do, and they do not stack. Neither stack with poisoned arrows or with weapon poison applied to a melee weapon, so this shield is in competition with a variety of other, more readily available sources of poison. It is, however, free, with the shorter cooldown when compared to Snare, and most notably does not interfere with staggers caused by parries, allowing the player to either riposte that target, deal with other targets, or make space.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * VELGAR'S VENGEANCE PARRYING releases a BURST OF POISON that inflicts POISON build up on NEARBY enemies. * DRAGON BREATH RESISTANCE BLOCKING prevents incoming DRAGON BREATH DAMAGE

items.name: Dragonbone Dagger
items.description: A ferocious blade, filled with primal draconic rage.
items.extract:
The dragonbone dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe can be found in Chaktan Kara, the dragonkin vault in northwest Stormtouched Highlands. It can be ascended at the mystic forge with ascension cores.
Its special effect is +15% critical strike chance, which equates to an average 1.0375x damage increase. It also lists -15% durability, but it has the same amount of durability and does not deplete faster than the iron dagger. 
Although keris has 2 higher max hit at power level 7, this dagger when ascended has the same stats as the wolfbane dagger, and so when not attacking either kalphites or wolves, this is the ideal one-handed stabbing weapon to ascend.

items.name: Dragoncurse Shield
items.description: The spirit of Imaru lives on within this shield.
items.extract:
The dragoncurse shield is a power level 5 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Withering Heights reward pack by completing Withering Heights. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining an undead draconic visage from the same pack or from turning in Imaru's head to Death afterwards, although it will require another anti-dragon shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect causes a spectral dragon claw to rise from the ground and deal 25 damage to and pull enemies slightly away from the player. Unlike the dragonblight shield, the effect does not scale with power level. It has a 20 second internal cooldown. This damage will interrupt a stagger caused by a parry. Despite not being listed, this shield also has Dragon Breath Resistance, the special effect of the anti-dragon shield, which provides the ability to block dragon fire.
As long as the target is not immune to poison (like green dragons) and poison is not being applied from another source (like Venomous Trapper, poisoned arrows, or weapon poison), then the dragonblight shield's effect is better because the damage scales with power level, dealing more total damage over time, and it doesn't interrupt staggers. That being said, fallen hoplite's aspis will also have more block value and toktz-ket-xil will have increased melee crit damage after a parry, but reduced block value.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * IMARU'S RETRIBUTION PARRYING sends a GHOSTLY CLAW forwards and DAMAGES enemies * DRAGON BREATH RESISTANCE BLOCKING prevents incoming DRAGON BREATH DAMAGE

items.name: Dragonfire Shield
items.description: A shield forged in the wake of Fuzan's fall. Its scales still glow with a smoldering heat, as though the dragon's fury refuses to fade.
items.extract:
The dragonfire shield is a power level 7 masterwork shield that is obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack by completing Icthlarin's Little Helper. It can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a smouldering draconic visage from the same pack or from turning in Fuzan's head to Icthlarin afterwards, although it will require yet another anti-dragon shield. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect launches a burst of lava forwards on a parry, dealing 25 damage and causes Burning on nearby enemies, which deals 11 damage per second for 5 seconds for a total of 55 Burning damage. This effect does not have a cooldown. This damage will interrupt a stagger caused by a parry. 
This shield has an excellent synergy with the fire cape, which restores stamina when defeating Burning targets with melee attacks. Unfortunately, the fire cape and Enchant Weapon: Fire are just as good at causing Burning damage. Fire magic and fire arrows are also a common source of damage in a multiplayer setting that wouldn't stack, not to mention several enemies are resistant to Burning (like the knights and mages of Dowdun Reach) or immune to fire completely (like the KotHaar). The toktz-ket-xil's increased melee damage after a parry (which does not interrupt a stagger) may still be more valuable.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * FUZAN'S FURY PARRYING launches a BURST OF LAVA that detonates on impact, dealing DAMAGE and inflicting BURNING build up * DRAGON BREATH RESISTANCE BLOCKING prevents incoming DRAGON BREATH DAMAGE
