items.description: A rare and precious gem, coveted by jewelers.
items.extract: Dragonstone is a gemstone obtained from mining adamant and runite ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

items.name: Dragonwolf Hide
items.description: Dropped from felled draconic beasts. Can be processed at the tannery.
items.extract: Dragonwolf hide is a drop from dragon wolves and Doric's smithing supplies. Dragonwolf hide is used to make draconic leather at the tannery.

items.name: Dried Cadavaberries
items.description: Probably not poisonous. A neat little snack.
items.extract: Dried cadavaberries are a power level 4 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten, and can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Dried Dwellberries
items.description: Sweet and chewy, a great fruity snack.
items.extract: Dried dwellberries are a power level 3 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten, and can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Dried Giant Krill
items.description: Krills hunger with one bite. Grants the Sea Legs perk.
items.extract: Dried giant krill is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Legs, which makes you immune to the slowing effects of water for 300 seconds. It is made by cooking raw giant krill on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in stir-fry and stuffed catfish.

items.name: Dried Peach
items.description: A tasty dried fruit.
items.extract: Dried peaches are a power level 1 food item made by cooking a peach at a campfire or grill. They provide 25 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

items.name: Dried Redberries
items.description: A little sour, but a tasty snack.
items.extract: Dried redberries are a power level 1 food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or a grill. Dried redberries provide 15 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

items.name: Dried Tea Leaves
items.extract: Dried tea leaves is a basic item processed from tea leaves at the kiln. It is used to make ground tea leaves at the grindstone.

items.name: Druid's Bandosian Amulet
items.description: A goblin artefact, found on a druid.
items.extract: Druid's Bandosian amulet is a quest item for Goblin Diplomacy. It is one of two amulets; the other amulet is found in a reliquary at Bramblemead ruins.

items.name: Dual Tall Slit Wall
items.extract: A dual tall slit wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Dubious Meat Pie
items.description: Pastry makes everything better.
items.extract: Dubious meat pie is a consumable food item that provides 50 health, 100 Sustenance, and 20 Soulscourge as well as the perks Ravenous and Steadfast Stomach, which drain thirst and hunger 20% faster and grant resistance to Wither effects for 300 seconds. It is made with roast pumpkin, cauterised undead steak, and bread in a cooking range.

items.name: Dust-covered Sketchbook
items.description: A ruined notebook, buried beneath the soil.
items.extract:
The dust-covered sketchbook is a quest item that is found at Coalridge Pass, south-east of the ridge of the map. To access this sketchbook, players will need to avoid two skeleton monsters (one skeletal hoplite and one skeletal warrior) from attacking them outside the entrance. The entrance has a nearby rune essence geyser with ruined pillars and beams, and contains several coal nodes.
Once players have entered the cave with the coal, iron, and granite nodes, they will need to turn left and either cast Rocksplosion or mine away the granite deposits on top of the iron ore node and interact with the old book.

items.name: Dusty Black Pocket
items.description: The remnants of Zamorakian chaps. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The dusty black pocket is a vestige that unlocks the shadow chaps. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

items.name: Dwellberries
items.description: Some rather pretty blue berries.
items.extract: Dwellberries are a consumable food item that provides 10 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 3 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried dwellberries starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt dwellberries at level 41. They can also be used to make dwellberry infusion, feathered lure, as well as some potions, a decoration, and weapons. They can be collected from dwellberry bushes in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands, Farmed from dwellberries (Farming) grown from dwellberry seeds, and found in chests in Ghornfell.

items.name: Dwellberry Crunchies
items.description: Yum... smells fruity.
items.extract: Dwellberry crunchies are a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 40 sustenance. They are made with dried dwellberries and wheat in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Dwellberry Crunchies (Removed)
items.description: Yum... smells fruity.
items.extract: Dwellberry crunchies are a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining dwellberries and either cabbages or potatoes at a cooking pot. When consumed they provide moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry crunchies.

items.name: Dwellberry Glazed Roast Flank
items.description:
A delicious flank steak, covered in a fruity dwellbery[sic] glaze.
Mouthwateringly tasty!
items.extract: Dwellberry glazed roast flank is a consumable food item that can be cooked by combining dwellberries with raw bestial meat at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry glazed roast flank.

items.name: Dwellberry Glazed Roast Meat
items.description: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a deliciously fruity dwellberry glazing. Scrumptious!
items.extract: Dwellberry glazed roast meat is a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining dwellberries with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot. Eating the dish provides moderate sustenance (30) and a small amount of lifeward (5) when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making dwellberry glazed roast meat.

items.name: Dwellberry Infusion
items.description: A refreshing, fruity drink. Good for hydration.
items.extract: Dwellberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with clean water and dwellberries in a stone range or cooking range. However, a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Dwellberry Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A dwellberry infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a dwellberry infusion.

items.name: Dwellberry Seeds
items.description:
A dwellberry seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Dwellberry seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Dwellberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild dwellberry bushes.

items.name: Earth Rune
items.description: A symbol of the earth's might, essential for earth-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die
items.extract:
Earth runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 15 Runecrafting or higher. Spells that use this rune orient around manipulating the earth and minerals, such as Mucksplosion and Divine Rock.
From the Community Campfire with Mod Pointy, there is active development on casting spells with earth runes.

items.name: Earth Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Earth rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received an earth rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Ectoplasm
items.description: Dropped from aggressive spirits or extracted from wither hearts. Used in crafting.
items.extract: Ectoplasm is a basic material dropped by Spirits such as lost souls or acquired by processing one withered heart in a kiln for a yield of three. It may be beneficial for players to kill lost souls instead of rotsworn enemies because the beginning stages of being Soul Rifted include power level 2 lost souls spawning instead of power level 5 rotsworn skeletons, making it easier to receive ectoplasm. If going this route, quickly escape out of the soul rift by being near a Purification Pool whilst in the soul rift process.

items.name: Egg
items.description: A nutritious ingredient.
items.extract: Eggs are a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fried egg starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt egg at level 12. They can also be used to make Victoria sponge cake. They are found in bird nests from trees, dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and from terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Eggs Royale
items.description: Made by combining fried egg and fried salmon. Grants the Sea Life perk.
items.extract: Eggs royale is a consumable food item that provides 120 health and 30 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 900 seconds. It is made with fried egg and fried salmon in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Elder Curiosities
items.description: Obsidian curiosities that feel pleasing in the hand. Can be ground and smelted into pure obsidian.
items.extract: Elder curiosities is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

items.name: Elongated Obsidian Construct
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The Elongated Obsidian Construct is a vestige that unlocks the Toktz-Mej-Tal. It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Hur and KotHaar-Xil in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Emerald
items.extract: Emeralds are a gemstone. They currently cannot be legitimately obtained.

items.name: Empty Vial
items.description: Apparently this will collect lightning if you get struck by it.
items.extract: Empty Vial is a quest item that is obtained by Doctor Fenkenstrain in The Great Body Robbery. Players will need to be struck by lightning with this in their inventory to convert it into a lightning-in-a-bottle.

items.name: Enchanted Adamant Bolt
items.description: Adamant bolts infused with sanguine energy and a ruby tip. Drains some of the archers health to increase the bolts damage.
items.extract: The Enchanted Adamant Bolt is a power level 7 bolt crafted at a Fletching Bench. It has a 15% chance to drain 15% of the user's current health and increase critical hit damage by 40% for that shot on a successful hit. If the special effect activates on a missed shot, the user's health is not drained, but it is still drained on non-critical hits.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Blurite Bolts
items.description: Blurite crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted Jade, that have a chance of dealing Earth magic damage and knocking your target down.
items.extract: Enchanted blurite bolts are an upgradeable version of blurite bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. Upon creation, there is a 15% chance of the stack of bolts being enchanted with 10% earth magic damage.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Bronze Bolts
items.description: Bronze crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted opal. These have a chance to summon a lightning strike around your target, dealing Air Magic Damage to all nearby enemies.
items.extract:
Enchanted bronze bolts are an upgradeable version of bronze bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. 
The bolts have a 15% chance to trigger a lightning explosion around a target. This lightning explosion deals 10 air magic damage to enemies within a 4.5 meter radius and applies the Shocked debuff.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Iron Bolts
items.description: Iron crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted Jade, that have a chance of dealing Water magic damage and slowing your target.
items.extract: Enchanted iron bolts are an upgradeable version of iron bolts unlocked at level 35 Ranged. After creation, there is a 15% chance of one of the bolts being enchanted with 10% water magic damage.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Mithril Bolts
items.description: These crossbow bolts offer a chance to create a toxic burst, poisoning all nearby enemies.
items.extract: Enchanted mithril bolts are a power level 6 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench that has a 15% chance to create a toxic burst, poisoning all nearby enemies within a 4-5 meter radius.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Rune Bolt
items.description: Rune bolts infused with magical energy and a diamond tip. Their targets rarely appreciate the distinction. Has a chance to pierce through several enemies at once.
items.extract: Enchanted rune bolts are a power level 8 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench. It has a 15% chance to increase critical hit damage by 20% for that shot on a successful hit. When the special effect activates, the shot also pierces enemies. Despite being power level 8, these bolts deal the same base damage as Enchanted Adamant Bolts.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Enchanted Steel Bolts
items.description: Steel crossbow bolts tipped with enchanted red topaz. Has a chance to create a necrotic bolt that heals you for a porportion of the damage dealt.
items.extract: Enchanted steel bolts are a power level 5 ammunition that has a 15% chance to heal 20% of the player's health when struck at an enemy.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the ability to craft Enchanted Crossbow Bolts. Enchanted bolts have a chance of triggering unique magical effects when being fired!

items.name: Evasive Infusion
items.description: A thirst-quenching drink that improves your reflexes.
items.extract: Evasive infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Evasion, which reduces the stamina cost of dodging by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water and small animal fang in a stone range or a cooking range. However, a player must first interact with a stone range to learn the recipe.

items.name: Evasive Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: An evasive infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating an evasive infusion.

items.name: Eventide - A New Spawn
items.description: A sealed scroll full of the worst things imaginable.
items.extract: Eventide - A New Spawn is a quest item obtained on the desk in the ruins by Razlem, the Deranged. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. The scroll located in the very south-eastern part of Silverthorn Keep.

items.name: Extinguished Blue Remnants
items.description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].
items.extract: The extinguished blue remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the blue torch recipe.

items.name: Extinguished Green Remnants
items.description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].
items.extract: The extinguished green remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the green torch recipe.

items.name: Extinguished Purple Remnants
items.description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].
items.extract: The extinguished purple remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the purple torch recipe.

items.name: Extinguished Red Remnants
items.description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].
items.extract: The extinguished red remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the red torch recipe.

items.name: Extinguished Yellow Remnants
items.description: A long extinguished torch with unique charactersitics[sic].
items.extract: The extinguished yellow remnants is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Brynmoor and Ghornfell. There is a 2/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the yellow torch recipe.

items.name: Fabric That Hums With You
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian mage hood. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The fabric that hums with you is a vestige that unlocks the Zamorak hood. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

items.name: Fallen Hoplite's Aspis
items.description: The shield of an Undead Hoplite.
items.extract:
The fallen hoplite's aspis is a power level 5 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after obtaining a sundering spiked slab as a rare drop (5/100) from a skeletal hoplite. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is that it has 3 higher block value at every power level compared to most other shields. Block value directly reduces damage taken from attacks linearly, i.e. if you have more block value than an attack deals, you will lose no health, your armour will be unaffected, and the stamina cost to block an attack will be low, lower than dodging that same attack.
This has to be compared with the effects provided by the other shields though, for example this shield will be unable to block dragon fire like the anti-dragon shield, dragonblight shield, and dragoncurse shield (but not the dragonfire shield). This shield also does not an offensive benefit like those shield's parry effects or the toktz-ket-xil's bonus melee crit damage, although that shield in particular has 6 less block than other shields.

items.name: Fallen Hoplite's Chest
items.description: Melee chest armour once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.
items.extract:
Fallen hoplite's chest is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is a reward from Kalistrakthen Kara, a dragonkin vault. It can be obtained by interactng with a dragonkin effigy within the vault. The dragonkin effigy can be found behind a breakable wall, near the two diamond door with a distinct circular cracked pattern. It has the exact same combat stats and durability as steel platebody and white platebody, making them functionally identical.

items.name: Fallen Hoplite's Helm
items.description: A Melee helmet once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.
items.extract:
Fallen Hoplite's Helm is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is a reward from Vekchenven Kara, a dragonkin vault. It can be obtained by interacting with a dragonkin effigy within the vault. The Effigy can be found up a path revealed (while soulrifted) above the spectral door in the room you jump down into after the fight with the rotsworn necromancer.

items.name: Fallen Hoplite's Tassets
items.description: Melee leg armour once belonging to a long dead Saradomin Hoplite.
items.extract:
Fallen hoplite's tassets are a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is a reward from Skekven Kara, a dragonkin vault. It can be obtained by interacting with a dragonkin effigy within the vault, which can be found up the stairs in the main room then Windstep to the north-Western platforms.

items.name: Fancy Rug
items.extract: A fancy rug is a decoration that is unlocked after crafting rough cloth for the first time.

items.name: Fang Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
items.extract: Fang arrows are power level 2 ammunition crafted at a Crafting Table.

items.name: Fang Barbed Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
items.extract:
Fang barbed arrows are fang arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a Bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows. There are no additional bonuses at this time. 
Note: fang barbed arrows are currently not craftable in either regular or Creative Mode worlds, making them unobtainable.

items.name: Fang Fire Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips carved from animal fangs.
items.extract: Fang fire arrows are fang arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by the fang fire arrow will not be inflicted with the Burning debuff, but higher-tier arrows will have a higher chance of doing so. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

items.name: Farmer's Hat
items.description: A delightful piece of headwear, popular with those who toil the land.
items.extract: Farmer's hat is a power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is a reward from scarecrow scavenging.

items.name: Farming Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Farming is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Farming cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Farming. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Feather Bait
items.description: What is it about feathers that fascinates a fish? A great way to bait them. Trout seems the most susceptible. increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Feather bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching trout. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Feathered Lure
items.description: Entice Salmon with a knotted ball of bird knock-offs. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Feathered lures are a power level 3 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching salmon. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Feathers
items.description: Gathered from avian creatures and nests. Feathers are used to fletch arrows.
items.extract: Feathers are obtained by killing birds, such as chickens and terrorbirds, and used to fletch arrows.

items.name: Fellhollow Arena Tapestry
items.extract: Fellhollow Arena Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Fellhollow Cape
items.description: A cloak depicting the ethereal beauty of Fellhollow.
items.extract: The Fellhollow cape is a craftable armour piece.  The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Fell Cape Pattern, found in a chest buried under a pile of Rocks along the spine of the dragon skeleton, south of Imaru's Tower.

items.name: Fellhollow Spectral Magpie Perch
items.extract: Fellhollow Spectral Magpie Perch is a decoration.

items.name: Fence
items.extract: Fence are defensive structures that are built to protect a player-built structure.

items.name: Ferocious Infusion
items.description: A hydrating drink infused with primal fury.
items.extract: Ferocious infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Ferocious Fighter, which reduces the stamina cost of physical attacks by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, animal bone, and harralander in a stone range or cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Teamonger at level 14 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Ferocious Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A ferocious infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a ferocious infusion.

items.name: Fibrous Pipe Cactus
items.description: A complex network of fibres and water reservoirs. Can be tanned to produce a durable material.
items.extract: Fibrous pipe cactus can be found west of the Moon Garou tribe near a grove of yew trees, and can be used to make 3 cactus fibres in a tannery.

items.name: Fillet
items.description: Roasted bird meat. Tastes like everything tastes.
items.extract: A fillet is a power level 1 food item that provides 20 sustenance and 20 health when eaten. It can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Fine Cloth
items.description: Woven from fine thread and gold. Used in weapon and armour crafting.
items.extract: Fine cloth is created with a loom with a Loom Harness next to it, requiring three fine thread. Fine cloth is used primarily for power level 5 armour.

items.name: Fine Net
items.description: Made with two fine threads at a crafting table. An elegant little net.
items.extract: The fine net is a power level 5 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

items.name: Fine Thread
items.description: Made from spun corpse cotton. Can be used as a bow string and in stitching weapons and gear.
items.extract: Fine thread is a material item created at a spinning wheel. It can be crafted using 4 corpse cotton, creating a single fine thread.

items.name: Fire Cape
items.description: Receiving or blocking damage has a chance to triggering burning on your attacker. Melee kills on Burning enemies refill stamina.
items.extract:
The fire cape is a cape awarded after beating the Fight Cave activity. It is the only cape in the game that is dropped by a boss monster. When worn by the player it gives the Burning Endurance effect.
The cape previously required an ember-edged remnant of cloth vestige.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * '''Burning Endurance''' Receiving or blocking DAMAGE has a chance to triggering BURNING on your attacker. Melee KILLS on BURNING enemies refill STAMINA.

items.name: Fire Oil
items.description:
Flammable and volatile, handle with care!

Used to craft Fire arrows.
items.extract: Fire oil is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use fire oil to create fire arrows. Note that adding fire oil to arrows will change the damage property of the arrow from Ranged damage to Fire Magic damage and will apply a 60% burn buildup.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Fire Rune
items.description:
Equippable as ammo when using a magic weapon (provided the required skill perk is unlocked).

A symbol of blazing heat, essential for fire-based magic. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract: Fire runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 25 Runecrafting or higher, and can deal between 6-10 base damage, along with whatever staves the player equips. Fire runes are used in spells such as Rocksplosion, Superheat, and Fire Spirit.

items.name: Fire Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Fire rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received a fire rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Fish Fry
items.description: Made by combining roasted lobster, braised undead eel and fried cabbage.
items.extract: Fish fry is a consumable food item that provides 180 health and 55 sustenance. It is made with fried cabbage, braised undead eel, and roasted lobster in a cooking range.

items.name: Fishing Barrel
items.extract: The fishing barrel is a storage container that can hold up to 48 raw fish. It becomes available once players reach level 34 in the Fishing skill.

items.name: Fishing Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Fishing is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Fishing cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Fishing. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Flank Steak
items.description: A thick and juicy steak.
items.extract: Flank steak is a power level 3 food item that provides 25 sustenance, 30 health, as well as the perk Coagulated, which reduces Bleed buildup for 150 seconds. It can be cooked from raw bestial meat at either a campfire or a grill, and is used in roast dinner, meat pizza, meat sandwich, meat twist sandwich, and steak sandwich.

items.name: Flax
items.description: Harvested from flax plants, essential for crafting linen and bowstrings.
items.extract: Flax can be found by harvesting the flax plants in either Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, or Stormtouched Highlands. It can be used on the spinning wheel to create coarse thread. Collecting flax for the first time unlocks the creation of the spinning wheel and fletching bench.

items.name: Flax Seeds
items.description:
Flax seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract:
Flax seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Flax seeds can be used to grow flax (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in an ash farming plot. 
Planting flax seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Flax seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild flax plants.

items.name: Fleece
items.description: Raw sheepskin that can be processed into wool.
items.extract: Fleece is a basic material, gathered from killing rams and sheep.

items.name: Fleet-Footed Infusion
items.description: A thirst-quenching drink that puts a spring in your step.
items.extract: Fleet-footed infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Fleet Footed, which reduces the stamina cost of sprinting by 50% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water and feathers in a stone range or a cooking range. However, a player must first interact with a stone range to learn the recipe.

items.name: Fleet-Footed Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A fleet-footed infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a fleet-footed infusion.

items.name: Fletching Bench
items.extract: The fletching bench can be used to create and repair bows, crossbows, and ammo. it can be placed without a foundation but must have a roof to use. Players must receive a Bronze Bar in their inventory to unlock the fletching bench.

items.name: Focused Agility Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Agility

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Agility potion grants the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with avantoe, gold leaf, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Artisan Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Artisan II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
items.extract: Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with irit, necrotic bonemeal, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Attack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Attack II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Attack Skill
items.extract: Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with an irit, a small animal fang, and a glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Construction Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Construction II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Construction Skill
items.extract: Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made with irit, ground sandstone, and a glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Cooking Potion

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Farming Skill
items.extract: Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made with irit, undead bone, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Fishing Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Fishing II

Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.
items.extract: Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with irit, grilled trout, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Mining Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Mining II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Mining Skill
items.extract: Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made with irit, coarse animal fur, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Focused Runecrafting Potion

items.name: Focused Woodcutting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Woodcutting II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Woodcutting Skill
items.extract: Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting II, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +30% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made with irit, redberries, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Food & Drink Salvage
items.extract: Food & drink salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in the Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Forager's Sandwich
items.description: A hunger-reducing snack made with fried cabbages and grilled mushrooms.
items.extract: Forager's sandwich is a consumable food item that provides 70 health, 80 sustenance as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment and Fungal Fortitude, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10% and reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with fried cabbage, grilled mushrooms, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in the garrison in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Moon Goddess'
items.description: An ancient garou scroll describing some kind of moon deity. An archaeologist will want this.
items.extract: Forbidden Scroll - 'Moon Goddess' is a quest item that is obtained by digging up a mound with a piece of a scroll sticking up. Players will need to bring this to Lehran - The Archaeologist, along with the other three scrolls to complete The Dig Site subquest part of Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Old Kingdom'
items.description: An ancient garou scroll describing old Moon Garou kingdom. An archaeologist will want this.
items.extract: Forbidden Scroll - 'Old Kingdom' is a quest item that is obtained by digging up a mound with a piece of a scroll sticking up. Players will need to bring this to Lehran - The Archaeologist, along with the other three scrolls to complete The Dig Site subquest part of Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll - 'Sun Demon'
items.description: An ancient garou scroll describing a cruel, sun-themed demoness. An archaeologist will want this.
items.extract: Forbidden Scroll - 'Sun Demon' is a quest item that is obtained by digging up a mound with a piece of a scroll sticking up. Players will need to bring this to Lehran - The Archaeologist, along with the other three scrolls to complete The Dig Site subquest part of Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Forbidden Scroll - 'The Schism'
items.description: An ancient Moon Garou scroll describing the schism that separated the garou. An archaeologist will want this.
items.extract: Forbidden Scroll - 'The Schism' is a quest item that is obtained by digging up a mound with a piece of a scroll sticking up. Players will need to bring this to Lehran - The Archaeologist, along with the other three scrolls to complete The Dig Site subquest part of Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Fortifying Crunchies
items.description:
PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)
Grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects
It actually smells quite good.
items.extract: Fortifying crunchies are a consumable food item that provide moderate sustenance. It also gives the player the Fungal Fortitude perk, which grants resistance to Poison effects for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying crunchies.

items.name: Fortifying Soup
items.description:
PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)

A warm vegetable soup, with added mushrooms.

Grants RESISTENCE[sic] to POISON effects
items.extract: Fortifying soup is a consumable food item that provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten. It also provides the player with the Fungal Fortitude perk, which grants resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying soup.

items.name: Fortifying Stew
items.description:
PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)

Grants RESISTENCE[sic] to POISON effects

A warm meat and mushroom stew, fortifies you against the trials ahead.
items.extract: Fortifying stew is a stew that can be crafted by combining bittercap mushrooms with any raw meat at a cooking pot. When consumed, it provides moderate sustenance, 5 lifeward, and gives the Fungal Fortitude perk, granting resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making fortifying stew.

items.name: Fractured Cape
items.description: A cloak warning against the danger of hubris.
items.extract: The fractured cape is a craftable armour piece.  The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the PATTERN: fractured cape, found in a chest at the north-north-east tip of the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Fractured Obsidian Construct
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The fractured obsidian construct is a vestige that unlocks the obsidian chest.

items.name: Fried Cabbage
items.description: Yum! Maybe I do like cabbage.
items.extract: Fried cabbage is a power level 1 food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or grill. Fried cabbages have 20 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

items.name: Fried Egg
items.description: Sunny side up.
items.extract: Fried eggs are a power level 1 food item made by cooking an egg at a campfire or grill. Fried eggs have 20 sustenance and 20 health when consumed.

items.name: Fried Onions
items.description: A pungent meal that brings a tear to your eye.
items.extract: Fried onions are a consumable food item that provide 20 sustenance as well as the perk, Grounded, which reduces the amount of shock damage taken for 150 seconds. They can be cooked from onion at either a campfire or a grill, and are used in squeaking sausage, wild pie, and steak sandwich.

items.name: Fried Salmon
items.description: For when you feel like a hungry bear. Grants the Sea Life perk.
items.extract: Fried salmon is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 20 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 300 seconds. It is made by cooking raw salmon on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in eggs royale.

items.name: Fried Sardine
items.description: Delicious little fishies. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]
items.extract: Fried sardine is a consumable food item that provides 30 health and 15 sustenance, as well as granting the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 180 seconds. It is made by cooking raw sardine on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in sauteed sardines and lesser Focused Fishing potion.

items.name: Fruit Pie
items.description: A fruit party, wrapped in golden pastry.
items.extract: Fruit pie is a consumable food item that provides 90 health and 85 sustenance. It is made with dried redberries, dried dwellberries, and bread in a cooking range. Cadavaberries are required to be held to unlock the recipe.

items.name: Fuel Briquette
items.description: Produced by burning wood in a kiln, charcoal is a very efficient fuel.
items.extract: Fuel briquettes are a type of fuel that can be used in any processing stations requiring a heat source. Fuel briquettes are currently not in the game and do not have a set recipe. However, the description suggests burning wood inside a kiln to yield fuel briquettes.

items.name: Fuel Pellet
items.description: A high-temperature fuel. Needed to smelt more advanced metals.
items.extract: Fuel pellet is a fuel source that can be created at a Blacksmith's Bench. It can be used in a blast furnace as fuel to create higher-tiered materials. Players must have coal in their inventory and build a blast furnace to unlock the fuel pellet. If the recipe has not unlocked with Coal in the inventory, mining Coal from a Coal Node may fix it.

items.name: Furnace
items.extract:
This page talks about the base furnace. If you want to see the one capable of smelting higher materials, please see blast furnace.
The furnace is a facility used to process ores into bars. It requires charcoal to operate, which can be obtained using the kiln. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it. In order for the furnace to function, it must not have a roof above it. Despite the description stating that it can also fire clay, it cannot do so at this time.
It can only be built once the player has unlocked the recipe by having tin or copper ore in their inventory.

items.name: Fuzan's Head
items.description: It's tempting to leave it out in the Scorch to give it a taste of its own medicine.
items.extract: Fuzan's head is a quest item obtained during Icthlarin's Little Helper after defeating Fuzan. Players will need to hand this to Icthlarin to complete the quest.

items.name: Garou Arms
items.description: A pair of well-preserved garou arms, the perfect gift for any mad scientist.
items.extract: Garou Arms are a quest item used in The Great Body Robbery, where it is required to create Doctor Fenkenstrain's creature.

items.name: Garou Artefact
items.description: An object of garou origin that might hold value with local traders.
items.extract: Garou artefact is an item found in Umbral Sands. It can be sold to the merchants Domri, Beartach and Iasadair for 500 garou chits. Garou artefact can also be used to craft Lunar Robes.

items.name: Garou Chit
items.description: A local currency favoured by garou traders.
items.extract: Garou chit are currency used by the Moon Garou in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Garou Drum
items.extract: The garou drum is a decoration that is unlocked after learning its recipe, PLAN: garou drum.

items.name: Garou Hanging Ornament 01
items.extract: Garou hanging ornament 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product.

items.name: Garou Hanging Ornament 02
items.extract: Garou hanging ornament 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product.

items.name: Garou Hanging Ornament 03
items.extract: Garou hanging ornament 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product.

items.name: Garou Hanging Ornament 04
items.extract: Garou hanging ornament 04 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near Fractured Plains or inside vaults. Hanging ornaments should be placed on the underside of the upper floors to show the built product.

items.name: Garou Highborn's Cloak
items.description: A cloak worn by garou nobility.
items.extract: The garou highborn's cloak is a unique cape given as a reward by Vannaka for completing the Dog Days quest. Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

items.name: Garou Pack
items.description: A brutal bag sewn from hide and sinew.
items.extract: A garou pack is dropped from killing garou berserkers, garou druids, garou hunters, garou thanes, and the Garou King.

items.name: Garou Stool
items.extract: The garou stool is a decoration that is unlocked after learning its recipe, PLAN: garou stool.

items.name: Garou Trophy 01
items.extract: Garou trophy 01 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Trophy 02
items.extract: Garou trophy 02 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests in Ghornfell or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Trophy 03
items.extract: Garou trophy 03 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Trophy 04
items.extract: Garou trophy 04 is created by first learning the blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Tusks 01
items.extract: Garou tusks 01 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Tusks 02
items.extract: Garou tusks 02 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Tusks 03
items.extract: Garou tusks 03 is created by first learning its blueprint, found in chests near the Fractured Plains, or inside vaults.

items.name: Garou Wall Banner
items.extract: The garou wall banner is a constructed Garou decoration that is unlocked by learning its recipe, PLAN: garou wall banner. Building it requires 4 rough cloth, creating a banner that is 2 metres long and 3.75 metres high, which must be placed on a flat vertical surface.

items.name: Garou Wall Pelt
items.extract: The garou wall pelt is a decoration that is unlocked after learning its recipe, PLAN: garou hanging pelt.

items.name: Garou Weave
items.description: A high quality material sold by local garou merchants.
items.extract: Garou weave can be bought from the merchants Iasadair, Beartach and Domri or found in chests in Umbral Sands and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

items.name: Ghornfell Caves Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Caves Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghornfell Forest Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Forest Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghornfell Highlands Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Highlands Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghornfell Meadows Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Meadows Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghornfell Toxic Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Toxic Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghornfell Water Tapestry
items.extract: Ghornfell Water Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Ghostspeak Amulet
items.description: An amulet you found in a well in Brynmoor.
items.extract: The ghostspeak amulet is a quest item that is required to speak with the restless spirits that appear around the map during the night, during the quest, Restless Ghosts. The amulet can be found by interacting with a crumbling well in the ruins of the town of Brynmoor in Bramblemead Valley, near where the Wise Old Man can be found.

items.name: Giant Krill Bait
items.description: If I told you why this bait works, I'd have to krill you. Infernal Eels look alive! Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Giant krill bait is a power level 6 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching infernal eels. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Gilded Gyrhawk Amulet
items.description: While wearing this amulet, Warped Feathers are consumed to award additional XP while exploring the world. Additionally increases the amount of experience gained from courses.
items.extract:
The gilded gyrhawk amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench after obtaining gold record times on all available Agility courses. While equipped, the amulet grants +100% Agility experience when walking or sprinting by consuming warped feathers in the player's inventory, while also providing +25% Agility experience when training on Agility courses.
This item, thus far, is the only trinket in the game with an Agility level requirement to wear and craft at level 65 Agility.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: +25% Increased AGILITY XP from Agility Courses.

items.name: Gilded Paladin Cape
items.description: A magnificent cape trimmed in gold, worn by those who wish to stand apart from the crowd.
items.extract:
The Gilded Paladin Cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft and can be crafted at the Crafting Table and the Mystic Forge
The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Gilded Paladin Chestpiece
items.description: An ornate golden chestpiece that serves as a symbol of power, status, and confidence.
items.extract:
The gilded paladin chestpiece is a power level 4 melee armour piece that can be crafted with an armour bench.
The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Gilded Paladin Helmet
items.description: Polished to a brilliant shine, this helmet is as impressive as it is eye-catching.
items.extract:
The gilded paladin helmet is a power level 4 melee armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.
The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Gilded Paladin Legs
items.description: Golden platelegs for warriors who believe protection should be seen from a distance.
items.extract:
The gilded paladin legs is a power level 4 melee armour piece that can be crafted with an armour bench. 
The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Glass Decoration
items.description: A delightful ornament that will really tie your home together.
items.extract: A glass decoration is an item that can be crafted using molten glass at the jeweler's bench.

items.name: Glass Owl
items.description: A handcrafted owl made of glass. It seems to have great sentimental value to someone.
items.extract: The glass owl is an item used in the Black Knight's Fortress quest. The glass owl is obtained by digging the grave west of the blue dragon spawn in the west of the Library region.

items.name: Glass Pane
items.description: It's transparent that you're going to use this when building.
items.extract: Glass panes can be created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and can be used for construction.

items.name: Glass Vessel
items.description: A glass item made by glassblowing.
items.extract: Glass vessels can be created with molten glass at a jeweler's bench, and can be used for various recipes.

items.name: Glazed Pumpkin Sandwich
items.description: A warming dish made with roast pumpkin, maple syrup and dried redberry.
items.extract: Glazed pumpkin sandwich is a consumable food item that provides 80 health and 100 sustenance as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment, Foreman's Feast, and Soul Food, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10%, reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33%, and restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 600 seconds. It is made with dried redberries, roast pumpkin, maple syrup, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe on a table in the hall nearby Zanik in the Dowdun Reach underground.

items.name: Goblin "Swingslash"
items.description: A surprisingly nasty little axe. Popular with goblin warriors.
items.extract:
The goblin "Swingslash" is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming a cruel goblin blade, received as a random drop from a goblin pack; the drop chance for this vestige is 2%.
Despite having slash in the name, this weapon deals crush damage and uses the mace attack style. It has slightly higher base damage but the same durability as the bone club, despite listing a special effect of -15% durability.
It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores, but the base damage doesn't scale properly: the power level 2 goblin "swingslash" has 11-12% higher base damage than the power level 2 bone club's 26 - 46, but the power level 7 goblin "swingslash" only has ~1% higher base damage than the power level 7 adamant mace's 114 - 202).

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * CLUB COMBO attacks that deal SLASH DAMAGE, with increased DAMAGE * Reduced DURABILITY

items.name: Goblin Legs
items.description: A pair of worryingly fresh goblin legs. Doctor Fenkenstrain will be interested in these.
items.extract: Goblin legs are a quest item used in The Great Body Robbery, where it is required to create Doctor Fenkenstrain's creature.

items.name: Goblin Pack
items.description: A cloth shoulder bag, grimy and poorly kept.
items.extract: A goblin pack is dropped from killing goblin warriors, goblin archers, goblin runts, and goblin bruisers.

items.name: Goblin War Banner
items.description: A cloak reminding us that even gods can be forgotten.
items.extract: The goblin war banner cape is a unique cape given as a reward by Zanik for completing the Goblin Diplomacy quest. Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.description: A precious metal found in the deepest parts of Ghornfell; used for crafting valuable items.
items.extract: A gold bar is a component of making a variety of armour. Gold bars are used for making dragonkin mage and wild archer armour.

items.name: Gold Bar (decoration)
items.extract: A gold bar is a decoration that requires one gold bar. The gold bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Gold Leaf
items.description: A thin sheet of brilliant gold, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into gold bars.
items.extract: Gold leaf is a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions, golden regional capes, and a gilded version of the gyrhawk amulet. To obtain these, players must either collect them from golden reward packs or recycle gold bars at the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

items.name: Gold Medal
items.extract: Gold medal is a decorative trophy that players can build once they have completed all available Agility courses at gold record times.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Mined from gold deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
items.extract: Gold ore is a basic Mining material mined from Gold Ore Nodes, which can be mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make gold bars.

items.name: Gold Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps that can be searched through. All that glitters may not be gold.
items.extract: Gold salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one gold bar.

items.name: Gourmand Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The gourmand ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Granite
items.description: A dense stone used for construction and crafting. Very commonly found underground, in mines and dungeons.
items.extract:
Granite is a basic Mining material that can be mined from granite deposits. 
Granite can be processed at a grindstone to create ground granite. Additionally, granite is a reagent for other items and buildings.

items.name: Granite Maul
items.description: The power of this warhammer should not be taken for granite.
items.extract:
The granite maul is a power level 3 two-handed melee weapon craftable after the quest Granite Mauled. It is classified as a masterwork weapon. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is that it hits harder but slower than other warhammers, and its special action is called Battering Ram, which will knock down most opponents. It has no effect on minibosses or bosses. Although it has a unique animation, other two-handed warhammers special actions also knock down most opponents.
Although this weapon has a different, very slightly slower attack style than other two-handed warhammers, it has a far higher damage range at every power level that makes it stand out when ascended: bronze warhammer (PL3, 52 - 82), iron warhammer (PL4, 76 - 119), steel warhammer (PL5, 100 - 157), mithril warhammer (PL6, 126 - 198), and adamant warhammer and tzhaar-ket-om (PL7, 156 - 244).

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * BATTERING RAM Deals heavy DAMAGE to the target and KNOCKS them DOWN * OVERKILL Uses a unique WARHAMMER COMBO that excels against SINGLE TARGETS * UNWIELDY Reduced ATTACK SPEED

items.name: Grated Floor
items.extract: A grated floor is a type of furniture that can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Grave 01
items.extract: Grave 01 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: grave 1 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Grave 02
items.extract: Grave 04 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: grave 2 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Grave 03
items.extract: Grave 03 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: grave 3 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Grave 04
items.extract: Grave 04 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: grave 4 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Greater Kalphite Wing
items.extract: Greater kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite guardians and kalphite queens that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

items.name: Green Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The green adventurer's cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Green Chandelier
items.extract: A green chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

items.name: Green Desert Cape
items.description: A Green cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The green desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the green memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Green Dragon Hide
items.description: Obtained from felled Lesser Green Dragons. Can be processed at the Tannery.
items.extract: Green dragon hide is a basic material dropped by green dragons which can be tanned to create green dragonhide leather.

items.name: Green Dragon Trophy
items.extract: The Green Dragon Trophy is a decoration that can be obtained through the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Green Dragonhide Body
items.description: Ranged body armour crafted from Green Dragonhide. Form-fitting yet intimidating.
items.extract:
Green dragonhide body is power level 5 ranged armour that can be created at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining green dragon hide.

items.name: Green Dragonhide Chaps
items.description: Agile Ranged leg armour crafted from Green Dragonhide.
items.extract:
Green dragonhide chaps is power level 5 ranged armour that can be created at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining green dragon hide.

items.name: Green Dragonhide Coif
items.description: Lightweight Ranger headgear crafted from Green Dragonhide for Ranged users.
items.extract:
Green dragonhide coif is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be created at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked upon obtaining green dragon hide.

items.name: Green Dragonhide Leather
items.description: Made by tanning Green Dragonhide. A key crafting component for armour.
items.extract: Green dragonhide leather is a Processed material created from tanning green dragon hide.

items.name: Green Dyad Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The green dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Green Hex Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The green hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Green Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The green memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the green desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Green Standing Torch
items.extract: Green standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green standing torch recipe.

items.name: Green Standing Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The green standing torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Fellhollow region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the green standing torch.

items.name: Green Torch
items.description: A trusty lightsource - now in green.
items.extract: The green torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished green remnants.

items.name: Green Wall-mounted Torch
items.extract: Green wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: green wall-mounted torch recipe.

items.name: Green Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The green wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Dowdun Reach region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the green wall-mounted torch.

items.name: Grieving Moonstaff
items.description: This staff is dedicated to Lougrim, the fallen Garou goddess of the Moon.
items.extract:
The grieving moonstaff is a power level 3 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying a mysterious crescent carving, which can be dropped by garou druids with a 2/100 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is -15% critical strike chance, which alongside its lower rune damage modifier at every power level, makes this the weakest staff to ascend.
For example, compare this to the draconic staff: That staff has +15% critical strike chance but has -15% durability to compensate. However, it has the same rune damage modifier as most other staffs at the same power level, while this staff has less, with no benefit to offset the reduced chance to crit.

items.name: Grill
items.extract: A grill can be built using 12 ash logs, 4 stone, 2 leather, and 6 fire runes after unlocking the Grill Master perk at 26 Cooking. It can be used to cook basic foods, but unlike the campfire, it does not require fuel to use. Cooking with a grill may result in burnt food, depending on the type of food and the player's Cooking level.

items.name: Grilled Mushrooms
items.description: A rich and earthy treat.
items.extract: Grilled mushrooms are a power level 2 food item that provide 20 sustenance, 20 health, and the perk Fungal Fortitude, which reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 150 seconds. They can be cooked from bittercap mushroom at either a campfire or a grill, and are used in pungent omelette, mushroom kebab, forager's sandwich, and steak sandwich.

items.name: Grilled Tomatoes
items.description: Fire really brings out the flavour.
items.extract: Grilled tomatoes are a power level 1 cooked food, made from tomatoes at either a grill or campfire. Players have a chance to burn the tomato, resulting in burnt tomatoes.

items.name: Grilled Trout
items.description: Stave off hunger with this tasty bite. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]
items.extract: Grilled trout is a consumable food item that provides 40 health and 15 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw trout on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in herb baked trout and Focused Fishing potion.

items.name: Grilled Undead Bass
items.description: Undead and makes you unhungry. Grants the Sea Life perk.
items.extract: Grilled undead bass is a consumable food item that provides 80 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 600 seconds. It is made by cooking raw undead bass on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in undead delight.

items.name: Grim Black Codpiece
items.description: The remnants of Zamorakian platelegs. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The grim black codpiece is a vestige that unlocks the Black Knight platelegs. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

items.name: Grindstone
items.extract:
The grindstone can be used to grind stone, sandstone, and granite. Both ground stone and sandstone are required to build power level 2 house parts. It processes very slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks, or to fill it just before sleeping, to process a whole stack of stone instantly. It must not have a roof above it to function. 
Note that players must receive granite in their inventory to unlock the grindstone.

items.name: Ground Clay
items.description: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.
items.extract: Ground clay is made by using clay on a grindstone. It is used to make lesser Focused Artisan potions.

items.name: Ground Dragon Tooth
items.description: The product of grinding dragon teeth. Essential for making draconic vis wax.
items.extract: Ground Dragon Tooth is a processed material created at a grindstone from dragon tooth and is used in the creation of Draconic Vis Wax.

items.name: Ground Granite
items.description: Pulverised stone, used in building and as an ingredient in herblore.
items.extract: Ground granite is created by putting granite in a grindstone. It is used in making attack potions.

items.name: Ground Gypsum
items.description: Ground from gypsum. This reagent seems to reflect light and therefore heat.
items.extract: Ground gypsum is created by putting a gypsum in a grindstone.

items.name: Ground Limestone
items.description: Fine limestone ground from limestone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Blast Furnace.
items.extract: Ground limestone is a processed material used to make molten glass in a blast furnace.

items.name: Ground Obsidian
items.description: An object of pure, refined obsidian.
items.extract: Ground obsidian is a basic item created by grounding elder curiosities or obsidian device in a grindstone.

items.name: Ground Rune Essence
items.description: Made by grinding rune essence. A component of black dragon leather.
items.extract: Ground Rune Essence is a processed material that is used to make a variety of power level 8 equipment.

items.name: Ground Sandstone
items.description: Fine sand ground from sandstone. With the proper tools, it can be made into glass in the Furnace.
items.extract: Ground sandstone is a processed material created at a grindstone from sandstone.

items.name: Ground Stone
items.description: Pulverised stone, used in building, and as an Herblore ingredient.
items.extract: Ground stone is created by putting a stone in a grindstone. Ground stone is used in tier 2 constructed items and will be used for herblore in future updates.

items.name: Ground Tea Leaves
items.extract: Ground tea leaves is a basic item processed from dried tea leaves at the grindstone. It is used to make strong tea and strong sweet tea at the cooking range.

items.name: Guthix Banner 01
items.extract: Guthix banner 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix banner 01.

items.name: Guthix Banner 02
items.extract: Guthix banner 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix banner 02.

items.name: Guthix Banner 03
items.extract: Guthix banner 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix banner 03.

items.name: Guthix Flag 01
items.extract: Guthix flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 01 found within Dowdun Reach or bought from Evil Emporium.

items.name: Guthix Flag 02
items.extract: Guthix flag 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 02.

items.name: Guthix Flag 03
items.extract: Guthix flag 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 03.

items.name: Guthix Flag 04
items.extract: Guthix flag 04 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 04.

items.name: Guthix Flag 05
items.extract: Guthix flag 05 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 05.

items.name: Guthix Flag 06
items.extract: Guthix flag 06 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Guthix flag 06.

items.name: Gypsum
items.description: A crumbly stone unsuitable for building but, once ground, offers unique properties.
items.extract: Gypsum is a basic Mining material mined from gypsum nodes, found scattered across the Umbral Sands.

items.name: Gypsum Wax
items.description: A marvel of alchemy that, once applied to equipment, adds durability in extreme conditions.
items.extract: Gypsum wax is one of the materials required for making power level 7 armour.

items.name: Gyrhawk Amulet
items.extract: The gyrhawk amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a crafting table. While equipped, the amulet grants +100% Agility experience when walking or sprinting but consumes warped feathers. To unlock the recipe, players must receive warped feathers in their inventory, found in reward packs after completing Agility courses. Note that wearing the gyrhawk amulet whilst completing an agility course will not use warped feathers.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: While wearing this amulet, Warped Feathers are consumed to award additional XP while exploring the world.

items.name: Half Wall
items.extract: A half wall is a constructed object that is half the length of a regular wall, measuring 2 metres long by 4 metres high.

items.name: Half Wall With Door Frame
items.extract: Half wall with door frame is a constructed object where players can place a door inside the frame.

items.name: Half Wall With Window Frame
items.extract: Half wall with window frame is a constructed object where players can place a window inside.

items.name: Hanging Tools
items.extract: Hanging tools is a constructed object decoration that is unlocked once the player has completed A Room With A Garou. Players cannot store any of their Farming or other tools on this object.

items.name: Hard Leather
items.description: Sturdy material for crafting durable armour.
items.extract: Hard leather is thicker and more resilient than normal leather. Players can create hard leather with two pieces of regular leather and one adhesive or four pieces of hard leather scraps in a tannery. Picking up the item grants 20 Artisan XP.

items.name: Hard Leather Body
items.description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather.
items.extract: Hard leather body is a power level 3 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Hard Leather Chaps
items.description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather.
items.extract: Hard leather chaps is a power level 3 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Hard Leather Cowl
items.description: A durable helmet crafted from hard leather.
items.extract: Hard leather cowl is a power level 3 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Hard Leather Scraps
items.description: Dropped from beasts in Fellhollow. Combined at the Tannery to create hard leather.
items.extract: Hard leather scraps are found by killing Zombie Cows and are used to create hard leather. Picking up the item grants 20 Artisan XP.

items.name: Hardy Weathered Shell
items.description: You can feel it pulling away from you. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The hardy weathered shell is a consumable item that unlocks the creation of the amulet of defence.

items.name: Harmonised Compound
items.description: Made from discordant residue in a kiln. Can be combined with runic powder on an advanced spinning wheel.
items.extract: Harmonised Compound is a processed material created at a kiln from discordant residue.

items.name: Harralander
items.description: A fragrant herb used in restorative potions.
items.extract: Harralander is a herb that is harvested from Harralander plants, found primarily in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

items.name: Harralander Seeds
items.description:
Harralander seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract: Harralander seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill.

items.name: Haunch
items.description: Roasted game meat. Tender and tasty.
items.extract: Haunch is a consumable food item that can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Headstone 01
items.extract: Headstone 01 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: headstone 01 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Headstone 02
items.extract: Headstone 02 is a decoration unlocked by reading PLAN: headstone 02 which is found in a spectral chest in Fellhollow.

items.name: Healing Potion
items.description: Recovers some lost health. Made with irit and redberries.
items.extract: Healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 80 health points upon consumption. It is made with irit, 2 dwellberries, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Hearty Crunchies
items.description: Yum! Smells delicious!
items.extract: Hearty crunchies are a food item that can be created through Cooking, by combining onions and either redberries or dwellberries at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty crunchies.

items.name: Hearty Fortifying Soup
items.description:
PERK - FUNGAL FORTITUDE (300 SEC)

Grants RESISTANCE to POISON effects

A comforting vegetable soup with added mushrooms. Helps prepare you for a grueling day ahead.
items.extract: Hearty fortifying soup is a consumable food item that can be crafted by combining bittercap mushrooms with onions at a cooking pot. When consumed, it provides moderate sustenance, 5 lifeward, and gives the Fungal Fortitude perk, granting resistance to Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty fortifying soup.

items.name: Hearty Soup
items.description: A comforting vegetable soup, reminds you of rainy days sat by the fire.
items.extract: Hearty soup is a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining onion with either potato or cabbage at a cooking pot and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when consumed.

items.name: Hearty Stew
items.description: A nice hot stew. A taste of home.
items.extract: Hearty stew is a stew that can be created through Cooking by combining a meat with a vegetable at a cooking pot, and much like meat stew provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten, however to as opposed to meat stew at least one tier two ingredient is used, either the meat used is raw bestial meat or the vegetable used is onion, or both. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making hearty stew.

items.name: Hell Rat Trophy
items.extract: The Hell Rat Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Herb Baked Trout
items.description: Made by combining grilled trout and a baked potato. Grants the Sea Life perk.[sic]
items.extract: Herb baked trout is a consumable food item that provides 100 health and 35 sustenance. It is made with grilled trout and baked potato in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Herd Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The herd ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Hermit Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The hermit ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Hollow Bark
items.description: Found lying around Fellhollow, around long-dead trees. Used in crafting.
items.extract: Hollow bark is a drop from dead trees.

items.name: Horizontal Thick Beam
items.extract: Horizontal thick beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other constructed objects.

items.name: Horizontal Thin Beam
items.extract: Horizontal thin beams are constructed objects where the dimensions are 4 metres long and .32 metres in diameter. Horizontal thin beams may be useful for supporting structures such as floors and other horizontal structures.

items.name: Human Torso
items.description: A surprisingly well-preserved human torso, must be ancient. Doctor Fenkenstrain is looking for something just like it.
items.extract: A human torso is a quest item used in The Great Body Robbery, where it is required to create Doctor Fenkenstrain's creature.

items.name: Hunter Stagbow
items.description: With it's[sic] aerodynamic antlers, this bow is very popular with garou scouts.
items.extract:
The hunter stagbow is a power level 4 longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a string of sinew, a vestige dropped by garou hunters with a 3/100 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect reads "Increased DAMAGE, Reduced DRAW SPEED." This has been changed twice since it was introduced: At first, it said “+10% Draw Speed Reduction” then it was changed to “+10% Draw Speed,” before it was changed to what it reads now, however it continues to draw and fire faster than other longbows, despite the special effect's description. It's clear that the developer's intention is for this weapon to hit harder but slower, however that is not yet the case.
The increased damage is also far less than it used to be: Previously, it reached 152 base damage at power level 7 (compared to 100 and 102 for Ulv's Longbow and the Bow of Elidinis), however now it is a mere 2 base damage higher at power level 8 at 120 compared to 118 for the other two.
