That being said, as long as it continues to fire faster, this will remain the ideal longbow to ascend for players wishing to focus on sustained damage over time in longer fights, although Ulv's Longbow will still be better for the first shot due to its special effect, and the Bow of Elidinis' water damage and special attack remain interesting where effective.

items.name: Icthlarian Fetish
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: Icthlarian fetish is the vestige that is used to unlock the pharaoh's sceptre. It can be collected after completing the quest Contact!, as long as the player has one inventory space.

items.name: Icthlarin's Little Helper Reward Pack
items.extract: Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack is an item given to the player upon completing the quest Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Imaru Tapestry
items.extract: Imaru Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Imaru's Head
items.description: Proof of your triumph over the Soul-Eater. It's dripping ectoplasm all over, you should probably get rid of it...
items.extract: Imaru's head is a quest item that is obtained by killing Imaru during the Withering Heights quest. Players will need to turn this head to Death at the Forgotten Temple to complete the quest.

items.name: Imaru's Talon
items.description: A Scimitar forged from the Visage of Imaru.
items.extract:
Imaru's talon is a power level 5 scimitar, crafted at a blacksmith's bench, after receiving the serrated claw as a drop from Imaru. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is Soul Feast, which grants 15 health when killing an enemy. This effect has a 30 second internal cooldown. The player's maximum health, enemy type, or power level does not change the amount of health restored.
This is the only ascendable scimitar, and it has higher damage ranges when the same power level as the steel scimitar (49 - 103), the mithril scimitar (62 - 130), and the adamant scimitar (76 - 160).

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * Soul Feast GRANTS a portion of HEALTH when killing an ENEMY

items.name: Imbued Granite Maul Head
items.description: A massive granite warhammer head. Garou masons imbue their stone weapons with wild anima to make them stronger than metal.
items.extract: The imbued granite maul head is one of the components used in crafting the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

items.name: Imbued Leather Wrappings
items.description: Strips of imbued dire wolf leather for the grips of a granite maul. Infused with primal savagery.
items.extract: Imbued leather wrappings is an artefact. The leather wrappings are used in the creation of the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

items.name: Imbuing Barrel
items.extract:
The imbuing barrel is a facility used to slowly process potions into super potions. It requires wild anima to operate, which can primarily be obtained by smelting 4 anima-infused bark in the kiln. 1 wild anima will process 6 potions in 12 minutes.
Players must receive yew logs in their inventory to unlock the imbuing barrel.

items.name: Infernal Fragment
items.description: Used to craft magical equipment. Postie Pete also has a use for them.
items.extract: Infernal fragments is a type of currency used in Evil Emporium to purchase several item recipes, and capes - these can be found in chests within Dowdun Reach, or dropped by certain monsters, such as lesser demons, hellhounds, hellrats, Black Knights, Zamorakian acolytes, Mages of Zamorak and shardbound lesser demons.

items.name: Infinity Cloth
items.description: Named as such due to the infinite number of colours it features. It's quite garish.
items.extract: Infinity cloth is created with a loom and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

items.name: Infinity Robe Body
items.description: A wizard's robe, infused with endless arcane force.
items.extract: Infinity robe body is a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe for this item and the rest of the armour set is unlocked by creating Infinity Cloth for the first time.

items.name: Infinity Robe Hat
items.description: A wizard's hat, infused with boundless magical power.
items.extract: Infinity robe hat is a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.  The recipe for this item and the rest of the armour set is unlocked by creating Infinity Cloth for the first time.

items.name: Infinity Robe Legs
items.description: A wizard's hat, infused with boundless magical power.
items.extract: Infinity robe legs are power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe for this item and the rest of the armour set is unlocked by creating Infinity Cloth for the first time.

items.name: Infinity Zogre Trophy
items.extract: The Infinity Zogre Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Inner Corner 45° Stairs
items.extract: Inner corner 45° stairs are a constructed object that is used to provide stairs in wall corners.

items.name: Inspiring Amulet of Attack
items.extract: The inspiring amulet of Attack is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Attack experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Amulet of Magic
items.extract: The inspiring amulet of Magic is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet grants players an additional 5% Magic experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Amulet of Ranged
items.extract: The inspiring amulet of Ranged is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Ranged experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Insignia
items.description: Perhaps you can learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The inspiring insignia is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the skills necklace.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Agility
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Agility is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Agility experience while training.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Artisan
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Artisan is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Artisan experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Construction
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Construction is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants the players an additional 5% Construction experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Cooking
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Cooking is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants the players an additional 5% Cooking experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Farming
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Farming is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Farming experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Fishing
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Fishing is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Fishing experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Mining
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Mining is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Mining experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Runecrafting
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Runecrafting is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Runecrafting experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Inspiring Ring of Woodcutting
items.extract: The inspiring ring of Woodcutting is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players an additional 5% Woodcutting experience while working with the skill.

items.name: Irit
items.description: Harvested from Thorny Irit Roots, used in potion making at the brewing cauldron.
items.extract: Irits are herbs acquired from destroying thorny irit roots and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 18 garou chits.

items.name: Irit Seeds
items.extract: Irit seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill.

items.name: Iron Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from iron.
items.extract: Iron arrows are power level 4 ammunition that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Iron Bar
items.description: A versatile metal used for crafting a wide range of durable items.
items.extract: An iron bar is a component of a variety of armour and weapons.

items.name: Iron Bar (decoration)
items.extract: An iron bar is a decoration that requires one iron bar. The iron bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Iron Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from iron.
items.extract: Iron barbed arrows are iron arrows with weapon barbs crafted on the arrow. Targets that are hit by a iron barbed arrow will be inflicted with the Bleed debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other barbed arrows, the icon will have a Bleed icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows. There are no additional bonuses at this time.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Iron Bolts
items.description: Crossbow bolts made from iron.
items.extract: Iron bolts are a power level 4 ammunition that can be fired from iron crossbows.

items.name: Iron Chest
items.extract:
The iron chest is a large storage container for up to 64 item slots. Players can unlock the recipe for the large chest after receiving an iron bar in their inventory. Players must have the required items in their chest and check the "Linked" checkbox in the chest interface to craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory. This will allow players to craft within a 32-metre radius from the chest.
Players can also lock their chest by opening the interface and checking the Private checkbox at the bottom.

items.name: Iron Crossbow
items.description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Iron.
items.extract: An iron crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can shoot blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Iron Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of iron crossbow limbs. Used in crafting an Iron Crossbow.
items.extract: Iron crossbow limbs are used in crafting iron crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Iron Dagger
items.description: A sharp, compact weapon, perfect for quick strikes in close combat.
items.extract: The iron dagger is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

items.name: Iron Fire Arrow
items.description: Burning arrows with tips forged from iron coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Iron fire arrows are iron arrows with fire oil applied with level 45 Ranged. Targets that are hit by the iron fire arrow will be inflicted with the Burning debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other fire arrows, the icon will have a fire icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Iron Greataxe
items.description: A massive, two-handed axe, capable of delivering devastating blows.
items.extract: The iron greataxe is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Iron Greatsword
items.description: A well-balanced, large, imposing sword for skilled warriors.
items.extract: The iron greatsword is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at the blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

items.name: Iron Helmet
items.description: Protect your head with this sturdy iron headgear.
items.extract: Iron helmet is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Iron Logging Axe
items.description: A durable tool for chopping trees, ideal for budding lumberjacks.
items.extract: The iron logging axe is a power level 4 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The iron logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with blightwood roots and bloodwood sap. Deals 30 damage when felling applicable trees, and 45 when overhead chopping to split them.

items.name: Iron Mace
items.description: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked iron mace.
items.extract: The iron mace is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

items.name: Iron Med Helm
items.description: A dependable helm trusted by countless adventurers.
items.extract: The Iron Med Helm is a power level 4 armour piece. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Iron Bar, 4 Hard Leather, 1 Padded Cloth, and 1 Vault Shard. The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition and by having an iron bar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Mined from iron deposits. It can be smelted in a Furnace.
items.extract: Iron ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from iron ore nodes, which are mainly found all over the Stormtouched Highlands and Fellhollow. Three ores can be smelted in a furnace into an iron bar, or three can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create a steel bar.

items.name: Iron Pickaxe
items.description: Essential for mining hard, valuable rocks, this iron pickaxe is a miner's best friend.
items.extract: An iron pickaxe is a power level 4 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with gold ore and dragon teeth, dealing 50 damage to minable ores, and 100 with a critical swing.

items.name: Iron Platebody
items.description: A heavy iron chestplate, providing superior protection in battle.
items.extract: An iron platebody is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Iron Platelegs
items.description: Sturdy iron leg armour.
items.extract: An iron platelegs is a power level 4 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Iron Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps that can be searched through. There might be something of value in there.
items.extract: Iron salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one iron bar.

items.name: Iron Secateurs
items.description: A pair of gardening Secateurs that boost your harvesting yield while equipped.
items.extract: Iron secateurs are a farming tool that boosts harvest yields, with the recipe unlocked at 42 Farming. Players can expect to receive a 25% yield increase when harvesting fully grown plants whilst wielding the secateurs and clicking the Harvest left-click option on the harvestable crop. This effect does not apply when the Uproot spell is used, even when the secateurs are equipped.

items.name: Iron Shield
items.description: A reliable, durable shield crafted from iron; perfect for tanking big hits.
items.extract: The iron shield is a power level 4 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A well-crafted iron blade for skilled combatants.
items.extract: The iron sword is a power level 4 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

items.name: Iron Warhammer
items.description: A brutal two-handed weapon, capable of smashing through enemy defences.
items.extract: The iron warhammer is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

items.name: Jade
items.description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
items.extract: Jade is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining iron ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

items.name: Jade (decoration)
items.extract: A jade is a decoration that requires one jade. The jade decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Jade Emblem
items.description: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.
items.extract: A jade emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found near the centre of Fractured Plains.

items.name: Jeweler's Bench
items.extract: The jeweler's bench is a buildable object where players can create jewellery with several gems. Players will need a silver bar in their inventory for the first time to unlock the bench.

items.name: Kalphite Bait
items.description: Kalphite bait. Increases the catch chance of fish.
items.extract: Kalphite bait is a power level 7 bait crafted at the crafting table. It can be used to increase the chance of catching Raw Beltfish. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Kalphite Carapace Chest
items.description: This chest armour is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers.
items.extract: Kalphite carapace chest is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the chitinous carapace vestige from Iasadair - The Merchant.

items.name: Kalphite Carapace Helmet
items.description: This helmet is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers
items.extract: Kalphite carapace helmet is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the twtiching antenna vestige from Iasadair - The Merchant.

items.name: Kalphite Carapace Legs
items.description: This leg armour is made from parts of the kalphites. Its durable but flexible nature makes it excellent for rangers.
items.extract: Kalphite carapace legs is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the barbed appendage vestige from Iasadair - The Merchant.

items.name: Kalphite Guardian Trophy
items.extract: The Kalphite Guardian Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Kalphite Ichor
items.description: A viscous, sticky fluid. Can be processed into a durable adhesive.
items.extract: Kalphite ichor is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies and kalphite eggs in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into acrid adhesive.

items.name: Kalphite Queen Trophy
items.extract: The Kalphite Queen Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Kalphite Shell
items.description: A durable kalphite carapace, suitable for crafting.
items.extract: Kalphite shell is a basic item used as a crafting material. It can be processed from kalphite shell fragments with acrid adhesive at the tannery.

items.name: Kalphite Shell Fragments
items.description: Shattered kalphite chitin. Could be salvaged with the right adhesive.
items.extract: Kalphite shell fragments is a basic item obtained from kalphite enemies in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into kalphite shell at a tannery.

items.name: Kalphite Soldier Trophy
items.extract: The Kalphite Soldier Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Kalphite Wing
items.extract: Kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite soldiers that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

items.name: Kalphite Worker Trophy
items.extract: The Kalphite Worker Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Keg Barrel
items.extract: A keg barrel is a decoration that is unlocked after receiving ash logs in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Keris
items.description: This dagger is thin and has a wavy edge to better slide through gaps in armour.
items.extract:
The keris is a power level 7 dagger. The recipe is learned from the corroded curved blade, found in the vault in southwest Umbral Sands, in the chest after the kalphite queen boss fight. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect deals 25% increased damage against kalphites, including kalphite workers, kalphite soldiers, kalphite guardians, and the kalphite queen, but not to kalphite eggs. While upright, kalphites are resistant to all forms of damage other than fire, however, when knocked onto their backs either with enough damage or after a parry, they become weak to all forms of damage, increasing all other forms of damage by about a combined 85% (this weapon's first hit deals 50 damage to an upright kalphite and 92 damage when knocked down without a parry, while the adamant dagger deals 40 damage upright and 74 knocked down without a parry).
This weapon and the adamant dagger have slightly higher maximum hits compared to the dragonbone dagger and wolfbane dagger when ascended to power level 7 (59 - 150 vs. 59 - 152), however they excel in their respective areas: In Umbral Sands, the player can be ambushed by kalphites at any time, and the kalphite guardians and kalphite queen can become immune to one of the three combat styles, so carrying this weapon out on the sands even when geared for either Magic or Ranged (especially since it only weighs 5.0) is worthwhile. Similarly, dire wolves, dragonwolves, ghost wolves, and hellhounds will quickly close the gap, so the wolfbane dagger is a strong choice against them. In all other situations, the dragonbone dagger's increased crit chance (even though it will be a lower bonus against those specific enemy types) will be best in all other situations.

items.name: Kiln
items.extract: The kiln is used to burn various logs into charcoal, swamp tar into adhesive, and to fire clay items. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled whilst doing other tasks. Its operation can be greatly sped up by casting Superheat on it. Players must receive clay in their inventory to unlock the recipe for building the kiln.

items.name: Kot Pack
items.description: A flame-retardant bag full of various knickknacks.
items.extract: Kot packs are a drop from KotHaar sentinels, and contains elder curiosities, rune essence, and obsidian devices.

items.name: Kuldra's Head
items.description: One of Kuldra's many heads. It glares back at you with untold hatred, even in this decapitated state. [[Commander Zilyana]] should see this.
items.extract: Kuldra's Head is a quest item acquired through defeating Kuldra in her sanctum within the Scorned Wilderness raid. Players can turn this in to not only complete the Regicide quest, but to acquire the Queenslayer's Reward Pack from Commander Zilyana.

items.name: Kuldra's Wrath
items.description: A masterfully crafted wand, infused with the fury of Kuldra - channeling arcane power with terrifying efficiency.
items.extract:
Kuldra's Wrath is a power level 9 wand and opening the Queenslayer's Reward Pack. Unlike many other weapons in the game, this wand is both uncraftable and has a passive full durability.
Bug: Despite the special effect stating an increase to damage against dragons, this wand does not currently get a damage boost against dragons.

items.name: Kwuarm
items.description: A bitter green herb used to make potions.
items.extract: Kwuarm is a herb that must be farmed using kwuarm seeds found in Garou or skeleton packs.

items.name: Kwuarm Seeds
items.description:
Kwuarm Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Kwuarm seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Kwuarm seeds can be obtained from a skeleton or garou pack, after discovering ash logs. When planted with the Farming skill, kwuarm seeds will grow into kwuarm.

items.name: Large Awning Roof
items.extract: A large awning roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Large Blurite Bar Pile
items.extract: A large blurite bar pile is a decoration that is unlocked after creating an blurite bar for the first time.

items.name: Large Bronze Bar Pile
items.extract: A large bronze bar pile is a decoration that is unlocked after creating a bronze bar for the first time.

items.name: Large Compost Bucket
items.description: An upgraded wooden bucket with room for extra Compost. Fewer trips, more fertilizing - just try not to strain your back! Pour its contents over a Farming Plot to Fertilize your plants.
items.extract:
The large compost bucket is a tool created at the crafting table. Level 65 Farming is required to unlock the recipe. It can be used to take out compost, super compost and ultra compost from the compost bin, super compost bin and ultra compost bin, respectively, at a maximum of 300 units per bucket held in the inventory.
When used on a farming plot, 10 units of either compost, super compost or ultra compost will be used until a total of 50 units have been used to fully fertilize a plot.

items.name: Large Desert Vase
items.extract: Large desert vase

items.name: Large Gold Bar Pile
items.extract: A large gold bar pile is a decoration that is unlocked after creating a gold bar for the first time.

items.name: Large Iron Bar Pile
items.extract: A large iron bar pile is a decoration that is unlocked after creating an iron bar for the first time.

items.name: Large Silver Bar Pile
items.extract: A large silver bar pile is a decoration that is unlocked after creating a silver bar for the first time.

items.name: Large Wardstone
items.description: Recharges your armour with a large amount of lifeward.
items.extract: A large wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 90 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player.

items.name: Large Water Barrel
items.extract: A large water barrel is a buildable object unlocked at level 46 Farming. which can hold either clean or dirty water (only from watering cans and not the drinks), but players cannot mix the two types of water inside the barrel.

items.name: Law Rune
items.description:
Resource needed for teleportation.

Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract: Law runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 50 Runecrafting or higher. Law runes are needed for teleporting with lodestones.

items.name: Law Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Law rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received a law rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Laying Book
items.extract: A laying book is a type of literature decoration that is unlocked after crafting leather for the first time.

items.name: Leather
items.description: A basic crafting material created from animal hide; commonly used for making equipment.
items.extract: Leather is created by putting animal hide or animal hide scraps into the tannery.

items.name: Leather Body
items.description: Protective armour made from leather.
items.extract: Leather body is a power level 2 ranged armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Leather Chaps
items.description: Protective armour made from leather.
items.extract: Leather chaps are a power level 2 ranged armour that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Leather Cowl
items.description: Protective armour made from leather.
items.extract: Leather cowl is a power level 2 helmet that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Leather Shield
items.description: A slightly more refined and durable shield made from wood and tanned animal hide.
items.extract: A leather shield is a power level 2 shield that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Leggings Of Lightness
items.description: Fabeled leggings that allow you to carry more!
items.extract: The leggings of lightness are a piece of power level 1 leg armour, which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the suspiciously light tattered boots vestige, found in a chest atop the windmill in Temple Woods. Their special effect increases the player's maximum carry weight by 50 and reduces the amount of fall damage the player takes. Also removes the rune cost of the spell Windstep.

items.name: Leonard the Bound
items.description: The book squirms in your backpack, as though trying to escape.
items.extract:
Leonard the Bound is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. The book is found in the gateway south of Skekven Kara vault, a connecting area between the Lake of Lost Souls and Silverthorn Keep. It is on the western gate, just below the southern tower. You need to use Windstep to reach the book which lies on a pedestal
There are two skeletal warriors and one skeletal hoplite in this area. It also contains two chests, one requiring a spade, and six rune essence rocks on the ground in the nearby nook.

items.name: Lesser Antipoison Potion
items.description: Removes poison and grants resistance to it.
items.extract: Lesser antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison, which removes Poison stacks and grants 33% resistance from Poison buildup for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with toadflax, swamp weed, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Attack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Strikes

INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with MELEE ATTACKS
items.extract: Lesser Attack potion grants the perk Focused Strikes, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with melee attacks by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, ground granite, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Agility Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Agility

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Agility potion grants the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with snapdragon, silver leaf, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Artisan Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Artisan

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with snapdragon, ground clay, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Attack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Attack

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack, which provides a 10 minute (600 second) +15% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with snapdragon, ram horn, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Construction Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Construction

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made with snapdragon, oak logs, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Cooking Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Cooking

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the COOKING Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made with snapdragon, onion, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Farming Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Farming

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the FARMING Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made with snapdragon, wheat, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Fishing Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Fishing

Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.
items.extract: Lesser Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with snapdragon, fried sardine, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Mining Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Mining

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the MINING Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made with snapdragon, sandstone, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Runecrafting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Runecrafting

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFTING Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made with snapdragon, soft animal fur, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Focused Woodcutting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Woodcutting

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill
items.extract: Lesser Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +15% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made with snapdragon, shrapnel, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Healing Potion
items.description: A potion that restores a moderate amount of health.
items.extract: Lesser healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 70 health points upon consumption. It is made with snapdragon, 2 dwellberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Lumberjack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Lumberjack

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 33%
items.extract: Lesser Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack, reducing the stamina cost of Woodcutting by 33% for 10 minutes (600 seconds). It is made with toadflax, ram horn, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Magic Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Casting

INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS with COMBAT SPELLS
items.extract: Lesser Magic Potion grants the perk Focused Casting, which increases the chance of landing critical hits with combat spells by 25% for 10-minutes (600 seconds). It is made with snapdragon, wild anima, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lesser Quarrymaster Potion
items.description:
PERK: Quarrymaster

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of MINING by 33%
items.extract: Lesser Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster, reducing the stamina cost of Mining by 33% for 10 minutes (600 seconds). It is made with toadflax, ground sandstone, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.extract:
The lightning rod is a building item that can be obtained by completing The Great Body Robbery. The item is 20m tall and can stop lightning from striking the area within a 25-metre radius. This may be useful in Ghornfell or Brynmoor, where lightning strikes can occur during rainy weather (e.g., Stormtouched Highlands).
Players can see the lightning protection area by walking away from its protection radius, revealing a light-blue dome around the lightning rod.

items.name: Lightning-in-a-bottle
items.description: A lightning bolt trapped in glass. It's best not to think too hard about the physics of it.
items.extract: Lightning-in-a-bottle is a quest item that is obtained by getting struck by lightning with an empty vial in their inventory. Players will need this for The Great Body Robbery to provide life to Doctor Fenkenstrain's creation.

items.name: Limestone
items.description: Can be ground into ground limestone
items.extract: Limestone is a basic Mining material mined from limestone rocks, found scattered across the Dowdun Reach region, typically beside bodies of water.

items.name: Limp Black Lining
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian body armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The limp black lining is a vestige that unlocks the shadow body. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

items.name: Lobster Bait
items.description: Scraps of lobster meat made into bait to draw in fish. A meal Undead Eels cannot resist. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: The lobster bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching undead eels. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Lodestone
items.extract: A lodestone is a platform that allows the player to travel if another lodestone is placed elsewhere. When the first lodestone is built, the inactive lodestone in the Temple starting area becomes active as well. Teleporting between two lodestones costs a varied amount of law runes, depending on the distance of the target lodestone and the weight of the player.

items.name: Loom
items.extract:
The loom can be used to create rough cloth, wool cloth and mystic cloth. It can be upgraded with the loom harness to be used to make padded cloth, fine cloth, infinity cloth, desert cloth, and vis cloth. It requires a roof above it to function. 
The loom is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

items.name: Loom Harness
items.extract:
A loom harness is a production upgrade for the loom that adds an extra slot, enabling the production of padded cloth or other woven cloths. To function, the harness must be placed within 9 metres of a loom. Each harness can only support a single loom; if placed between two, only the closest loom will receive the additional slot.
NOTE: To learn the recipe, you MUST first gather iron ore and smelt it into iron bars. After collecting iron bars, you will see an onscreen pop-up about learning the loom harness; however, you must also first interact with the loom itself, or it will never show up in the Build Menu.

items.name: Lougrim Memorial Shrine
items.extract: Lougrim memorial shrine is created by first learning the recipe from Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder upon delivering Lougrim's Staff to him after defeating Kuldra.

items.name: Lougrim's Staff
items.description: The very staff that Lougrim carried to her death within Kuldra's belly.
items.extract: Lougrim's Staff is a quest item obtainable through the Scorned Wilderness raid. Players can acquire it after defeating Kuldra during Regicide and it will appear in the quest item inventory tab. The item can be delivered to Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder for a Lougrim Memorial Shrine furniture reward.

items.name: Lumber Backpack
items.description: Stylish? Yes! But not only that... A highly functional backpack that improves your luck with rare wood resource drops. It also lightens the weight of carried wood, and gives a gentle boost to woodcutting progression.
items.extract:
Lumber backpack is an armour item equipped in the cape slot. Equipping this grants a +10% reduction to the weight of carried wood, +10% increase to Woodcutting experience, +10% increase to the amount of wood received from chopping trees and +15% for special item drop chance.
The recipe unlocks at level 59 Woodcutting.

items.name: Lumber Storage
items.extract:
Lumber storage is a large storage container for storing lumber. Only logs and planks can be stored inside, and it can hold up to 48 item slots. If the lumber storage is placed within three metres of the receiving end of a sawmill, the sawmill will automatically deposit planks into it. Players can also build multiple sawmills with the sawing end within two metres, and have the processed planks go into the same storage. Players gain the ability to build lumber storage by reaching level 67 Woodcutting, and gaining the feat lumber storage.
To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their crate and check the "Linked" checkbox in the crate interface. This will allow players to craft up to 12 metres away from the crate.

items.name: Lumberjack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Lumberjack II

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 66%
items.extract: Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack II, which reduces the stamina cost of woodcutting by 66% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with irit, dragon tooth, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Luminite Ore
items.description: Mined from luminite deposits. A catalysing material that can help to make rare metals.
items.extract: Luminite Ore is a Mining material that can be mined from Luminite Deposits, which are found within the Scorned Wilderness.

items.name: Lunar Garou Hat
items.description: A lunar-infused hood designed to complement the garou robes, Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.
items.extract: Lunar Garou hat are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Lunar Garou Robe Legs
items.description: Lunar-imbued leggings that complete the garou robe set. Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.
items.extract: Lunar Garou robe legs are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the lunular wrappings vestige from Domri - The Merchant.

items.name: Lunar Garou Robes
items.description: Robes woven under the light of a full moon, imbued with the wild power of the garou. Suitable for magic users, enhancing healing abilities at night.
items.extract: Lunar Garou robes are a power level 7 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the lunate shawl vestige from Domri - The Merchant.

items.name: Lunate Shawl
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it
items.extract: The lunate shawl is a vestige that unlocks the Lunar Garou robes

items.name: Lunular Wrappings
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it
items.extract: The lunular wrappings is a vestige that unlocks the Lunar Garou robe legs

items.name: Magic Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Magic is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Magic cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Magic. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Magic Logs
items.description: Cut from magic trees. Can be crafted into various equipment.
items.extract: Magic logs are obtained by chopping down Magic Trees, with a Rune Logging Axe or better.

items.name: Magic Longbow
items.description: The natural resilience of magic wood allows this bow to send arrows soaring over great distances.
items.extract: Magic Longbow is a power level 8 longbow.

items.name: Magic Shortbow
items.description: A shortbow made of magic wood, this bow is light enough to carry all day and powerful enough to ruin someone else's.
items.extract: Magic Shortbow is a power level 8 ranged weapon.

items.name: Magic Tree Seed
items.description:
Magic tree seeds.

Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
items.extract: A magic tree seed is a Power level 1 seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a magic tree.

items.name: Magical Focus
items.description: Imbue your staff to increase the damage of your magical attacks for a limited time.
items.extract: A magical focus is an unlockable item at level 39 Magic, where players can imbue their equipped staff with a 15% damage increase for 10 minutes. Players can also stack the damage boost with a lesser Magic potion, making the player's staff also equipped with a 25% increased chance of a critical hit.

items.name: Magnet
items.description: A Magnet smithed by Pulpknuckle.
items.extract: Magnet  is a quest item required for Animal Magnetism, which is created by giving an iron bar and 5 law runes to Pulpknuckle.

items.name: Maple Battlestaff
items.description: A magical weapon carved from maple wood.
items.extract: Maple battlestaff is a power level 6 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

items.name: Maple Infusion
items.description: Made from clean water, maple sap and irit. Reduces thirst as well as stamina when blocking.
items.extract: Maple infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 80 hydration and grants the perk Stalwart Shield, which reduces the stamina cost of block actions by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, maple syrup, and irit in a cooking range.

items.name: Maple Logs
items.description: Cut from maple trees. Can be crafted into various equipment.
items.extract: Maple logs are obtained by chopping down maple trees, with a mithril logging axe  or better. It can now been used to make super compost!

items.name: Maple Longbow
items.description: A supple longbow carved from maple wood.
items.extract: The maple longbow is a power level 6 longbow that can be crafted from a fletching bench.

items.name: Maple Rod
items.description: A bad-ass rod, effective in Dowdun Reach.
items.extract: The maple rod is a power level 6 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Maple Sap
items.description: Harvested from maple trees. An ingredient that can be cooked on a campfire.
items.extract: Maple sap is a Power Level 4 basic material, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into maple syrup starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt maple syrup at level 50. It can be gathered from chopped maple trees.

items.name: Maple Shortbow
items.description: A limber shortbow carved from maple wood[sic]
items.extract: Maple shortbows are a power level 6 bow that has higher stats than the willow shortbow. Players can create the maple shortbow at a fletching bench.

items.name: Maple Syrup
items.description: A sweet and nutty syrup. An ingredient for various dishes.
items.extract: Maple syrup is a power level 4 consumable food item that provides 25 sustenance when eaten. It can be cooked from maple sap at either a campfire or grill. It requires Cooking level 41 to cook and 50 to not burn, otherwise creating burnt maple syrup.

items.name: Maple Toastie
items.description: A sweet lunch made with maple syrup and dried redberry.
items.extract: Maple toastie is a consumable food item that provides 70 health, 80 sustenance, as well as the perks Foreman's Feast and Coagulated. These perks reduce the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33%, and reduce Bleed buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with dried redberries, maple syrup, and bread at a cooking range after receiving the recipe from Snotpit near The Grand Hall in Dowdun Reach as part of the Black Knight's Fortress (quest).

items.name: Maple Tree Seed
items.description:
Maple tree seeds.

Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
items.extract: A maple tree seed is a power level 1 seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a maple tree.

items.name: Maple Wand
items.description: A finely crafted maple wand, prized for its natural affinity with magic.
items.extract: The Maple wand is a power level 6 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 maple logs, 3 mithril bar, 2 glass vessel, and 8 infernal fragment.

items.name: Marentill Seeds
items.description:
Marentill Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract: Marentill seeds (also spelled marrentil) are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill.

items.name: Marrentil
items.description: A bitter tasting herb used in resistance potions.
items.extract: Marrentil (also spelled marrentill in books) is a herb found from harvesting a marrentill plant in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

items.name: Master Wand
items.description: A wand worthy of an accomplished spellcaster. Mastery is not included.
items.extract: The Master wand is a power level 7 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 8 yew logs, 3 refined obsidian, 2 infinity cloth, 2 dragonstone, and 2 gypsum wax.

items.name: Master's Staff
items.description: A magical staff fashioned for a master of the mystic arts. It radiates with power.
items.extract: Master's staff is a power level 7 two-handed staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge.

items.name: Meat Pizza
items.description: A pizza with bits of meat on it.
items.extract: Meat pizza is a consumable food item that provides 90 health, 110 sustenance as well the perks Meaty Meal and Coagulated, which reduces hunger drain by 25% and reduces Bleed buildup for 600 seconds. It is made with flank steak, fillet, haunch, and bread in a cooking range and learned by unlocking Adept Culinaromancer at level 36 Cooking.

items.name: Meat Sandwich
items.description: A carnivore's favourite, made with flank steak and rat roast.
items.extract: Meat sandwich is a consumable food item that provides +0.5 Resist Shocked Buildup, 80 health and 85 sustenance, as well as the perks Meaty Meal and Grounded, which reduces hunger drain by 25% and reduces shock damage taken for 600 seconds. It is made with flank steak, rat roast, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in the library in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Meat Stew
items.description: Meat and vegetables, the classic combination. A warm and pleasant meal.
items.extract: Meat stew is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 50 sustenance. It is made with fillet and haunch in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Meat Stew (decoration)
items.extract: A meat stew is a decoration that is first unlocked by successfully cooking a meat stew.

items.name: Meat Twist Sandwich
items.description: Meat, meat and more meat. A sandwich with flank steak, rat roast and dried redberries.
items.extract: Meat twist sandwich is a consumable food item that provides 90 health and 80 sustenance, as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment, Meaty Meal, and Foreman's Feast, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10%, reduces hunger drain by 25%, and reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with flank steak, rat roast, dried redberries, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe nearby Valerius in Dowdun Reach, between The Library and The Cathedral.

items.name: Medium 30° Curved Roof Support Wall
items.extract: A medium 30° curved roof support wall is a constructed.

items.name: Medium 30° Hip Roof
items.extract: Medium 30° hip roof is a constructed object where the dimensions are half of a regular 30° hip roof, measuring at 2 metres long and wide.

items.name: Medium 30° Inverted Curved Roof Support Wall
items.wiki: Medium 30° Inverted Curved Roof Support Wall
items.icon: Medium 30° Inverted Curved Roof Support Wall (Castle).png
items.extract: A medium 30° inverted curved roof support wall is a constructed Object that is a medium 30° curved roof support wall but is flipped 180°.

items.name: Medium 30° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: Medium 30° inverted roof support wall is a constructed object where it is half the dimensions of the 30° inverted roof support wall, measuring at 1 metre high and 2 metres long.

items.name: Medium 30° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 30° inverted triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium 30° Roof
items.extract: A medium 30° roof is a constructed object where the dimensions are half of a regular 30° roof, measuring at 2 metres long and wide.

items.extract: Medium 30° inverted roof support wall is a constructed object where it is half the dimensions of the 30° inverted roof support wall, measuring at 1 metre high and 2 metres long.

items.name: Medium 30° Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 30° triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium 30° Valley Roof
items.extract: A medium 30° valley roof is a constructed object where the dimensions are half of a regular 30° valley roof, measuring at 2 metres long, 2 metres wide, and 2.8 metres high.

items.name: Medium 45° Hip Roof
items.extract: A medium 45° hip roof is a constructed object where the dimensions are half of the 45° hip roof, measuring at 2.8 metres long, 2 metres wide, and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium 45° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: Medium 45° roof support wall is a constructed object where two of them can support a medium 45° roof. This medium-sized 45° roof support wall is 2 metres long and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium 45° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 45° inverted triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium 45° Roof
items.extract: A medium 45° roof is a constructed object where it is half the dimensions of the 45° roof, measuring at 2.8 metres long, 2 metres wide, and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium 45° Roof Support Wall
items.extract: Medium 45° roof support wall is a constructed object where two of them can support a medium 45° roof. This medium-sized 45° roof support wall is 2 metres long and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium 45° Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 45° triangle roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium 45° Valley Roof
items.extract: Medium 45° valley roof is a constructed object that is half the dimensions of a 45° valley roof, measuring at 2 metres long, 2 metres wide, and 2.8 metres high.

items.name: Medium 60° Hip Roof
items.extract: Medium 60° hip roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage set where that is half the dimensions of the 60° hip roof, measuring at 2.3 metres long, 1 metre wide, and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium 60° Inverted Roof Support Wall
items.extract: Medium 60° inverted roof support wall is a constructed item that is flipped 180° in its horizontal axis. This structure may be useful for supporting an upper floor with a wall in a corner location.

items.name: Medium 60° Inverted Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 60° inverted triangle roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage collection that is an inverted version of the medium 60° triangle roof. Inverted triangle roofs may be useful for building Saw-tooth roofs.

items.name: Medium 60° Roof
items.extract: Medium 60° roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage set that is half the length of the 60° roof, measuring at two metres long and 2.3 metres high.

items.name: Medium 60° Roof Support Wall
items.extract: Medium 60° roof support wall is a tier 2 constructed object that is half the size of a regular 60° roof support wall, measuring at 1 metre long, 2 metres high, and its hypotenuse at 2.23 metres. Medium 60° roof support walls can be useful for supporting a medium 60° roof.

items.name: Medium 60° Triangle Roof
items.extract: Medium 60° triangle roof is a cottage-constructed object that is half the dimensions of the 60° triangle roof, measuring at 1 metre wide, 2 metres high, and 2.2 metres long. Triangle roofs may be useful for building Saw-tooth roofs.

items.name: Medium 60° Valley Roof
items.extract: Medium 60° valley roof is a cottage-constructed object in the Cottage set that is half the size of a regular 60° valley roof, measuring at 2 metres high, 2 metres wide, 2 metres long, and is 2.83m at its hypotenuse.

items.name: Medium Awning Roof
items.extract: A medium awning roof is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium Blurite Nugget
items.extract: A medium blurite nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining blurite ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Clay Pile
items.extract: A medium clay pile is a decoration that is unlocked by mining and receiving clay for the first time.

items.name: Medium Copper Nugget
items.extract: A medium copper nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining copper ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Desert Vase
items.extract: Medium desert vase

items.name: Medium Gold Nugget
items.extract: Medium gold nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining gold ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Grated Floor
items.extract: A medium grated floor is a type of furniture that can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Medium Iron Nugget
items.extract: A medium iron nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining iron ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Silver Nugget
items.extract: A medium silver nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining silver ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Square Foundation
items.extract: Medium square foundations are a constructed object that is two metres long and two metres wide, half of the width and length dimensions of the square foundation.

items.name: Medium Square Tile
items.extract: Medium square tiles are a constructed object that has 1/2 of the dimensions of the square tile’s length and width, measuring at 1 metre for each dimension.

items.name: Medium Tin Nugget
items.extract: A medium tin nugget is a decoration that is unlocked after mining tin ore for the first time.

items.name: Medium Triangular Foundation
items.extract: Medium triangular foundations are a constructed object that has 1/3 the dimensions of the triangular foundation.

items.name: Medium Triangular Tile
items.extract: Medium triangular tiles are constructed objects that are about half the dimensions of a regular triangular tile, measuring at 1.85 metres long and 1.8 metres wide.

items.name: Medium Wall
items.extract: A medium wall is a constructed object that does not require a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors. A medium wall is half the dimensions of a regular wall, measuring 2 metres long and 2 metres high.

items.name: Medium Wall With Slit
items.extract: A medium wall with slit is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium Wall With Window
items.extract: A medium wall with window is a constructed object.

items.name: Medium Wardstone
items.description: Recharges your armour with a moderate amount of lifeward.
items.extract: A medium wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 60 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player.

items.name: Miner Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The miner ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Mining Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Mining is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Mining cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Mining. It can be crafted at the mystic forge.  
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Mithril Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from mithril.
items.extract: Mithril arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft mithril barbed arrow, poisoned mithril arrow, and mithril fire arrow.

items.name: Mithril Bar
items.description: A versatile metal used for crafting weapons and armour.
items.extract: Mithril bars are a processed material created with three mithril ore (or nine mithril salvage piles) and three coal inside a blast furnace.

items.name: Mithril Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from mithril.
items.extract: Mithril barbed arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Mithril Bolts
items.description: Crossbow bolts made from mithril.
items.extract: Mithril bolts are a power level 6 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Mithril Crossbow
items.description: A 1-Handed crossbow composed mainly of mithril.
items.extract: A mithril crossbow is a power level 6 crossbow that can shoot mithril, steel, blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Mithril Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of mithril crossbow limbs. Essential for crafting mithril crossbow.
items.extract: Mithril crossbow limbs are used in crafting mithril crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Dagger
items.description: A concealable weapon, perfect for backstabbing your enemies.
items.extract: The mithril dagger is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Fire Arrow
items.description: Burning arrows with tips forged from mithril, coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Mithril fire arrows are a power level 6 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Mithril Greataxe
items.description: A two-handed battleaxe forged from mithril.
items.extract: The mithril greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Greatsword
items.description: A sturdy two-handed sword, with strength to match its size.
items.extract: The mithril greatsword is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Helmet
items.description: Protect your head with this durable mithril headgear.
items.extract: Mithril helmet is a power level 6 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Mithril Logging Axe
items.description: A tool for chopping trees. Make sure to hit them with the sharp side.
items.extract:
The mithril logging axe is a power level 6 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The mithril logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with maple trees. Deals 68 damage when felling applicable trees, and 102 when overhead chopping to split them.
The recipe and ability to craft mithril logging axes are unlocked upon obtaining a mithril bar for the first time.

items.name: Mithril Mace
items.description: Crush your foes with this heavy, spiked mithril mace.
items.extract: The mithril mace is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Med Helm
items.description: Lightweight, durable, and highly sought after.
items.extract: The Mithril Med Helm is a power level 6 helmet. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Mithril Bar, 4 Cursed Leather, 1 Mystic Cloth, and 1 Demonic Oil. The recipe for this item is obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition and having a mithril bar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Mithril Ore
items.description: Mined from Mithril deposits. It can be smelted in a Furnace.
items.extract: Mithril ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from mithril ore nodes, which can be found all over the Dowdun Reach region and its underground areas. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of coal in a blast furnace to produce mithril bars.

items.name: Mithril Pickaxe
items.description: A tool for mining. Few rocks can withstand its strength.
items.extract:
A mithril pickaxe is a power level 6 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers along with limestone, dealing 82 damage to minable ores, and 164 with a critical swing. 

The recipe and ability to craft the Mithril pickaxe are unlocked upon obtaining Maple logs for the first time.

items.name: Mithril Platebody
items.description: A heavy mithril plate, providing welcome protection in battle.
items.extract: Mithril platebody is a power level 6 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Mithril Platelegs
items.description: Durable mithril leg armour.
items.extract: Mithril platelegs is a power level 6 armour piece that can be crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Mithril Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps of mithril that can be smelted into more useful bars.
items.extract: Mithril salvage piles are a basic material that can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one mithril bar.

items.name: Mithril Scimitar
items.description: A curved sword of Eastern influence, forged from mithril.
items.extract: The mithril scimitar is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Shield
items.description: A sturdy shield crafted from mithril. Perfect for holding your ground.
items.extract: Mithril shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Sword
items.description: A well-forged mithril blade for trained combatants.
items.extract: The mithril sword is a power level 6 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mithril Warhammer
items.description: An imposing two-handed weapon, capable of crushing any enemy.
items.extract: The mithril warhammer is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Mixed Grill
items.description: Why eat just one animal? A carnivore's favourite.
items.extract: Mixed grill is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perk Meaty Meal, which reduces the player's hunger drain by 25% for 300 seconds. It is made with fillet, haunch, and steak in a stone range or a cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Amateur Culinaromancer at level 16 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Mixed Platter
items.description: Why eat just one animal? A carnivore's delight!
items.extract: Mixed platter is a consumable food item that can be created through Cooking by combining raw bestial meat with any tier one meat (raw rat meat, raw bird meat, raw farm meat, or raw game meat) at a cooking pot and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten.

items.name: Molten Glass
items.description: Hot glass ready to be blown into useful objects.
items.extract: Molten glass is a processed material. It can be created with three ground sandstone and three ground limestone at a blast furnace. This is used at a jeweler's bench to craft glass vessel, glass decoration & glass pane.

items.name: Monkfish Bait
items.description: Bait made from monkfish tail. Increases the catch chance of Desert Sole.
items.extract: Monkfish bait is a power level 7 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching desert soles. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Monkfish Fillets
items.description: Tastier than the Piscatoris monkfish, in our humble opinion.
items.extract: Monkfish fillets are a consumable food item that provides 60 health and 25 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 300 seconds. It is made by cooking raw monkfish on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in monkfish skewers.

items.name: Monkfish Skewers
items.description: Tasty monkfish meat, pierced on a skewer for convenient eating.
items.extract: Monkfish skewers are a consumable food item that provide 120 health and 50 sustenance as well as the perks Sea Life and Frosted Flavours, which restores 3 health every second and reduces the rate at which Scorch is accumulated for 300 seconds. They are made with monkfish fillets and seared cactus steak in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Monstrous Fang
items.description: Large fangs used in creating deadly weaponry.
items.extract: Monstrous fangs are obtained by defeating an abyssal demon. There is currently no use for monstrous fangs.

items.name: Moon Garou Armchair
items.extract: A Moon Garou armchair is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the chair.

items.name: Moon Garou Bed
items.extract: The Moon Garou bed is a buildable piece of furniture used to sleep, rest, and set the player's respawn point in the world. If used at night, players will skip to daytime and regain their "Rest" meter, but if used during the day, players will lie in place and slowly regain their rest meter over time. The bed requires 8 yew planks and 4 desert cloths to craft, and must be under a roof and mostly enclosed with walls to be used.

items.name: Moon Garou Pack
items.description: A reward for helping the Moon Garou.
items.extract: Moon Garou packs are quest rewards given to the player by completing all of the reputation quests for each tribe in Umbral Sands. Different items are rewarded for completing each of the three tribes.

items.extract: Moon Garou sunshade 02

items.extract: Moon Garou table 01 is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

items.extract: Moon Garou table 02 is a type of furniture. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

items.name: Moon Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The moon ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Moonstone (item)
items.description: A glittering gemstone, desired by a merchant in the Alcarrid garou settlement.
items.extract: Moonstone is a quest item found after mining moonstone rocks in Umbral Sands. Players will need to hand three of these to Domri - The Merchant to complete the rogue trader section of Icthlarin's Little Helper.

items.name: Moth Eaten Black Cloth
items.description: The tattered pieces of a mysterious object. Perhaps you could learn something from them.
items.extract: The moth eaten black cloth is a vestige that unlocks the black adventurer's cape. It is obtained from Death's Exchange for 150 soul fragments.

items.description: The tattered pieces of a mysterious object. Perhaps you could learn something from them.
