items.extract: The moth eaten yellow cloth is a vestige that unlocks the yellow adventurer's cape. It is obtained from Death's Exchange for 150 soul fragments.

items.name: MOUNT: Applefeather Mosstail
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: applefeather mosstail is a Vestige that grants the player the applefeather mosstail mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from red dragons, KotHaar-Kal, kalphite guardians and chests found in Umbral Sands.

items.name: MOUNT: Astralbeak Warbler
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: astralbeak warbler is a Vestige that grants the player the astralbeak warbler mount when used. It can be bought from Postie Petes Evil Emporium for 2000 infernal fragments.

items.name: MOUNT: Coastal Sunbeak
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: coastal sunbeak is a Vestige that grants the player the coastal sunbeak mount when used. It can be bought from Postie Petes Evil Emporium for 2000 infernal fragments.

items.name: MOUNT: Crimson Crybaby
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: crimson crybaby is a vestige that grants the player the crimson crybaby mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from red dragons, KotHaar-Kal, kalphite guardians and chests found in Umbral Sands.

items.name: MOUNT: Eclipseborn Sharpbeak
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: eclipseborn sharpbeak is a Vestige that grants the player the eclipseborn sharpbeak mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from blue dragons, lesser demons, elite Black Knights and chests found in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: MOUNT: Grassfoot Screecher
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: grassfoot screecher is a Vestige that grants the player the grassfoot screecher mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from green dragons, zogres, soulstone sentinels and chests found in Fellhollow.

items.name: MOUNT: Infernal Blightbeak
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: infernal blightbeak is a vestige that grants the player the infernal blightbeak mount when used. It can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 9999 garou chits.

items.name: MOUNT: Leafwood Strider
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: leafwood strider is a Vestige that grants the player the leafwood strider mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from green dragons, zogres, soulstone sentinels and chests found in Fellhollow.

items.name: MOUNT: Manafem Midnight
items.extract: MOUNT: Manafem Midnight is an unreleased vestige that unlocks the Manafem Midnight appearence for the magic carpet mount. It is currently unobtainable in-game.

items.name: MOUNT: Moonsilk Weave
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: moonsilk weave is a vestige that unlocks the Moonsilk Weave appearance for the magic carpet mount. This is only dropped by the Kalphite Queen.

items.name: MOUNT: Mossbeak Hunter
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: mossbeak hunter is a vestige that grants the player the mossbeak hunter mount when used. It can be bought from Death's Exchange for 2000 soul fragments.

items.name: MOUNT: Oakfeather Raptor
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: oakfeather raptor is a Vestige that grants the player the oakfeather raptor mount when used. It can be bought from Death's Exchange for 2000 soul fragments.

items.name: MOUNT: Scorchsummer Ashbeak
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: scorchsummer ashbeak is a Vestige that grants the player the scorchsummer ashbeak mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from red dragons, KotHaar-Kal, kalphite guardians and chests found in Umbral Sands.

items.name: MOUNT: Scorchweave Rug
items.extract: MOUNT: Scorchweave Rug is an unreleased vestige that unlocks the Scorchweave Rug appearence for the magic carpet mount. It is currently unobtainable in-game.

items.name: MOUNT: Springdown Runner
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: springdown runner is a vestige that grants the player the springdown runner mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from green dragons, zogres, soulstone sentinels and chests found in Fellhollow.

items.name: MOUNT: Summerbellied Wagtail
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: summerbellied wagtail is a Vestige that grants the player the summerbellied wagtail mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from blue dragons, lesser demons, elite Black Knights and chests found in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: MOUNT: Sunkissed Clawfoot
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: sunkissed clawfoot is a Vestige that grants the player the sunkissed clawfoot mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from blue dragons, lesser demons, elite Black Knights and chests found in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: MOUNT: Uzzerian Umber
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: Uzzerian umber is a Vestige that grants the player the Uzzerian umber mount when used. It can be obtained as a drop from Tok-Xil in Umbral Sands.

items.name: MOUNT: Zamorakian Pledgesaddle
items.description: Grants access to a visual mount variant
items.extract: MOUNT: Zamorakian pledgesaddle is a Vestige that grants the player the Zamorakian pledgesaddle mount when used. It can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 9999 garou chits.

items.name: Mucher's Basket
items.extract: Mucher's Basket is a decoration unlocked by purchasing the Deluxe Edition of the game.

items.name: Mule Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The mule ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Muncher's Basket
items.extract:
Muncher's basket is a companion that can be placed.
The recipe for this item is obtained from purchasing the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Mushroom Kebab
items.description: A meaty kebab with mushrooms.
items.extract: Mushroom kebab is a consumable food item that provides 120 health, 110 sustenance as well as the perks Foreman's Feast and Fungal Fortitude, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting and Mining by 33% and reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with grilled mushrooms, fried cabbage, haunch, and bread in a cooking range and learned by unlocking Adept Culinaromancer at level 36 Cooking.

items.name: Mysterious Orb (Charged)
items.description: An orb obtained from a statue in the Magic Institute, charged with magical energy.
items.extract: Mysterious orb (charged) is an item used in Highlighting the Problem. During the quest, a mysterious orb (uncharged) is charged with the energy from three towers to become charged. Players must interact with the statue at the centre of the Runecrafting Guild to complete the quest, granting the recipe knowledge to create the staff of light.

items.name: Mysterious Orb (Uncharged)
items.description: An orb obtained from a statue in the Magic Institute.
items.extract: Mysterious orb (uncharged) is a quest item used in Highlighting the Problem. During the quest, it is charged with the energy from three towers to become mysterious orb (charged).

items.name: Mystic Cloth
items.description: Spun from mystic fibre. Magic courses through every thread.
items.extract: Mystic cloth is a item used for armours. It is crafted at the loom using three mystic thread.

items.name: Mystic Fibres
items.description: Dropped by Zamorak magi[sic]. Can be spun into thread at a spinning wheel.
items.extract: Mystic fibres are found by opening Zamorakian mage pack and are used to create mystic thread.

items.name: Mystic Forge
items.extract:
The mystic forge is a crafting station that allows for the creation of staves, other weapons, and more powerful capes, and uses ascension cores in ascending masterwork weapons and vestige armour. This replaces some of the functionality of the smithing anvil and crafting table.
The mystic forge is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar in the player's inventory.

items.name: Mystic Hat
items.description: A magically resonant hood, perfect for staying warm.
items.extract: Mystic hat is a power level 6 armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Mystic Net
items.description: Made with two mystic threads at a crafting table. A stunningly well crafted net.
items.extract: The mystic net is a power level 6 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table.

items.name: Mystic Robe Legs
items.description: Lightweight magical gear for the aspiring sorcerer.
items.extract: Mystic robe legs is a power level 6 armour piece that is crafted with an armour bench.

items.name: Mystic Robes
items.description: The finest magical thread, spun into fabolous mage gear.
items.extract: Mystic robes is a power level 6 armour piece that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Mystic Thread
items.description: Spun from mystic fibre. Magic courses through every thread.
items.extract: Mystic thread is a basic item created at a spinning wheel using four mystic fibres.

items.name: Naphtha
items.description: A very flammable liquid.
items.extract: Naptha is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use naptha to create fire oil. It is also dropped by dragon wolves and carnivorous chinchompas.

items.name: Narrow Arched Window Wall
items.extract: A narrow arched window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Narrow Cross Slit Wall
items.extract: A narrow cross slit wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Narrow Stained Glass Window Wall
items.extract: A narrow stained glass window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and glass panes.

items.name: Narrow Stone Inset Window Wall
items.extract: A narrow stone inset window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Narrow Tall Slit Wall
items.extract: A narrow tall slit wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Nature Rune
items.description: Nature runes are used for casting transumation spells. Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract: Nature runes can be crafted at a rune altar at level 38 Runecrafting or higher.

items.name: Nature Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Nature rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received an nature rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Necromancer's Crown
items.description: Magical headgear for those that rule over their undead minions.
items.extract: The necromancer's crown is a power level 5 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. It can be unlocked by purchasing the Curse Carrying Crown in Death's Exchange. The Crown, Robe Top, and Robe Legs are required to complete the What Remains is Written quest.

items.name: Necromancer's Robe Bottom
items.description: Leggings styled after the ancient overlords of Ashenfall.
items.extract: Necromancer's robe bottom are a power level 5 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench. The Crown, Robe Top, and Robe Legs are required to complete the What Remains is Written quest.

items.name: Necromancer's Robe Top
items.description: Leggings styled after the ancient overlords of Ashenfall.
items.extract: Necromancer's robe top is a power level 5 magic armour that can be created at an armour bench after studying the vestige, remnants of a rotting robe. The Crown, Robe Top, and Robe Legs are required to complete the What Remains is Written quest.

items.name: Necromancer's Staff
items.description: Necromantic essence still emanates from this staff.
items.extract:
The necromancer's staff is a power level 5 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by entering a spectral door and interacting with a dragonkin effigy in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is the highest rune damage modifier of all staves at the same power level but with lower durability.
It's only higher than the staff of light by 0.1. At power level 7, this equates to only a 0 - 4 damage difference between the two depending on the rune type, hit of the combo, whether it crits, and whether a magic focus is used. This will only make a difference if that damage hits a breakpoint on certain enemies (i.e. if it takes one less hit with this weapon to defeat an enemy than with the staff of light). The staff of light has 20% more durability with 1300. Although managing durability with Magical Mending is trivial, it could make a difference in, say, the 30 waves of the fight caves.

items.name: Necrotic Bonemeal
items.description: Made from ground up undead bone. A useful crafting ingredient.
items.extract: Necrotic bonemeal is one of the materials required for making sacred oil and demonic oil.

items.name: Noxious Draconic Visage
items.description: The image of a fearsome dragon. Used in crafting powerful equipment.
items.extract: The noxious draconic visage is an award obtained from the Wise Old Man in exchange for Velgar's head, which is obtained by killing Velgar during or after the quest Dragon Slayer. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragonblight shield.

items.name: Oak Battlestaff
items.description: A magical weapon carved from oak wood.
items.extract: Oak battlestaff is a power level 3 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge.

items.name: Oak Chair
items.extract: An oak chair is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating oak planks. Players can place decorations and can also sit on top of the chair.

items.name: Oak Chest
items.extract:
The oak chest is a large storage container for up to 48 item slots. Players can unlock the creation of the large chest after receiving oak logs for the first time. To craft or process an item without having the required items in their inventory, players must have the required items in their chest and check the "Linked" checkbox in the chest interface. This will allow players to craft up to a 12-metre radius away from the chest.
Players can also lock their chest by opening the interface and checking the Private checkbox at the bottom.

items.name: Oak Farming Plot
items.extract:
The oak farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. To obtain this plot recipe, collect oak logs.
It is the best plot to grow plants found within the Ghornfell region, like the following:

Dwellberry seeds
Kwuarm seeds
Onion seeds
Snapdragon seeds
Swamp weed seeds
Toadflax seeds
Tomato seeds

items.name: Oak Logs
items.description: Sturdy oak logs used for crafting equipment and furniture.
items.extract: Oak logs are obtained by chopping down oak trees, with a bronze axe  or better.

items.name: Oak Longbow
items.description: A powerful longbow carved from oak wood.
items.extract: The oak longbow is a power level 3 bow that can be crafted at the fletching bench.

items.name: Oak Palisades
items.extract: Oak palisades are defensive structures that are built to protect a player-built structure. Oak palisades have high defence so that players are protected from goblin raid events and other aggressive monsters.

items.name: Oak Palisades Gate
items.extract: Oak palisades gates are defensive structures that are built to protect a player-built structure. Players can place either a tier 1 or 2 door between the two pallisade beams and can also mix between the two. Oak palisades gates have a high defence so that players are protected from Goblin raid events and other aggressive monsters.

items.name: Oak Plank
items.description: A milled piece of lumber.
items.extract: Oak planks can be created by using oak logs on a sawmill. They have many uses in construction or can be processed in a kiln to make charcoal.

items.name: Oak Rod
items.description: A favourite fishing rod, effective in Ghornfell.
items.extract: The oak rod is a power level 3 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Oak Shortbow
items.description: An agile shortbow carved from oak wood.
items.extract: The oak shortbow is a power level 2 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Oak Table
items.extract: An oak table is a tier 2 type of furniture.

items.name: Oak Tree Seed
items.description:
Oak Tree Seeds.

Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
items.extract:
An oak tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow an oak tree. 
Oak tree seeds have a power level of 1.

items.name: Oak Wand
items.description: A sturdy oak wand that offers reliability far beyond its humble appearance.
items.extract: The Oak wand is a power level 3 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 oak logs, 3 anima-infused bark, and 2 wool thread.

items.name: Obsidian Cape
items.description: Black as cooled lava, this cape radiates a faint, lingering heat. It provides a small boost to Defence.
items.extract: The obsidian cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the plate of pure obsidian vestige, which is a reward for completing the quest Brink of Extinction.

items.name: Obsidian Chest
items.description: Heavy obsidian chest armour designed for frontline warriors. Offers exceptional protection and resilience in close combat.
items.extract: The obsidian chest is a power level 7 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The vestige, fractured obsidian construct, is sold by Beartach - The Merchant.

items.name: Obsidian Device
items.description: An obsidian object, useful as little more than a paperweight. Can be ground and then smelted into pure obsidian.
items.extract: Obsidian device is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

items.name: Obsidian Helmet
items.description: A sturdy obsidian helmet designed for frontline warriors. Offers exceptional protection and resilience in close combat.
items.extract: Obsidian helmet is a power level 7 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The vestige, chipped obsidian construct, is sold by Beartach - The Merchant.

items.name: Obsidian Legs
items.description: Heavy obsidian leg armour designed for frontline warriors. Offers exceptional protection and resilience in close combat.
items.extract: Obsidian legs is a power level 7 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. The vestige, crushed obsidian construct, is sold by Beartach - The Merchant.

items.name: Onion
items.description: A vegetable that often brings a tear to the eye.
items.extract: Onions are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fried onions starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt onion at level 41. They can also be used to make lesser Focused Cooking potion, bowl of onions, and potted onion. They can be collected from onion (plant) in Fractured Plains, and Farmed from onion (Farming) grown from onion seeds. Onions can be used to make compost.

items.name: Onion Seeds
items.description:
Onion Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Onion seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Onion seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild onion (plant).

items.name: Opal
items.description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
items.extract: Opal is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining tin ore nodes, copper ore nodes, and stone boulders. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

items.name: Opal (decoration)
items.extract: An opal is a decoration that requires one opal. The opal decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Opal Emblem
items.description: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.
items.extract: An opal emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found at the western side of the Whispering Swamp.

items.name: Open Book
items.extract: An open book is a type of literature decoration that is unlocked after crafting leather for the first time.

items.name: Open Wooden Barrel
items.extract: An open wooden barrel is a decorative item unlocked by learning the PLAN: open wooden barrel recipe. The open wooden barrel does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Orange Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The orange adventurer's cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Orange Desert Cape
items.description: A Orange cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The orange desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the orange memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Orange Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The orange memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the orange desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Ore & Stone Storage
items.extract:
Ore & stone storage is a storage container for storing stones and ore, unlocked at 58 Mining. Unlike the lumber storage that will automatically pickup planks from a sawmill, the ore & stone storage will not automatically pick up ores and stone processed from a kiln, furnace, grindstone, stonecutter, or blast furnace. The ore & stone storage has the same capacity as an oak chest and less capacity than an iron chest, despite it both taking up more space and being made from materials available later in a player's progression.
Note that the ore & stone storage does not store rune essence, limestone, gypsum, ground materials, Gems, Salvage Piles, and clay or glass products.

items.name: Ornate Golden Scarab
items.extract: Ornate Golden Scarab is a drop from the Kalphite Queen, but was mistakenly added to the game.

items.name: Ornate Maul Handle
items.description: A carved piece of wood decorated with metal ornaments; sturdy enough to swing a heavy granite head. Made of blightwood found in Bloodblight Swamp.
items.extract: The ornate maul handle is an artefact. The ornate maul handle is one of the components used in making the granite maul after the quest Granite Mauled.

items.name: Outer Corner 45° Stairs
items.extract: Outer corner 45° stairs are constructed objects that are used in corners of a house to provide a path to an upper floor. It may be useful to use one or more beams to guide the stairs to a higher level.

items.name: Padded Cloth
items.description: A strong and lightweight crafting material.
items.extract:
Padded cloth is both a decorative item used in building as well as a material for other items, such as armours and tools.
Padded cloth requires one rough cloth and one wool cloth.  It is crafted at a loom with the loom harness upgrade built and placed near to the loom itself.

items.name: Padded Cloth Bin
items.extract: A padded cloth bin is a decoration that is unlocked by creating padded cloth.

items.name: Padded Cloth Pile
items.extract: A padded cloth pile is a decoration that is unlocked by creating wool cloth.

items.name: Paladin Platelegs
items.description: Sturdy leg armour worn by the paladins of Saradomin.
items.extract: Paladin platelegs are a power level 4 armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Paladin's Helm
items.description: A metal helm, worn by paladins in service to the church of Saradomin.
items.extract: The Paladin's helm is a power level 4 helmet that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Paladin's Platebody
items.description: A heavy chestplate worn by the paladins of Saradomin.
items.extract: Paladin's platebody is a power level 4 platebody that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Pan Rack
items.extract: A pan rack is an indoor-only constructed item, unlocked after reaching level 11 Cooking. The pan rack can be placed indoors or outdoors, and must also be placed on a vertical surface.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks furniture piece Pan Rack in the building menu.

items.name: Parts of a Sinister-Looking Staff
items.description: Although damaged beyond repair, this staff seethes with ancient power. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Parts of a sinister-looking staff is a vestige that unlocks creation of the draconic staff. This is found in a chest, located north-west of the Skeklac Kara vault's entrance.

items.name: PATTERN: Bloodblight Cape
items.extract: PATTERN: Bloodblight cape is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the Bloodblight cape.

items.name: PATTERN: Bramblemead Cape
items.extract: PATTERN: Bramblemead cape is a consumable item that unlocks the creation of the Bramblemead cape.

items.name: PATTERN: Fell Cape
items.extract: The fell cape pattern is a blueprint for making the Fellhollow cape. This blueprint is found in Hope's Fall near the middle part of the dragon skeleton. Players will need to cast Rocksplosion or mine the stone boulders to get to the chest.

items.name: PATTERN: Fractured Cape
items.extract: PATTERN: fractured cape is a consumable item that unlocks the creation of the fractured cape.  The blueprint is within a chest at the north-north-east tip of the Fractured Plains.

items.name: PATTERN: Stormtouched Cape
items.extract: PATTERN: stormtouched cape is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the stormtouched cape.

items.name: PATTERN: Whispering Cape
items.extract: PATTERN: whispering cape is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the whispering cape. The blueprint is found in Whispering Swamp, within a chest tucked into an alcove, slightly north of the cave entrance where you find the garou druid during the Goblin Diplomacy quest.

items.name: Peach
items.description: Tasty fruit.
items.extract: Peaches are a consumable food item that provides 15 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 3 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried peach starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt peach at level 41. They can also be used to make bowl of peaches. They can be transmuted by casting Bones to Peaches on animal bones.

items.name: Personal Chest (chest)
items.extract: A personal chest is a type of buildable storage that was released in the closed Alpha Test and was reintroduced with the Fellhollow update. Players can access the contents of their chest (cast by the Personal Chest spell) through it.

items.name: Pharaoh's Sceptre
items.description: This ancient and powerful weapon lets the wielder channel its sovereign authority into mind-controlling powers.
items.extract:
The pharaoh's sceptre is a power level 7 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is learned from the Icthlarian fetish, the reward from the quest Contact!. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is Royal Mandate: While holding the Sceptre, the wielder is able to use the Confuse spell without consuming runes. Its special action is Sworn Servant: This summons Buddy, a friendly kalphite to attack and distract enemies in combat. Buddy can be used for up to 3 minutes as long as it is still alive, and will take another five minutes for it to respawn when recasting the sceptre's special action. However, due to Hollow Vessel, while Buddy is active, the wielder regains stamina much slower (90% slower than normal). Fighting while Buddy is out can be dangerous due to the lack of stamina regen.

Bug: There is currently a bug where Buddy will not respawn, or spawn in a online world.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * SWORN SERVANT Summon a FRIENDLY KALPHITE to ATTACK and distract enemies in combat. Resummoning while your summon is still active will RE-SUMMON it with the SAME HEALTH as when dispelled. * ROYAL MANDATE Cast Confuse without consuming RUNES while wielding the PHARAOH'S SCEPTRE * HOLLOW VESSEL While a SUMMON is ACTIVE, you regain STAMINA slower than normal.

items.name: Phoenix Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The phoenix ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game and was later replaced with a live version called the ring of life.

items.name: Piece of Padded Cloth
items.extract: A piece of padded cloth is a decoration that is unlocked by creating padded cloth.

items.name: Piece of Rough Cloth
items.extract: A piece of rough cloth is a decoration that is unlocked by creating rough cloth.

items.name: Piece of Wool Cloth
items.extract: A piece of wool cloth is a decoration that is unlocked by creating wool cloth.

items.name: Pink Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The pink adventurer's cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Pink Desert Cape
items.description: A Pink cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The pink desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the pink memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Pink Dyad Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The pink dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Pink Hex Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The pink hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Pink Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The pink memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the pink desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Pioneer's Cape
items.description: A cape worn by Ashenfall's first explorers.
items.extract: The pioneer's cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft. Its recipe is given to Early Adopters who purchased the game during Early Access.

items.name: Pioneer's Scarf
items.description: A scarf worn by Ashenfall's first explorers.
items.extract: The pioneer's scarf is a decorative piece of Ranged Armour, who's recipe is given to Early Adopters who purchased the game during Early Access. It provides no defensive stats and costs nothing to make at a crafting table, but still counts towards the set effect like all other pieces of Ranged armour.

items.name: Pioneer's Tapestry
items.extract: The pioneer's tapestry is a decoration unlocked by Early Adopters who purchased the game during Early Access.

items.name: Pipe Cactus Seeds
items.description:
A Pipe Cactus seed. Pop it into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Umbral Sand plots.
items.extract: Pipe cactus seeds are a type of Umbral Sands seed, used in the Farming skill. Pipe cactus seeds can be used to grow Pipe Cactus (Farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a yew farming plot.

items.name: Plan Bundle: Armadyl Flags
items.description: A collection of decoration plans.
items.extract: Plan bundle: Armadyl flags is a container that is purchased from the Evil Emporium for 250 infernal fragments, providing recipes to create different types of flags once opened.

items.name: Plan Bundle: Bandos Flags
items.description: A collection of decoration plans.

items.name: Plant Cure
items.description: Used to cure diseased plants and bring them back to a healthy state.
items.extract: Plant cure is a potion that cures diseased plants and provides 2 Farming experience when used. It is made with 2 weeds, animal bone, and clean water in a stone range or a cooking range (unlike the other potions made in a brewing cauldron). It is learned at level 3 Farming and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Plate of Pure Obsidian
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The plate of pure obsidian is a vestige that unlocks the obsidian cape. It's a reward for completing the quest Brink of Extinction.

items.name: Poison Ichor
items.description: This stuff looks nasty.
items.extract: Poison ichor is a basic item that comes from killing wild jade vines and putrid rats.

items.name: Poisoned Adamant Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from adamant, coated in Weapon Poison.
items.extract: Poisoned adamant arrows are a power level 7 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Poison, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Poison or to craft Poisonous Arrows.

items.name: Poisoned Bronze Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from bronze coated in Weapon Poison.
items.extract: Poisoned bronze arrows are bronze arrows that are coated with weapon poison. Targets that are hit by a poisoned bronze arrow will be inflicted with the Poison debuff, damaging the enemy by 5% of their max health for six seconds. Like other poisoned arrows, the icon will have a Poison icon placed on the top right of the arrow to distinguish itself from regular arrows.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Poison, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Poison or to craft Poisonous Arrows.

items.name: Portal Reward Pack
items.extract: A portal reward pack is a reward for completing the quest, What's Theirs is Mine!, containing the following:

items.name: Postbox
items.extract: The postbox is a buildable scenery item found in the "Crafting" building tab, given to players as a reward for completing the Letters for the Dead secondary quest. The post box can also give you a letter. Delivering the letter give you 50 soul fragments.

items.name: Potato
items.description: Definitely not a carrot.
items.extract: Potatoes are a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into baked potato starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt potato at level 27. They can be gathered from potato (plant)s in Bramblemead Valley and potato (Farming) from potato seeds. Potatoes can be used to make compost.

items.name: Potato Seeds
items.description:
A Potato Seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract:
Potato seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Potato seeds can be used to grow potatoes in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot.
Planting potato seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Potato seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild potato plants.

items.name: Pots on a Bench
items.extract: Pots on a bench is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has completed A Room With A Garou.

items.name: Potted Dwellberry Bush
items.extract: A potted dwellberry bush is a plant decoration that is learned from a PLAN: potted dwellberry bush found in chests across the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Potted Onion
items.extract: A potted onion is a plant decoration that is learned from a PLAN: potted onion found in chests across the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Pottery Wheel
items.extract: The pottery wheel is used to form unfired forms from clay, which can then be processed into a usable form at a kiln. Players must receive clay in their inventory for the first time to unlock the recipe for building the pottery wheel.

items.name: Primordial Heart
items.description: The heart of a nature spirit, you hunted this for [[Vannaka]]. He wants three of them.
items.extract: Primordial hearts are a quest item dropped by nature spirits and used in the quest The Wild Hunt. After the quest, three hearts can be turned in to Vannaka for 50 soul fragments.

items.name: Pristine Armoured Catfish
items.description: An unusually large Armoured Catfish, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
items.extract: Pristine armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt catfish at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Armoured Catfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a Raw Armoured Catfish.

items.name: Pristine Armoured Catfish Trophy
items.extract: The pristine armoured catfish trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Armoured Catfish from a rod fishing spot in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Pristine Beltfish
items.extract: Pristine beltfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 steamed beltfish. It can also be used to make Pristine Beltfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw beltfish.

items.name: Pristine Beltfish Trophy
items.extract: The pristine beltfish  Trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Beltfish from a rod fishing spot in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Pristine Desert Sole
items.extract: Pristine desert sole is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 sun baked sole. It can also be used to make Pristine Desert Sole Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using monkfish bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw desert sole.

items.name: Pristine Desert Sole Trophy
items.extract: The pristine desert sole trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Desert Sole from a rod fishing spot in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Pristine Herring
items.description: An unusually large Herring, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.

It can also be used to make Pristine Herring Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using anchovy bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw herring.

items.name: Pristine Herring Trophy
items.extract: The pristine herring trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine herring from a rod fishing spot in Ghornfell.

items.name: Pristine Infernal Eel Trophy

It can also be used to make a Pristine Lobster Trophy. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the pristine variant of a raw lobster.

items.name: Pristine Lobster Trophy

Using shrimp bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw sardine.

items.name: Pristine Sardine Trophy
items.extract: The pristine sardine trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine sardine from a rod fishing spot in Brynmoor.

items.name: Pristine Trout
items.description: An unusually large Trout, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
items.extract: Pristine trout is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 grilled trout starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into 3 grilled trout at level 27. It can also be used to make Pristine Trout Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using feather bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw trout.

items.name: Pristine Trout Trophy
items.extract: The pristine trout trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a pristine trout from a rod fishing spot in Brynmoor.

items.name: Pristine Undead Bass
items.description: An unusually large Undead Bass, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
items.extract: Pristine undead bass is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Grilled Undead Bass starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt undead bass at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Bass Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using spooky bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw undead bass.

items.name: Pristine Undead Bass Trophy
items.extract: The pristine undead bass trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Undead Bass from a rod fishing spot in Fellhollow.

items.name: Pristine Undead Eel
items.description: An unusually large Undead Eel, worthy of putting it on the wall as trophy or cook it to gain more food.
items.extract: Pristine undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Braised Undead Eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt undead eel at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Eel Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lobster bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the pristine variant of a raw undead eel.

items.name: Pristine Undead Eel Trophy
items.extract: The pristine undead eel trophy is a decoration unlocked by catching a Pristine Undead Eel from a rod fishing spot in Fellhollow.

items.name: Pumpkin
items.description: More treat than trick. Can be cooked by itself or used as an ingredient in cooking meals.
items.extract: Pumpkins are a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roast pumpkin starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt pumpkin at level 50. They can be gathered from pumpkin (plant)s in Fellhollow and Dowdun Reach and Farmed from Pumpkin (Farming) grown from pumpkin seeds. Pumpkins can not be used as an item in a compost bin, however can be used in a super compost bin.

items.name: Pumpkin Seeds
items.description:
Pumpkin Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
items.extract:
Pumpkin seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Pumpkin seeds can be used to grow Pumpkin (farming) in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in Willow Farming Plot.
Planting pumpkin seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming, and can be obtained from harvesting wild pumpkin (plant)s.

items.name: Pumpkin Soup
items.description: Sweet, yet savory.
items.extract: Pumpkin soup is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 75 sustenance as well as the perk Soul Food, which restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 300 seconds. It is made with roast pumpkin, baked potato, and fried cabbage in a cooking range.

items.name: Pumpkin Soup (decoration)
items.extract: Pumpkin soup is a decoration that is first unlocked by successfully cooking a pumpkin soup.

items.name: Pumpkin Spice Infusion
items.description: A seasonal treat, popular with some.
items.extract: Pumpkin spice infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 80 hydration and grants the perk Soul Food, which restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, roast pumpkin, and irit in a cooking range.

items.name: Pumpkin Spice Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A pumpkin spice infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a Pumpkin Spice Infusion.

items.name: Pungent Omelette
items.description: Tastes much better than it's[sic] name suggests.
items.extract: Pungent omelette is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perk Fungal Fortitude, which reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with fried cabbage, grilled mushrooms, and fried egg in a cooking range.

items.name: Pungent Omelette (decoration)
items.extract: A pungent omelette is a decoration that is unlocked by cooking a pungent omelette.

items.name: Purified King's Token
items.description: A ritually cleansed token, containing a piece of another world.
items.extract: Purified king's token is an item used in Dog Days. It is acquired after purifying the Tainted King's Token at Lougrim's Shrine.

items.name: Purple Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The purple adventurer's cape is a simple yet elegant cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Purple Chandelier
items.extract: A purple chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

items.name: Purple Desert Cape
items.description: A Purple cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The purple desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the purple memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Purple Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The purple memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the Purple Desert Cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: Purple Standing Torch
items.extract: Purple standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

items.name: Purple Standing Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The purple standing torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Fellhollow region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the purple standing torch.

items.name: Purple Torch
items.description: A trusty lightsource - now in purple.
items.extract: The purple torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished purple remnants.

items.name: Purple Wall-mounted Torch
items.extract: Purple wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: Purple Standing Torch recipe at the Chaktan Kara vault.

items.name: Purple Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The purple wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Dowdun Reach region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the purple wall-mounted torch.

items.name: Quarrymaster Potion
items.description:
PERK: Quarrymaster II

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of Mining by 66%
items.extract: Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster II, which reduces the stamina cost of Mining by 66% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with irit, ground limestone, and glass vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Queenslayer's Reward Pack
items.description: Contains the spoils of your battle against Kuldra.
items.extract:
The Queenslayer's Reward Pack is a reward pack given to you after defeating Kuldra, the God-Eater in the Scorned Wilderness raid. To acquire this item, players must hand in Kuldra's Head to Commander Zilyana and players can acquire this reward pack multiple times by completing multiple raid runs.
Through this, you can acquire pieces of Dragon equipment and a new wand. It is important to note that each opening of the pack ensures one drop from its table.

items.name: Rain Catcher
items.extract:
The rain catcher is a Farming building used to convert rainwater to clean water. The rain catcher can hold up to 300 units of clean water and collects 10 units of water per second whilst raining. Players cannot open the rain catcher's interface unless there is at least one unit of rain stored inside the catcher. 
You Require level 6 Farming to unlock the ability to build this.
Note that rain catchers cannot be destroyed whilst there is water stored inside.

items.name: Ram Horn
items.description: A large horn belonging to an animal. Used in crafting.
items.extract: Ram horns are dropped by rams, which are found in the Stormtouched Highlands. Two ram horns are required in the quest Dog Days.

items.name: Ranged Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Ranged is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Ranged cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Ranged. It can be crafted at the mystic forge.
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Ranger Hat
items.description: Ranger head gear. Wearing this gives you the urge to rob from the rich to help the poor for some reason.
items.extract:
Ranger hat is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the Simply Splendid Feather vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: Ranger Tights
items.description: Ranger leg gear that makes you feel both agile and slightly rebellious.
items.extract:
Ranger tights is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the tastefully torn tights vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: Ranger Tunic
items.description: Ranger armour that's as dangerous as it is dapper!
items.extract:
Ranger tunic is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the Slightly Chaffing Chestguard vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: Rat Roast
items.description: A survivalist's meal. Just pretend it's something else.
items.extract: Rat roast is a consumable food item that provides 20 sustenance when eaten. It can be cooked at either a campfire or a grill.

items.name: Ravanna's Ring
items.description: This item loses durability over time when equipped.
items.extract: Ravanna's ring is a ring that is a quest reward for completing the A Melody Remembered secondary quest. Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring has a 15-20% chance to spawn a corpse cotton plant where enemies were slain, consuming 1,000 durability in the process.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: After KILLING an enemy, there is a chance for a CORPSE COTTON FLOWER to grow where they fell.

items.name: Raw Anchovies
items.description: Doesn't look like much now, but sear it on a bonfire and receive a delicious treat.
items.extract: Raw anchovies are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into seared anchovies starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt anchovies at level 41. They can also be used to make anchovy bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a wool net in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

items.name: Raw Armoured Catfish
items.description: Should be shelled before being braised.
items.extract: Raw armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt catfish at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine armoured catfish.

items.name: Raw Beltfish
items.description: You half expect it to start wriggling again.
items.extract: Raw beltfish is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into steamed beltfish. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine beltfish.

items.name: Raw Bestial Meat
items.description: Raw meat from beasts.
items.extract: Raw bestial meat is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into flank steak starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt flank at level 41. It is dropped by wolves and dire wolves in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

items.name: Raw Bird Meat
items.description: Freshly harvested from avian creatures. A staple for cooking.
items.extract: Raw bird meat is a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into fillet starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt fillet at level 12. It is dropped by chickens in Bramblemead Valley and Dowdun Reach, and terrorbirds in the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Raw Desert Sole
items.description: You half expect it to start wriggling again.
items.extract: Raw desert sole is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into sun baked sole. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using monkfish bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine desert sole.

items.name: Raw Farm Meat
items.description: Raw meat from farm animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.
items.extract: Raw farm meat is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into steak starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt steak at level 27. It is dropped by cows in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, and Dowdun Reach, sheep in Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach, and rams in Stormtouched Highlands and Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Raw Game Meat
items.description: Raw meat from wild animals. It can be cooked on a campfire.
items.extract: Raw game meat is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into haunch starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt haunch at level 27. It is dropped by deer in Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, and Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Raw Giant Krill
items.description: A colossal crustacean. A little soggy now, so best dry it.
items.extract: Raw giant krill is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried giant krill starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt giant krill at level 50. It can also be used to make giant krill bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a mystic net in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Raw Herring
items.description: Cooked on an anvil, which may or may not be a red herring.
items.extract: Raw herring is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked herring starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt herring at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using anchovy bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine herring.

items.name: Raw Infernal Eel
items.description: Wriggly no more. Will need to be smoked before it goes near your palate.
items.extract: Raw infernal eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into smoked infernal eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt infernal eel at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using giant krill bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine infernal eel.

items.name: Raw Lobster
items.description: Don't worry, it's not alive anymore. Roast for best results.
items.extract: Raw lobster is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roasted lobster starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt lobster at level 50. It can also be used to make lobster bait. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the normal variant of a pristine lobster.

items.name: Raw Monkfish
items.description: Your mouth waters just looking at it.
items.extract: Raw monkfish is a power level 7 food that can be captured at net fishing spots in the Umbral Sands region. Monkfish are so-called on Ashenfall due to the goddess Elidinis. The Moon Garou, having never seen a monk, adopted the name after the goddess herself named them.

items.name: Raw Rat Meat
items.description: Tough, gamey meat that can be cooked and eaten.
items.extract: Raw rat meat is a Power Level 1 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into rat roast starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt rat roast at level 12. It is dropped by giant rats in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley and vaults, rat kings in vaults, putrid rats and plague kings in the Whispering Swamp and the Bloodblight Swamp, and chinchompas in the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Raw Salmon
items.description: While it might be edible now, you'll need to fry it in this game.
items.extract: Raw salmon is a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried salmon starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt salmon at level 41. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an oak rod in Fractured Plains at level 3 Fishing. Using feathered lure increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine salmon.

items.name: Raw Sardine
items.description: A small fish that was brought into this world to be fried and eaten.
items.extract: Raw sardine is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into fried sardine starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt sardine at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using shrimp bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine sardine.

items.name: Raw Shrimp
items.description: Schrodinger's shrimp: could end up burnt or fried.
items.extract: Raw shrimp is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into sauteed shrimp starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt shrimp at level 27. They can also be used to make shrimp bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a coarse net in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley.

items.name: Raw Trout
items.description: Grill this trout on a fire. You will thank us later.
items.extract: Raw trout is a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled trout starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt trout at level 27. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally an ash rod in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley at level 3 Fishing. Using feather bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine trout.

items.name: Raw Undead Bass
items.description: It may not look edible, but trust us: grill it and you're in for a treat.
items.extract: Raw undead bass is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into grilled undead bass starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead bass at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using spooky bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead bass.

items.name: Raw Undead Eel
items.description: A dead undead eel. We suggest you braise it.
items.extract: Raw undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised undead eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead eel at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lobster bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine undead eel.

items.name: Red Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The red adventurer's cape is a cape that is unlocked when studying its vestige, moth eaten red cloth. The cape takes no materials to craft.

items.name: Red Chandelier
items.extract: A red chandelier is a constructed object that can be built only indoors, and requires the player to place it under a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., square tile, square foundation, etc.)

items.name: Red Desert Cape
items.description: A Red cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The red desert cape is a cape that takes no materials to craft, but is not currently in the game. The recipe is unlocked after studying the red memory of Menaphos vestige, which is also currently unavailable in-game.

items.name: Red Dragon Hide
items.description: Obtained from felling lesser red dragons. Can be processed at the tannery.
items.extract: Red dragon hide is a basic material dropped by red dragons which can be tanned to create red dragonhide leather.

items.name: Red Dragon Trophy
items.extract: The Red Dragon Trophy is a decoration that can be obtained through the Deluxe Edition.

items.name: Red Dragonhide Body
items.description: Agile chest armour stitched from red dragonhide, fit for the finest of archers.
items.extract: The Red dragonhide body is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Red Dragonhide Coif
items.description: Headgear made of red dragonhide, fit for the finest of archers.
items.extract: Red dragon coif is a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Red Dragonhide Leather
items.description: Made by tanning red dragonhide. A key crafting component for armour.
items.extract: Red dragonhide leather is a processed material created from tanning red dragon hide.

items.name: Red Dragonhide Legs
items.description: Headgear made of red dragonhide, fit for the finest of archers.
items.extract: Red dragonhide legs are a power level 7 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench

items.name: Red Dyad Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The red dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Red Hex Cape
items.description: A cape made for its looks more than any kind of magical potency.
items.extract: The red hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

items.name: Red Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The red memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the red desert cape. It is found in Umbral Sands chests.

items.name: Red Standing Torch
items.extract: Red standing torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red standing torch recipe.

items.name: Red Standing Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The red standing torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Fellhollow region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the red standing torch.

items.name: Red Topaz
items.description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
items.extract: Red topaz is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining silver ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

items.name: Red Topaz (decoration)
items.extract: A red topaz is a decoration that requires one red topaz. The red topaz decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Red Torch
items.description: A trusty lightsource - now in red.
items.extract: The red torch is a cosmetic variation of the torch tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. It can be unlocked by studying extinguished red remnants.

items.name: Red Wall-mounted Torch
items.extract: Red wall-mounted torch is a type of furniture that is created by learning the PLAN: red wall-mounted torch recipe.

items.name: Red Wall-mounted Torch (Dowdun Reach)
items.extract: The red wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has unlocked the Dowdun Reach region. Players do not need a recipe to unlock the red wall-mounted torch.

items.name: Redberries
items.description: Gathered from bushes, eat them to gain a small amount of sustenance.
items.extract: Redberries are a consumable food item that provides 5 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 1 ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into dried redberries starting at Cooking level 1, and not burnt into burnt redberries at level 12. They can also be used to make redberry infusion, as well as some potions and decorations. They can be collected from redberry bushes in Temple Woods and Bramblemead Valley, Farmed from redberries (Farming) grown from redberry seeds, and found in chests in Ghornfell.

items.name: Redberry Crunchies
items.description: It smells quite fruity.
items.extract: Redberry crunchies are a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 35 sustenance. They are made with dried redberries and wheat in a stone range or a cooking range; however, a player must first interact with a stone range to learn the recipe.

items.name: Redberry Glazed Roast Flank
items.description: A delicious flank steak, covered in a fruity redberry glaze. Delightfully delicious!
items.extract: Redberry glazed roast flank is a consumable food item that can be cooked by combining redberries with raw bestial meat at a cooking pot, and provides moderate sustenance and 5 lifeward when eaten. There is also a 5% chance to produce a rat roast whilst making redberry glazed roast flank.

items.name: Redberry Infusion
items.description: A refreshing, fruity drink. Good for hydration.
items.extract: Redberry infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Quenched, which reduces thirst drain by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water and redberries in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe. It is used in Victoria sponge cake.

items.name: Redberry Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A redberry infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a redberry infusion.

items.name: Redberry Roast Rat
items.description: A juicy piece of roasted meat with a tangy redberry glazing. Tasty!
items.extract: Redberry roast rat is a consumable food item that provides 30 health and 45 sustenance. It is made with rat roast and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Redberry Seeds
items.description:
A redberry seed. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract:
Redberry seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Redberry seeds can be used to grow redberries in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in an ash farming plot.
Planting redberry seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Redberry seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild redberry bushes.

items.name: Refined Obsidian
items.description: An object of pure, refined obsidian.
items.extract: Refined obsidian is a basic item processed from nine ground obsidian at the blast furnace.

items.name: Regicide Reward Pack
items.description: A reward pack for completing Regicide.
items.extract: The Regicide Reward Pack is a reward for completing the Regicide quest, containing the Dragonslayer's Cape, Dragon Kiteshield, and Queenslayer's Reward Pack.

items.name: Reinforced Body
items.description: A heavy chestplate made from Leather and Bone.
items.extract: Reinforced body is a power level 2 armour piece that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Reinforced Helmet
items.description: Protect your noggin with this basic headgear made from leather and bone.
items.extract: A reinforced helmet is a power level 2 armour piece that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Reinforced Legs
items.description: Heavy platelegs made from Leather and Bone.
items.extract: Reinforced legs are a power level 2 armour piece that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Relentless Infusion
items.description: A tasty tipple that'll put a quiver in your quiver.
items.extract: Relentless infusion is a consumable drink item that provides 40 hydration and grants the perk Relentless Ranger, which reduces the stamina cost of ranged attacks by 33% for 300 seconds. It is made with clean water, animal hide scraps, and harralander in a stone range or cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Teamonger at level 14 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Relentless Infusion (decoration)
items.extract: A relentless infusion is a decoration that is first unlocked by creating a relentless infusion.

items.name: Remnants of a Rotting Robe
items.icon: VESTIGE: Remnants of a Rotting Robe.png
items.description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The remnants of a rotting robe is a vestige that unlocks the necromancer's robe top. It is obtained from Death's Exchange for 400 soul fragments.

items.name: Remnants of a Shattered Skull
items.description: A skull, obliterated by a particularly nasty weapon. If you study it, perhaps you might learn something.
items.extract: Remnants of a shattered skull is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the Skullsplitter.

items.name: Restless Ghosts Reward Pack
items.description: A cloth shoulder bag.
items.extract: A Restless Ghosts reward pack is a quest reward after completing Restless Ghosts.  Upon opening the pack, players will receive a volume-one variant of the Tome of Cooking, Tome of Woodcutting, Tome of the Artisan, and Tome of Mining.

items.name: Reward Pack: Brynmoor Bronze
items.description: A reward for finishing Brynmoor Agility Course with a bronze medal.

items.name: Reward Pack: Brynmoor Gold

items.extract: Reward pack: Dowdun Reach bronze is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Dowdun Reach Agility course, Tower Climb.

items.name: Reward Pack: Dowdun Reach Gold
items.description: A reward for finishing Dowdun Reach Agility Course with a gold medal.
items.extract: Reward pack: Dowdun Reach gold is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Dowdun Reach Agility course, Tower Climb.

items.extract: Reward pack: Fellhollow silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Fellhollow Agility course, Grave Run.

items.description: A reward for finishing Ghornfell Agility Course with a bronze medal.

items.description: A reward for finishing Umbral Sands Agility Course with a gold medal.
