items.name: Reward Pack: Umbral Sands Silver
items.description: A reward for finishing Umbral Sands Agility Course with a silver medal.
items.extract: Reward pack: Umbral Sands silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Umbral Sands Agility course, Lava Fields.

items.name: Ring of Life
items.extract: The ring of life is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring grants players automatic teleportation to their bed or bed roll upon reaching 10% health. Once that happens, the ring becomes broken, requiring 2 Vault Core to repair. The recipe is unlocked through Death's Exchange for 800 soul fragments.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: When close to DEATH, TELEPORTS you to your current BED

items.name: Ring of Pursuit
items.description: A magical ring that makes you sneakier.
items.extract: The ring of pursuit is a trinket, made on the jeweler's bench. Its special effect reduces animals’ awareness of your presence by 80%. For example, if the awareness radius of the deer is 50 metres, wearing the trinket will decrease the radius by 40 metres.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: ANIMALS are less AWARE of your PRESENCE

items.name: Ring of Recoil
items.extract: The ring of recoil is a ring that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring deals percentage of damage received back to attackers. The damage dealt is equal to 50% of the damage taken, rounded up.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: A PERCENTAGE of DAMAGE received is DEALT back to ATTACKERS

items.name: Roast Dinner
items.description: It's not even Sunday.
items.extract: Roast dinner is a consumable food item that provides 80 health and 80 sustenance as well as the perk Coagulated, which reduces Bleed buildup for 300 seconds. It is made with flank steak, baked potato, and dried redberries in a cooking range.

items.name: Roast Dinner (decoration)
items.extract: A roast dinner is a decoration that is first unlocked by successfully cooking a roast dinner.

items.name: Roast Pumpkin
items.description: A tough but tasty treat.
items.extract: Roast pumpkin is a consumable food item that provides 20 health and 25 sustenance, as well as the perk Soul Food, which restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 150 seconds. It can be cooked from pumpkin at either a campfire or a grill, and is used in dubious meat pie, pumpkin soup, pumpkin spice infusion, glazed pumpkin sandwich, and Umbral kebab.

items.name: Roasted Lobster
items.description: Does wonders for your hunger bar. Grants the Sea Legs perk.
items.extract: Roasted lobster is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 20 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Legs, which makes you immune to the slowing effects of water for 120 seconds. It is made by cooking raw lobster on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in fish fry.

items.name: Rolled Moon Garou Carpet 01
items.extract: Rolled Moon Garou carpet 01

items.name: Rolled Moon Garou Carpet 02
items.extract: Rolled Moon Garou carpet 02

items.name: Rotridden Cow Trophy
items.extract: The Rotridden Cow Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Rotridden Rat Trophy
items.extract: The Rotridden Rat Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Rotsworn Zombie Trophy
items.extract: The Rotsworn Zombie Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Rotten Farming Tool
items.extract: The rotten farming tool is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Fellhollow. There is a 5/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the undead spade recipe.

items.name: Rough Cloth
items.description: A versatile textile used for crafting equipment and furniture. It is woven at a loom from linen thread.
items.extract: Rough cloth is created with a loom, requiring three coarse thread. Rough cloth is used primarily for constructing rugs and Wizard Armour.

items.name: Rough Cloth Bin
items.extract: A rough cloth bin is a decoration that is unlocked by creating rough cloth.

items.name: Rough Cloth Pile
items.extract: A rough cloth pile is a decoration that is unlocked by creating rough cloth.

items.name: Round Oak Table
items.extract: The round oak table is a type of furniture decoration.

items.name: Round Table
items.extract: Round table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the round table.

items.name: Ruby
items.description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
items.extract: Ruby is a gemstone that can be obtained from mining Mithril Ore. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe, either directly or by using the Rocksplosion spell, which also requires the appropriate pickaxe.

items.name: Rune Altar
items.extract:
The rune altar is a crafting table used to craft runes, which are required to cast spells. To make runes, players need rune essence, which comes from essence geysers around the world, as well as from goblin packs, garou packs, and vault guardians. It does not have any special conditions to function.
Runes can be auto-crafted quickly or attuned by playing a simple minigame for more experience.

items.name: Rune Arrow
items.description: Rune arrows are prized for their exceptional flight and striking power.
items.extract: Rune arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench, and can be used to craft rune barbed arrow, poisoned rune arrow, and rune fire arrow, though players may wish to simply use Adamant Arrow as they possess the same base damage.

items.name: Rune Bar
items.description: A magically resonant metal used for crafting weapons and armour.
items.extract: Rune bars are a processed material created with three Runite Ore and three Luminite Ore inside a blast furnace.

items.name: Rune Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with tips forged from runite.
items.extract: Rune barbed arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that can be crafted with a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Rune Bolt
items.description: Carefully forged rune crossbow bolts that hit hard and fly true.
items.extract: The Rune Bolts are a power level 8 ammunition crafted at a Fletching Bench. Despite being power level 8, these bolts deal the same damage as adamant bolts.

items.name: Rune Crossbow
items.description: A precision-engineered rune crossbow that delivers powerful, accurate shots at range.
items.extract: A rune crossbow is a power level 8 crossbow crafted with a fletching bench.

items.name: Rune Crossbow Limbs
items.description: Expertly forged rune limbs that provide exceptional strength and durability when fitted to a crossbow.
items.extract: Rune crossbow limbs are used for crafting a rune crossbow with a fletching bench.

items.name: Rune Dagger
items.description: A razor-sharp rune dagger prized for its speed, precision, and deadly effectiveness.
items.extract: The Rune Dagger is a power level 8 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Rune Essence
items.description: A mysterious porous rock used as a base for powerful runes.
items.extract:
Rune essence can be gathered by mining rune essence stones surrounding the geysers around Ashenfall. Some spawn with rocks on the ground that you can easily gather from. The floating rocks require being hit (most easily with an arrow or an attack from a staff), and they will then fall to the ground to be mined. Alternatively, players can cast Rocksplosion whilst aiming at the floating rocks and can collect rune essence without affecting the pickaxe's durability.
Collecting rune essence in their inventory for the first time unlocks the rune altar.

items.name: Rune Fire Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from runite coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Rune fire arrows are a power level 8 ammunition that can be crafted with a fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Rune Greataxe
items.description: An imposing rune greataxe, for when a regular axe simply isn't sending a strong enough message.
items.extract: The rune greataxe is a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Rune Greatsword
items.description: A massive two-handed blade forged from runite. Few can wield such a weapon effectively, but fewer still can stand against it.
items.extract: The rune greatswordis a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Rune Helm
items.description: A sturdy rune helm built to withstand the chaos of close combat.
items.extract: Rune Helm is a power level 8 armour piece.

items.name: Rune Logging Axe
items.description: Crafted from durable runite, this axe bites deeply into timber and stands up to years of hard use.
items.extract: Rune Logging Axe is a power level 8 logging axe that can cut Magic Trees.

items.name: Rune Mace
items.description: A sturdy rune mace, designed to crush armour and bone alike with devastating force.
items.extract: The Rune Mace is a power level 8 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Rune Pickaxe
items.description: A masterfully forged pickaxe of pure runite, capable of breaking through even the toughest stone with ease.
items.extract: Rune Pickaxe is a power level 8 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, dealing 98 damage to minable ores, and 196 with a critical swing.

items.name: Rune Platebody
items.description: Thick rune plates forged into armour for the strongest of warriors.
items.extract: Rune Platebody is a power level 8 armour piece that can be crafted on the Armour Bench. To unlock the recipe, players need to have Rune Bar crafted.

items.name: Rune Platelegs
items.description: Durable rune platelegs designed for warriors who spend more time fighting than running.
items.extract: Rune Platelegs are a power level 8 armour piece.

items.name: Rune Scimitar
items.description: The curved rune blade flows effortlessly from one strike to the next.
items.extract: The rune scimitar is a power level 8 one-handed melee weapon that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Rune Shield
items.description: A rune shield forged to endure punishment that would leave lesser metal in pieces.
items.extract: Rune shield is a power level 8 shield.

items.name: Rune Spade
items.description: Whether digging gardening plots or unearthing treasure, this tool is built to last.
items.extract: A rune spade is a power level 8 spade. It is crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Rune Sword
items.description: A finely balanced rune sword, renowned for its strength, precision, and reliability in battle.
items.extract: The rune sword is a power level 8 one-handed melee weapon.

items.name: Rune Warhammer
items.description: A colossal rune warhammer, capable of shattering shields and crushing the strongest defences.
items.extract: The rune warhammer is a power level 8 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted with a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Rune Watering Can
items.description: A sturdy rune watering can, built to endure countless seasons of tending crops and gardens.
items.extract: The rune watering can is a power level 8 watering can created at the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Runecrafting Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Runecrafting is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Runecrafting cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Runecrafting. It can be crafted at the mystic forge.
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Runite Med Helm
items.description: A strong rune helm, for keeping important thoughts safely inside.
items.extract: The Runite Med Helm is a power level 8 helmet. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Rune Bar, 4 Black Dragon Leather, 1 Vis Cloth, 1 Harmonised Compound, and 1 Draconic Vis Wax. The recipe for this item is obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition and having a runite bar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Runite Ore
items.extract: Runite ore is a basic Mining material mined from Runite Ore Nodes, which can be found all over the Scorned Wilderness region. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of Luminite Ore in a blast furnace to produce Rune Bars.

items.name: Sacred Oil
items.description: Made from combining necrotic bonemeal and ectoplasm. Used as a crafting component.
items.extract: Sacred oil is one of the materials required for making power level 5 armour.

items.name: Saga (Icthlarin's Little Helper)
items.description: A book for writing down the passages found in the spires around the pyramid.
items.extract: A saga is a quest item given by Laguna - The Bard, where players need to find all 5 Ancient Garou Stone Slabs and interact with them to inscribe lyrics into the saga.

items.name: Salve Amulet
items.extract: The salve amulet is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the amulet increases damage against undead monsters by 17%. An effigy with a glowing ball at the Skekven Kara vault gives a stone dwarven tablet, which, after talking to Doric, grants a recipe for the salve amulet. Players will receive a salve crystal (required for creating the amulet) in return for this exchange. Loses 3 durability per hit on undead enemies, meaning it will break after ~833 hits.

items.name: Salve Crystal
items.description: A crystal that Doric obtained from a cave near the Salve River, back in Misthalin. Used in creating the Salve amulet.
items.extract: A salve crystal is a piece of crystal from the mainland of Gielinor that is known to have properties against undead. It is given to the players by Doric as a reward when completing Seeking Salvation. This crystal is required for the creation of the salve amulet. Players can obtain more by buying it from Death after Seeking Salvation is completed.

items.name: Sandstone
items.description: A building material; can be ground into sand.
items.extract: Sandstone is a basic Mining material mined from sandstone rocks, found scattered across the Fractured Plains, Stormtouched Highlands, Dowdun Reach and Umbral Sands. Sandstone is used in construction, alongside Stone and granite.

items.name: Sapphire
items.description: A rare gemstone used to craft enchanted jewellery.
items.extract: Sapphire is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining gold ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

items.name: Sapphire (decoration)
items.extract: A sapphire is a decoration that requires one sapphire. The sapphire decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Sapphire Emblem
items.description: One of three emblem keys required to unlock a statue.
items.extract: A sapphire emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found at the north-eastern side of the Stormtouched Highlands.

items.name: Saradomin Banner 01
items.extract: Saradomin banner 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin banner 01.

items.name: Saradomin Banner 02
items.extract: Saradomin banner 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin banner 02.

items.name: Saradomin Banner 03
items.extract: Saradomin banner 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin banner 03.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 01
items.extract: Saradomin flag 01 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 01.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 02
items.extract: Saradomin flag 02 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 02.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 03
items.extract: Saradomin flag 03 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 03.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 04
items.extract: Saradomin flag 04 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 04.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 05
items.extract: Saradomin flag 05 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 05.

items.name: Saradomin Flag 06
items.extract: Saradomin flag 06 is a decoration that is unlocked after studying the plan, PLAN: Saradomin flag 06.

items.name: Saradomin Symbol
items.description: It looks as if it is meant to sit on top of something.
items.extract: The Saradomin symbol is an item found during the Withering Heights quest and is used to repair the Saradomin altar, which is one of the 4 altars holding up the barrier around Emberwood Village. It is located in the water just below the altar, propped up against a rock.

items.name: Saradominist Cloak
items.description: Worn by followers of Saradomin, this cloak reflects a commitment to justice and the light of reason.
items.extract: The Saradominist cloak is a reward item from completing the activity, Statues of Saradomin. Like other capes, this shares the same melee, ranged, and magic defence.

items.name: Sauteed Sardines
items.description: Made by combining fried sardine and dried redberry. Grants the Sea Life perk.
items.extract: Sauteed sardines are a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 25 sustenance, as well as granting the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 600 seconds. They are made with fried sardine and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range; however, a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Sauteed Shrimp
items.description: A simple meal but one that will hold back the hunger.
items.extract: Sauteed shrimp is a consumable food item that provides 20 health and 10 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw shrimp on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in shrimp omelette and weak Focused Fishing potion.

items.name: Sawhorse
items.extract: A sawhorse is a constructed object that is unlocked once the player has completed A Room With A Garou. Note that the sawhorse is a decoration and cannot refine logs.

items.name: Sawmill
items.extract:
The sawmill is currently used to make ash planks and oak planks out of ash logs and oak logs. If a lumber storage is placed within five metres of the saw end, the planks will be deposited directly into it. It processes very slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks, or to fill it just before sleeping to process a whole stack instantly. It must not have a roof above it to function. 
The sawmill is unlocked upon obtaining a bronze bar.

items.name: Scarecrow
items.extract: A scarecrow is a buildable object unlocked at level 55 Farming. It is meant to prevent bird-type mobs from landing in your planters.

items.name: Scarecrow's Key
items.description: A key from a scarecrow in Ghornfell.
items.extract: A scarecrow's key is found in Ghornfell, where players will need this when scarecrow scavenging.

items.name: Scorch Leather
items.description: A light yet resilient leather, suited for survival in desert sands.
items.extract: Scorch leather is thicker and more resilient than hard leather. Players can create scorch leather with draconic leather, kalphite shell and a piece of acrid adhesive in an advanced tannery.

items.name: Scratchy Sackcloth
items.description: A ghostly bundle of scratchy sackcloth. It's unsettling to hold. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Scratchy Sackcloth is a vestige used to unlock the Shroud of Noggin. It can be obtained from the buried chest at the end of X Marks the Spot.

items.name: Sealed Wooden Crate
items.extract: Sealed wooden crates is a decoration that can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Seared Anchovies
items.description: Hold hunger back until lunch.
items.extract: Seared anchovies are a consumable food item that provide 30 health and 15 sustenance. They are made by cooking raw anchovies on either a campfire or a grill, and are used in berry drizzle pan-seared.

items.name: Seared Cactus Steak
items.description: You'd be surprised at how tasty an eight-ounce cactus, medium-rare can be.
items.extract: Cactus steak is a Power Level 5 consumable food item that provides 20 health and 20 sustenance when eaten. It can be cooked from cactus steak at either a campfire or grill. It requires Cooking level 50 to cook and 75 to not burn, otherwise creating burnt cactus Steak.

items.name: Selenic Veil
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The selenic veil is a vestige that unlocks the Lunar Garou hat.

items.name: Serrated Claw
items.description: A vicious claw once belonging to Imaru, which was used to try and rip you apart more than a few times. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The serrated claw is a vestige that unlocks the Imaru's talon. Unlike the head and ascension shard, the serrated claw drops to the floor.

items.name: Shadow Body
items.description: Durable armour worn by the [[Children of Shadows]].
items.extract:
Shadow body is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the limp black lining vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Shadow Chaps
items.description: Pliable leg armour worn by the [[Children of Shadows]].
items.extract:
Shadow chaps is a power level 6 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the dusty black pocket vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Shadow Cowl
items.description: A ranged headpiece worn by the [[Children of Shadows]].
items.extract:
The shadow cowl is a power level 6 armour piece that can be crafted on the armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and using the sodden black leather vestige from the Evil Emporium shop.

items.name: Shadow Crossbow
items.description: A crossbow made from black metal. Similar to those used by Black Knight snipers.
items.extract:
The shadow crossbow is a power level 6 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the sinister mechanism, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect deals 15% increased damage to weakpoints, however it has +25% Reload Duration, meaning it reloads slower than other crossbows.
When looking to maximize the damage done per metal or enchanted bolts, this is the pick. However, as it reloads slower than most other crossbows and the blurite crossbow and dorgeshuun crossbow reload faster than most other crossbows, it reloads significantly slower by comparison. One of the most useful aspects of a crossbow is the flinch that they cause per hit, and those are simply able to do that more often. The choice comes down to what bolt type is preferred, as the dorgeshuun can only fire bone bolts.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * Increased WEAK POINT DAMAGE * Slower FIRE RATE

items.name: Shadow Sword
items.description: This Greatsword exists between the realm of the living and the dead.
items.extract:
The shadow sword is a power level 5 greatsword created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the shard of smoky glass, dropped from a zogre. It is required to complete Doric's Quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is +25% damage against spectral enemies such as lost souls, ghost wolves, and soulstone sentinels.
It has almost exactly the same stats as other greatswords with Titan's Wrath as the one exception, and although it can be valuable in Fellhollow, extra damage to spectral enemies is useless outside of that region.

items.name: Shadowscale Cape
items.description: A cape worn by those from the lands of death and decay.
items.extract: The shadowscale cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige from skeletal marauders and rotsworn marauders, both dropping the vestige at a 1/100 drop rate.

items.name: Shadowscale Hood
items.description: Ranger Headgear worn by the Skeleton Archer's[sic] from Fellhollow.
items.extract: The shadowscale hood is a power level 5 ranged armour that can be crafted at a armour bench. Players can receive the vestige from skeletal archers at a 1/100 rate in Fellhollow.

items.name: Shard of Black Pauldron
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian platebody. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The shard of black pauldron is a vestige that unlocks the Black Knight platebody. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

items.name: Shard of Smoky Glass
items.extract: The shard of smoky glass is a vestige that players can consume, receiving the recipe to create the shadow sword. It should be noted that only Zogres found within Fellhollow are able to drop this item.

items.name: Shard of the Dreaming Stone
items.description: A piece of the broken Dreaming Stone in the Dowdun Reach nexus. It whispers if you listen closely.
items.extract: A shard of the Dreaming Stone is a quest item that is heavily featured in the Black Knight's Fortress. It is used to repair the Dreaming Stone when you have collected thirteen of them.

items.name: Shattered Black Blade
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian weapon. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The shattered black blade is a vestige that unlocks the black sword. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can also be obtained through vestige chests in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Shattered Black Blade (Umbral Sands)
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The shattered black blade is a vestige that unlocks the toktz-xil-ak. It can be received as a drop by KotHaar-Kal in Umbral Sands.

items.name: Shelf
items.extract: A shelf is a type of decoration that is unlocked by receiving ash planks in the player's inventory for the first time. The shelf must be placed on a vertical surface and can hold items such as a bowl of peaches, bowl of onions, and other small decorations.

items.name: Shimmerscale Powder
items.description: A shimmering iridescent powder. Its shifting hues are almost hypnotic.
items.extract: Shimmerscale powder is a processed material created at a grindstone from kalphite wings, its star-like shimmer making it a key ingredient in the creation of infinity cloth.

items.name: Shocking Plant Bulb
items.description: A bitter, green herb used to make potions.
items.extract: Shocking plant bulb is dropped by the wild lapulis vine, which is found in the Stormtouched Highlands.

items.extract: Short 30° thick beams are constructed items that are used to provide stability to walls, floors, and other constructed objects.

items.name: Short Horizontal Thick Beam
items.extract: Short horizontal thick beams are constructed objects where the length is about half the dimensions of a horizontal thick beam, measuring at 1.85 metres in length and 0.62 metres in diameter. Short horizontal thick beams may be useful for supporting short horizontal structures such as small square tiles, medium square tiles, or medium square/triangle foundations.

items.name: Short Horizontal Thin Beam
items.extract: Short horizontal thin beams are constructed objects where the dimensions are about half of the horizontal thick beam, measuring at 1.85 meters long and 0.32 metres in diameter. Short horizontal thin beams may be useful for supporting short horizontal structures such as small square tiles, medium square tiles, or medium square/triangle foundations.

items.name: Short Thin Pillar
items.extract: A short thin pillar is a beam, used to build stability with walls and other vertical structures.

items.name: Short Vertical Thick Beam
items.extract: Short vertical thick beams are constructed objects where the dimensions are half of the vertical thick beam, measuring at 2 meters long and 0.62 metres in diameter. Short vertical thick beams may be useful for supporting short structures such as small walls.

items.name: Short Vertical Thin Beam
items.extract: A short vertical thin beam is a beam, used to build stability with walls and other vertical structures.

items.name: Shrapnel
items.description: A collection of various sharp objects.
items.extract: Shrapnel can be found whilst killing terrorbirds and garou hunters found within the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Shred of Sunbleached Weave
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it
items.extract: Shred of sunbleached weave is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the Umbral Sands cape.

items.name: Shrimp Bait
items.description: Scraps of shrimp dressed to be eaten by fish. A Sardines favorite snack. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Shrimp bait is a power level 2 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching raw sardines. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Shrimp Omelette
items.description: Made by combining fried egg and sauté shrimp. Grants the Sea Legs perk.
items.extract: Shrimp omelette is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 15 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Legs, which makes you immune to the slowing effects of water for 600 seconds. It is made with fried egg and sauteed shrimp in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Shroud of Noggin
items.description: A ghostly sackcloth mask. Reduces Wither buildup while worn.
items.extract:
The shroud of Noggin is a piece of  Power level 1 head armour which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the scratchy sackcloth, found in a buried chest in Hope's Fall at the end of the unmarked activity X Marks the Spot.
Its special effect reduces the amount of Wither buildup the player takes.

items.name: Side Table
items.extract: Side table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the side table.

items.name: Sigil of a Phoenix
items.description: Endlessly burning and reconstituting itself. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The sigil of a phoenix is a vestige that unlocks the ring of life upon studying the recipe. It can be purchased from Death's Exchange in the Forgotten Temple under Fellhollow for 800 soul fragments.

items.name: Silver Bar
items.description: A precious and rare metal used to craft enchanting jewellery.
items.extract: Silver bars are primarily obtained by smelting silver ore in a furnace. Silver bars are used for making dark mage armour, the ornate maul handle, and other decorations.

items.name: Silver Bar (decoration)
items.extract: A silver bar is a decoration that requires one silver bar. The silver bar decoration does not need a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Silver Leaf
items.description: A thin sheet of finest silver, can be used for demonstrating your prowess, potion making or even recycling into silver bars.
items.extract: Silver leaf is a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions or create silver bars. To obtain these, players must either collect them from silver (or golden) reward packs or recycle silver bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

items.name: Silver Medal
items.extract: Silver medal is a decorative trophy that players can build once they have completed all available Agility courses at silver or higher records.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: A rare, precious ore. It can be smelted into silver bars at a furnace.
items.extract: Silver ore is a basic Mining material mined from silver ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make silver bars.

items.name: Silver Salvage Pile
items.description: Scraps that can be searched through. Take a look inside.
items.extract: Silver salvage piles are a basic material, nine of them can be smelted in a furnace to create one silver bar.

items.name: Simple Rug
items.extract: A simple rug is a decoration unlocked after crafting rough cloth for the first time.

items.name: Sinister Mechanism

items.name: Skills Necklace
items.description: Provides a small chance to get extra resources when gathering them in the world.
items.extract: The skills necklace is a trinket crafted at a jeweler's bench after unlocking the inspiring insignia vestige. Its special effect includes a 25% chance to double the resources gained whilst fishing, mining, or woodcutting.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: Grants a BONUS when gathering FISHING, MINING and WOODCUTTING resources in the world

items.name: Skullsplitter
items.description: A deadly weapon with a disturbingly accurate name.
items.extract:
Skullsplitter is a power level 3 one-handed weapon that can be crafted using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige remnants of a shattered skull, received randomly as a drop from killing garou berserkers at a 1/50 drop rate. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores. 
Its special effect is +15% critical strike chance, which equates to an average 1.0375x damage increase. However, that assumes that the critical strike chance never goes over 100%, which would be wasted. Currently, the base chance is 10%, the 2/3 melee armour set bonus provides 50% after a block, and the lesser Attack potion provides 25%, equaling 85% before adding the Skullsplitter's 15%.
This weapon has slightly higher base damage than the goblin "Swingslash" but slightly lower than the zombie axe at equivalent power levels. The zombie axe, however, deals both crush and slash damage, making it worse against enemies weak to crush but resistant to slash (including skeletal hoplites, zogres, black knight warriors, black knight guardians, and the black knight titan). For those enemies specifically, this is the best one-handed crush weapon to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * Increased CHANCE of landing CRITICAL HITS with CLUB ATTACKS * Reduced BLOCK

items.extract: A small wall is a constructed object that does not require a foundation and can be built either indoors or outdoors. A small wall is 1/4 the dimensions of a regular wall, measuring 1 metre long and 1 metre high.

items.name: Small Wardstone
items.description: Recharges your armour with a small amount of lifeward.
items.extract: A small wardstone is a wardstone that recharges a player's armour with 30 lifeward in one second, but will inflict 25 Soulscourge on the player. To unlock this wardstone, players must both create and equip any power level 2 chest.

items.name: Smoked Herring
items.description: Nothing beats hunger like a herring. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]
items.extract: Smoked herring is a consumable food item that provides 50 health and 20 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw herring on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in berry drizzle pan-seared.

items.name: Smoked Infernal Eel
items.description: An unusual meal, but a good one. Grants the Warding Fish perk.[sic]
items.extract: Smoked infernal eel is a consumable food item that provides 100 health and 30 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw infernal eel on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in stir-fry.

items.name: Smouldering Draconic Visage
items.description: The image of a fearsome dragon. Used in crafting powerful equipment.
items.extract: The smouldering draconic visage is an award obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest. To gain this item, one must trade Fuzan's head to Icthlarin. This item can be used to craft the dragonfire shield.

items.name: Snapdragon
items.description: A sweet-smelling herb used in restorative potions.
items.extract: Snapdragon is a herb that can be found by harvesting the Snapdragon plant in the Bloodblight Swamp or can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

items.name: Snapdragon Seeds
items.description:
Snapdragon seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Snapdragon seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Snapdragon seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Snapdragon.

items.name: Soda Ash

items.extract: Soda ash is a resource forgeable into molten glass (not present in-game), and is made from swamp weed. Soda ash is presently not in the game.

items.name: Sodden Black Leather
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian cowl. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The sodden black leather is a vestige that unlocks the shadow cowl. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 200 infernal fragments.

items.name: Soft Animal Fur
items.description: It's so fluffy!

items.extract: The spare farmer's supplies is a pack of supplies that includes a plant cure potion and a Tome of Farming, granting 400 Farming experience. This is given to the player after completing Growing Pains, the introductory Farming quest.

items.name: Spectral Book

items.name: Spectral Chinchompa Cape

items.extract: Spectral silver thread is a quest item that is found after giving Edna 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments, as well as the bedraggled spellbook to her during the quest, Mirror, Mirror.

items.name: Spinning Wheel
items.extract:
The spinning wheel is unlocked when players harvest from flax plants and receive flax for the first time. It is used to process fibres and furs into threads that can be used for crafting. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks. It requires a roof above it to function.
There is an advanced version of this spinning wheel that grants a secondary slot for spinning thread.

items.name: Splitbark Body
items.description: Magical armour crafted from fine cloth and hollow bark. it has strange magical properties.
items.extract: Splitbark body is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Splitbark Helm
