items.extract: Splitbark Helm is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.

items.name: Splitbark Legs
items.description: Magical leg armour crafted from wither-corrupted hollow bark.
items.extract: Splitbark legs is a power level 5 magic armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Splitbark Staff
items.description: A Mage's Weapon crafted from wither-rotted hollow bark. It has strange magical properties.
items.extract: Splitbark staff is a power level 5 two-handed staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. Players can unlock this after receiving hollow bark in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Splitbark Wand
items.description: Crafted from enchanted splitbark, balancing resilience with arcane potential.
items.extract: The Splitbark wand is a power level 5 magic weapon. It can be crafted at a mystic forge using 6 hollow bark, 3 sacred oil, 2 fine thread, and 3 vault shard.

items.name: Spooky Bait
items.description: Bait that gives fish the heeby-jeebies, but draws them in anyway. Undead Bass love a jump scare. Increases the catch chance of this fish.
items.extract: Spooky bait is a power level 5 Fishing bait crafted at the crafting table. It increases the chance of catching undead bass. Players can store the bait in a tackle box, which holds up to 48 baits.

items.name: Square Foundation
items.extract:
Square foundations are constructed objects that are not required to have a roof or a stable foundation. Note that the square foundation has eight points of contact: four at the corners and four on the bottom of each vertical beam. Players can only build up to six square foundations, either stacked on top of each other or side by side, without a stable foundation in between (or at the bottom of the stack). The square foundation is 4 metres long on both sides (which includes the frame surrounding the tile).
A square foundation is not recommended for building floors in a two-floor player-built house, as the bottom legs will make it hard for players to move around the house. It may be recommended to use square tiles without legs on the bottom.

items.name: Square Tile
items.extract: Square tile is a constructed item that is not required to have a roof and does not require a stable foundation. A square tile is 4 metres long in both the x and y directions, making the area 16 square metres. Note that this measurement accounts for the frame surrounding the tile.

items.name: Squeaking Sausage
items.description: Tail not included.
items.extract: Squeaking sausage is a consumable food item that provides +0.5 Resist Shocked Buildup, 80 health, and 80 sustenance as well as the perk Grounded, which grants resistance to shock effects for 300 seconds. It is made with dried dwellberries, fried onions, and rat roast in a cooking range.

items.name: Stack of Bowls
items.extract: A stack of bowls is a decoration that is unlocked by learning the PLAN: stack of bowls recipe found in chests across the Fractured Plains.

items.name: Stacked Wooden Crates
items.extract: Stacked wooden crates is a decoration that can be built either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Staff of Light
items.description: A mystical weapon humming with power, wielded by mighty Saradominist Wizards ages past.
items.extract:
The staff of light is a power level 4 masterwork staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by completing the quest Highlighting the Problem. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is a higher rune damage modifier than most other staves at the same power level.
It's only lower than the necromancer's staff by 0.1. At power level 7, this equates to only a 0 - 4 damage difference between the two depending on the rune type, hit of the combo, whether it crits, and whether a magic focus is used. This will only make a difference if that damage hits a breakpoint on certain enemies (i.e. if it takes one less hit with the necromancer's staff to defeat an enemy than with this weapon). The necromancer's staff also has 20% lower durability with only 1050. Although managing durability with Magical Mending is trivial, it could make a difference in, say, the 30 waves of the fight caves.

items.name: Stained Glass Window Wall
items.extract: A stained glass window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and glass panes.

items.name: Stamina Potion
items.description: Consuming a stamina potion will prevent all loss of stamina for a short duration, however you'll need a moment to recover before you have another as such unbridled energy is taxing on the body.
items.extract: Stamina potion grants the perk Stamina Potion, preventing stamina drain from all actions for 20 seconds. Upon using the potion, the player must wait roughly 75 seconds (1 minute and 15 seconds) starting from consumption to use another potion. This, effectively, means players must wait 55 seconds after the potion effect ends to use another dose if players want to multi-dose.

items.name: Standing Book
items.extract: A standing book is a type of literature decoration that is unlocked after crafting leather for the first time.

items.name: Standing Moon Garou Carpet 01
items.extract: Standing Moon Garou carpet 01

items.name: Standing Moon Garou Carpet 02
items.extract: Standing Moon Garou carpet 02

items.name: Standing Torch
items.extract: A standing torch is a constructed object that can be built either indoors or outdoors, and requires a horizontally flat foundation (e.g., another standing torch, a square tile, or on the top end of a thin or thick beam). The standing torch has two points of contact, one at the base and one at the base of the fire. Players can only stack up to five torches on top of each other before the structure becomes too unstable.

items.name: Steak
items.description: A delicious steak. The perfect campfire meal.
items.extract: Steak a consumable food item that provide 20 sustenance and 30 health when eaten. They can be cooked at either a campfire or grill.

items.name: Steak 'N' Eggs
items.description: A marvelous way, to start your day.
items.extract: Steak 'n' eggs is a consumable food item that provides 40 health and 50 sustenance. It is made with fried egg and steak in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Steak 'N' Eggs (decoration)
items.extract: Steak 'n' eggs is a decoration that is unlocked by successfully cooking steak 'n' eggs.

items.name: Steak Sandwich
items.description: A delectable treat made with flank steak, fried onions and grilled mushrooms.
items.extract: Steak sandwich is a consumable food item that provides +0.5 Resist Shocked Buildup, 90 health and 80 sustenance as well as the perks Coagulated, Grounded, and Fungal Fortitude, which reduces Bleed buildup, reduces the amount of Shock damage taken, and reduces Poison buildup by 33% for 600 seconds. It is made with flank steak, fried onions, grilled mushrooms, and bread in a cooking range after finding the recipe in The Cathedral in Dowdun Reach.

items.name: Steamed Beltfish
items.description: A long, tough meal. Don't eat it in one swallow.
items.extract: Steamed beltfish is a consumable food item that provides 100 health and 30 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw beltfish on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in beltfish broth and swabbie pie.

items.name: Steel Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips forged from Steel.
items.extract: Steel arrows are a power level 5 ammunition that are crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Steel Bar
items.description: Made by smelting coal and iron ore together. A primary ingredient for steel weapons, armour and tools.
items.extract: A steel bar is a component of a variety of armour and weapons. Players must use either three iron ores or one iron bar along with three coal (with a fuel pellet) in a blast furnace.

items.name: Steel Barbed Arrow
items.description: Lacerating arrows with barbed tips forged from Steel.
items.extract: Steel barbed arrows are power level 5 ammunition that can be created on the fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Steel Bolts
items.description: Crossbow bolts made from Steel.
items.extract: Steel bolts are a power level 5 ammunition crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Steel Crossbow
items.description: A 1-Handed Crossbow made from Steel.
items.extract: A steel crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can shoot steel, blurite, iron, and bronze bolts. It is crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Steel Crossbow Limbs
items.description: A pair of Steel crossbow limbs. Used in crafting a Steel Crossbow.
items.extract: Steel crossbow limbs are used for crafting steel crossbows. They are created at a blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Steel Dagger
items.description: A fine dagger made from high-quality Steel.
items.extract: The steel dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

items.name: Steel Fire Arrow
items.description: Burning arrows with tips forged from Steel coated in fire oil.
items.extract: Steel fire arrows are power level 5 ammunition crafted on the fletching bench.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the Fire Oil and Fire Arrows Recipes, giving you new ways to burn your enemies to ash!

items.name: Steel Full Helm
items.description: A full helmet forged from Steel for Melee users.
items.extract: Steel full helm is a power level 5 helmet that is crafted with a armour bench.

items.name: Steel Greataxe
items.description: A two handed Battleaxe forged from Steel.
items.extract: The steel greataxe is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

items.name: Steel Greatsword
items.description: A two handed Steel sword made famous by Highland Warriors.
items.extract: The steel greatsword is a power level 5 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a large circular slash that lunges the player forward in the direction they are aiming, useful for hitting large groups simultaneously and changing directions during a combo.

items.name: Steel Logging Axe
items.description: A woodcutter's tool, forged from Steel.
items.extract:
The steel logging axe is a power level 5 logging axe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The steel logging axe is able to cut the same kinds of trees as the previous tiers, along with thorny irit roots. Deals 40 damage when felling applicable trees, and 60 when overhead chopping to split them.
The recipe and ability to craft steel logging axes are unlocked upon obtaining a steel bar for the first time.

items.name: Steel Mace
items.description: A brutal crush weapon forged from high quality Steel.
items.extract: The steel mace is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage and guard breaking quicker than other one-handed special attacks.

items.name: Steel Med Helm
items.description: A dependable helm trusted by countless adventurers.
items.extract: The Steel Med Helm is a power level 5 helmet. It can be crafted at an Armour Bench using 4 Steel Bar, 4 Draconic Leather, 1 Fine Cloth, 1 Sacred Oil, and 2 Vault Shard. The recipe for this item is obtained by purchasing the Deluxe Edition and having a steel bar in the player's inventory for the first time.

items.name: Steel Pickaxe
items.description: A Miner's tool, forged from steel.
items.extract:
A steel pickaxe is a power level 5 pickaxe that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. It can mine the same ores as the previous tiers, along with soul stone, dealing 66 damage to minable ores, and 132 with a critical swing.
The recipe and ability to craft steel pickaxe are unlocked upon obtaining willow logs for the first time.

items.name: Steel Platebody
items.description: A strong set of well-crafted Steel platemail for Melee users.
items.extract: A steel platebody is a power level 5 platebody that is crafted using an armour bench. It has the exact same combat stats and durability as fallen hoplite's chest and white platebody, making them functionally identical.

items.name: Steel Platelegs
items.description: Sturdy and well-made Steel leg armour for Melee users.
items.extract: Steel platelegs are a power level 5 armour that can be crafted at a armour bench.

items.name: Steel Salvage Pile
items.description: .Scraps that can be searched through. It's the steel of the century.
items.extract: Steel salvage piles are a basic material that can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one steel bar.

items.name: Steel Scimitar
items.description: A vicious, curved sword of Eastern origins forged from Steel.
items.extract: The steel scimitar is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage and guard breaking quicker than other special attacks. Despite being a sword-class weapon, the steel scimitar shares the special attack of mace weapons and the attack speed of the abyssal whip, while sporting its own unique attack animations.

items.name: Steel Shield
items.description: A reliable, durable shield crafted from Steel, perfect for taking big hits.
items.extract:
The steel shield  is a power level 5 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench.
The recipe is unlocked after obtaining a steel bar for the first time.

items.name: Steel Spade
items.description:
A robust Spade made from Steel.

Used to clear farming plots.
items.extract: A steel spade is a power level 3 spade that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress by 60% to the next plot clearing stage. Therefore, it will take two digs to progress one stage.

items.name: Steel Sword
items.description: For fighting monsters and swearing oaths.
items.extract: The steel sword is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a forward stab, which can reach quite far forward compared to most melee attacks, making it useful for combo extensions and intercepting an opponent before they can attack.

items.name: Steel Warhammer
items.description: A massive weapon made from Steel. Great for hammering really big nails.
items.extract: The steel sword is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. Its special attack is a slow and heavy slam in front of the player, with a small area-of-effect shockwave that will cause a hard knockdown on most opponents and deal heavy damage.

items.name: Steel Watering Can
items.extract:
The steel watering can is a tool created at the blacksmith's bench. It is used to hydrate farming plots and has a capacity of 300 units.
The can may be filled with either dirty water or clean water, but not both at the same time. When the can is filled, it may not be filled with the opposite type until it is emptied. Players can empty the can at any time and fill it with a different water type. To fill the can, the can must be filled at a water source. Players cannot use the physical items dirty water or clean water to fill the can.
Along with bodies of water, players may fill the can at the rain catcher, well, water barrel, or large water barrel.
Fully hydrating a farming plot requires 50 units of water.

items.name: Stir-Fry
items.description: Made by combining dried giant krill, dried redberry[sic] and smoked infernal eel.
items.extract: Stir-fry is a consumable food item that provides 150 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perks Sea Legs and Sea Life, which makes players immune to the slowing effects of water and restores 3 health every second for 600 seconds. It is made with dried giant krill, dried dwellberries, and smoked infernal eel in a cooking range.

items.name: Stone
items.description: A basic building and crafting material.
items.extract: Stone is a basic Mining material found all over Ashenfall and inside vaults. Stone can be mined or picked up from any regions. It's used in a wide variety of crafting, from building to item making. Receiving stone in the player's inventory for the first time will unlock the creation of the stone range and the kiln.

items.name: Stone Arrow
items.description: Arrows with tips of splintered stone.
items.extract: Stone arrows are power level 1 ammunition crafted at a Crafting Table.

items.name: Stone Block
items.description: Advanced building material.
items.extract: Stone blocks are Construction materials made by putting stones in a stonecutter.

items.name: Stone Club
items.description: A primitive weapon made from stone, perfect for early adventurers.
items.extract: The stone club is a power level 1 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. This weapon is the first weapon a player learns to make at the start of their adventure. Its special attack is a small leap with an overhead slam, dealing moderate damage.

items.name: Stone Dagger
items.description: A rudimentary blade, handy in close combat.
items.extract: The stone dagger is a power level one-handed weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. Its special attack is a small dash forward, followed by an upward slash, and can be useful as a combo extension.

items.name: Stone Inset Window Wall
items.extract: A stone inset window wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks.

items.name: Stone Logging Axe
items.description: A crude but functional axe for chopping trees.
items.extract: The stone logging axe is a power level 1 logging axe that can be crafted at a crafting table. The stone logging axe is only able to cut ash trees. The axe deals 15 damage when felling applicable trees, and 23 when overhead chopping to split them.

items.name: Stone Pickaxe
items.description: A primitive pickaxe capable of mining stone and rune essence.
items.extract: The stone pickaxe is a power level 1 pickaxe that the player can craft at the start of the game, at a crafting table. It can mine stone, rune essence. This pickaxe deals 10 damage to mineable ores, and 20 damage with a critical swing.

items.name: Stone Range
items.extract:
A stone range can be built using 8 ash logs, 12 stone, and 3 animal bones. It is a lower-tier version of the cooking range. To unlock the recipe for the stone range, players must first build and interact with a campfire, or collect an animal bone in their inventory.
It must have a roof above it to function.

items.name: Stonecutter
items.extract: The stonecutter is a buildable processing station where players can input 2 stone pieces to create 1 stone block, which is used to make power level 3 building pieces. The recipe and ability to build a stonecutter are unlocked after obtaining a steel bar in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Stool
items.extract: A stool is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the stool.

items.name: Storage Ledger
items.extract:
A storage ledger is a building where players quickly deposit items into "linked" storage containers. Its function serves to limit the need to manually open every storage container and instead automatically deposit items into the appropriate container.
The storage ledger does not have a Construction level requirement, but it does require level 28 Artisan.

items.name: Stormtouched Cape
items.description: A cloak depicting ancient monsters and a mage's fury.
items.extract: The stormtouched cape is a craftable armour piece.  The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the stormtouched cape pattern, located at the top of the Highlands Castle in the Stormtouched Highlands.

items.name: Strong Sweet Tea
items.extract: Strong sweet tea is a consumable drink item that provides 10 hydration and 20 rest as well as the perk Sugar Rush, which reduces rest drain by 25% for 300 seconds. It is made with ground tea leaves, 3 clean water, and maple syrup in a cooking range.

items.name: Strong Tea
items.extract: Strong tea is a consumable drink item that provides 10 hydration and 20 rest. It is made with ground tea leaves and 3 clean water in a cooking range.

items.name: Studded Leather Body
items.description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather reinforced with iron studs.
items.extract: Studded leather body is a power level 4 armour that can be created at an armour bench.

items.name: Studded Leather Chaps
items.description: Durable armour crafted from hard leather reinforced with iron studs.
items.extract: Studded leather chaps are a power level 4 armour that can be created at an armour bench.

items.name: Studded Leather Cowl
items.description: A durable helmet crafted from hard leather reinforced with iron studs.
items.extract: Studded leather cowl is a power level 4 helmet that can be created at an armour bench.

items.name: Stuffed Catfish
items.description: Made by combining dried giant krill, fried cabbage and a braised catfish.
items.extract: Stuffed catfish is a consumable food item that provides 200 health and 80 sustenance. It is made with dried giant krill, fried cabbage, and braised catfish in a cooking range.

items.name: Stunted Kalphite Wing
items.extract: Stunted kalphite wing is a basic item dropped by kalphite workers that can be processed at a grindstone into shimmerscale powder.

items.name: Subjugation Staff
items.description: A powerful battlestaff, once owned and used by Arcmage Alric.
items.extract:
The subjugation staff is a power level 6 staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the demonic metal rod vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is 15% increased damage against lesser demons and abyssal demons. Despite also being considered demons, hellrats and hellhounds do not take extra damage from this weapon.
This weapon has the same rune damage multiplier as the draconic staff when ascended to the same power level, but it has much higher durability. That being said, with how few enemies there are that take extra damage from this weapon, the same thing applies here as for the draconic staff that the staff of light and necromancer's staff are better choices in most other situations as they will have 0.4 - 0.5 higher rune damage multipliers at each power level, and the increased chance to crit or higher durability aren't enough to offset that.

items.name: Sun Baked Sole
items.description: Even when cooked it still smells a great deal.
items.extract: Sun baked sole is a consumable food item that provides 130 health and 30 sustenance. It is made by cooking raw desert sole on either a campfire or a grill, and is used in swabbie pie.

items.name: Sun Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The sun ring is a power level 4 piece of armour, made by using three vault cores on a smithing forge. However, it is currently not in the game.

items.name: Sun-Bleached Head Wrap
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The sun-bleached head wrap is a vestige that unlocks the desert hood.

items.name: Sun-Bleached Leggings
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The sun-bleached leggings is a vestige that unlocks the desert robe legs.

items.name: Sun-Bleached Vest
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The sun-bleached vest is a vestige that unlocks the desert robes.

items.name: Sundering Spiked Slab
items.description: Splattered with blood. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The sundering spiked slab is a vestige that is dropped by the skeletal hoplite. Players must study it to receive the recipe to create the fallen hoplite's aspis.

items.name: Super Antifire Potion
items.description:
PERK: Antifire

NEGATES and grants RESISTANCE to FIRE effects
items.extract: Super Antifire potion grants the perk Antifire, which removes Burning stacks and grants 33% resistance from Burning buildup for 600 seconds (10 minutes). It is made by using an Antifire potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Antipoison Potion
items.description:
PERK: Antipoison II

NEGATES and grants RESISTENCE to POISON effects
items.extract: Super Antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison II, which negates and grants resistance to Poison for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

items.name: Super Compost Bin
items.extract: A super compost bin is a buildable object unlocked at level 60 Farming. Unlike the regular compost bin, it will only accept a smaller pool of items, which includes willow logs, in order to produce super compost, which can be taken out of the bin with an empty compost bucket.

items.name: Super Focused Agility Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Agility II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Agility potion grants the perk Focused Agility II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made by using a Focused Agility potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Artisan Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Artisan II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan II, which increased the experience gained through the Artisan skill by 30% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

items.name: Super Focused Attack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Attack II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made by using a Focused Attack potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Construction Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Construction II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made by using a Focused Construction potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Cooking Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Cooking II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the COOKING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made by using a Focused Cooking potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Farming Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Farming II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the FARMING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made by using a Focused Farming potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Fishing Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Fishing II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the FISHING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made by using a Focused Fishing potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Mining Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Mining II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the MINING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made by using a Focused Mining potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Runecrafting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Runecrafting II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made by using a Focused Runecrafting potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Focused Woodcutting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Woodcutting II

Grants a 30% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill
items.extract: Super Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting II, which provides a 10-minute (600-second) +30% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made by using a Focused Woodcutting potion in an imbuing barrel.

items.name: Super Lumberjack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Lumberjack II

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 66%
items.extract: Super Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack II, which reduces the stamina cost of woodcutting by 66% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

items.name: Super Quarrymaster Potion
items.description:
PERK: Quarrymaster II

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of MINING by 66%
items.extract: Super Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster II, which reduces the stamina cost of mining by 66% for 10 minutes (600 seconds).

items.name: Suspiciously Light Tattered Boots
items.description: Barely heavier than a feather, but worn away by time's cruel march. Still, perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Suspiciously light tattered boots is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the leggings of lightness.

items.name: Swabbie Pie
items.description: A pie reserved for the less prestigious members of a ship's crew.
items.extract: Swabbie pie is a consumable food item that provide 220 health and 80 sustenance. It is made with sun baked sole, steamed beltfish, bread, and baked potato in a cooking range.

items.name: Swamp Tar
items.description: It's sticky!
items.extract: Swamp tar is obtained by gathering from the ground in the Whispering Swamp, and is used inside a kiln to create adhesive.

items.name: Swamp Thread
items.description: A crafting material made by spinning Swamp Weed.
items.extract: Swamp thread is a basic item created at a spinning wheel using 1 swamp weed.

items.name: Swamp Weed
items.description: A hardy plant found in swamps and caves.
items.extract: Swamp weed can be harvested by the swamp weed plant, which mostly spawns in and around the poisonous waters in the Bloodblight Swamp and inside the Kletterbuja Kara vault. It can be used to create swamp thread.

items.name: Swamp Weed Seeds
items.description:
Swamp weed seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Swamp weed seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Swamp weed seeds can be used to grow swamp weed in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in oak farming plot. Planting swamp weed seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Swamp weed seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Swamp Weed.

items.name: Sweet Veg Ball
items.description: A marvelous amalgamation of sweet and savoury.
items.extract: Sweet veg ball is a consumable food item that provides 70 health 65 sustenance as well as the perk Knowledgable Nourishment, which increases the player's experience gain in all skills by 10% for 300 seconds. It is made with fried cabbage, baked potato, and dried redberries in a stone range or a cooking range. It is learned by unlocking Amateur Culinaromancer at level 16 Cooking, and requires interacting with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Sweet Veg Ball (decoration)
items.extract: A sweet veg ball is a decoration that is unlocked by cooking a sweet veg ball.

items.name: Table
items.extract: Table is a type of furniture that is unlocked after creating ash planks. Players can place decorations on top of the table.

items.name: Tackle Box
items.extract: The tackle box is a storage container that can hold up to 48 fishing baits (can be a mix of any type), as well as rods and nets. It becomes available once players reach level 39 in the Fishing skill.

items.name: Tainted King's Token
items.description: Proof of your victory over the garou king.
items.extract: Tainted king's token is a quest item dropped by the Garou King. It is used on Lougrim's Shrine during the Dog Days quest to turn it into the purified king's token. Players can also choose to destroy the tainted token in their quest item inventory.

items.name: Tall Slit Wall
items.extract: A tall slit wall is a type of wall that is built with stone blocks and black metal scraps.

items.name: Tanner's Kit
items.extract: The tanner's kit is used to upgrade the tannery, and can be unlocked by obtaining a bronze bar in the player's inventory for the first time. Placing the tanner's kit near the tannery allows the player to use the tannery to make hard leather. One tanner's kit is required per tannery, even if the kit is placed between the two tanneries.

items.name: Tannery
items.extract:
A tannery can be built using 2 coarse thread, 4 animal bones and 12 ash logs. It allows for refining animal hides into leather. It processes somewhat slowly, so it is recommended to keep it filled while doing other tasks. Players must collect an animal bone to unlock the tannery.
The tannery can be upgraded by placing a tanner's kit next to it. This allows the creation of products that require two materials, most notably hard leather. There is an upgraded crafting station, the advanced tannery which allows you to create products that require three materials.

items.name: Tastefully Torn Tights
items.description: The ancient remnants of some sort of armour. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: Tastefully torn tights is a power level 5 vestige that can be purchased with 350 soul fragments at Death's Exchange. Players will need to study this to receive the recipe for the ranger tights.

items.name: Tattered Cape
items.description: It provides some warmth... barely.
items.extract: The tattered cape is a purely decorative cape that has no defensive properties, unlike most other capes. The recipe is unlocked after crafting any piece of power level 2 armour for the first time.

items.name: Tattered Time-Lost Cloth
items.description: The tattered pieces of a mysterious object. Perhaps you could learn something from them.
items.extract: The tattered time-lost cloth is a vestige that is dropped by skeletal marauders and rotsworn marauders. Upon studying the vestige, players can create the shadowscale cape.

items.name: Tea Leaves
items.extract: Tea leaves is a basic item bought from merchants for 20 garou chits or found in chests in Umbral Sands . It can be processed into dried tea leaves at the kiln.

items.name: Terrorbird Trophy
items.extract: The Terrorbird Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Textile Kit
items.extract: A textile kit is a decoration that is unlocked after creating padded cloth.

items.name: Thane's Authority
items.description: A hefting greataxe, wielded by the powerful garou thanes.
items.extract:
Thane's authority is a power level 4 two-handed melee weapon created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a brutal bladehead, received randomly as a drop from killing garou thanes and the Garou King, at a 1/20 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is +15% stamina cost, but it only has around +5% base damage compared to the other greataxes at lower power levels and a mere +1% base damage compared to the adamant greataxe at power level 7.
The black greataxe has the same increased stamina cost, but has higher damage ranges at both power level 6 and 7 (146 - 256 vs. 141 - 246 and 176 - 308 vs. 170 - 298).

items.name: The Binding of Ib
items.description: A sealed scroll containing dark secrets.
items.extract: The Binding of Ib is a quest item obtained behind Blightscale. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. The scroll located in the eastern part of Silverthorn Keep, below the cliffs by large bones.

items.name: The Importance of Chaos
items.description: A religious tome discussing the god of rebellion.
items.extract:
The Importance of Chaos is one of the five tomes in What Remains is Written. It is obtained north of the ominous gateway leading to Dowdun Reach. It's lying on a small incline on the south side of a small tower amidst a gateway ruin. It is on the south-western end of the ruin.
The ruin is surrounded by withered scenery and power-level 5 monsters.

items.name: The Pride of the Avernic
items.description: A badly burned book wrapped in leather hide... at least you hope it's leather.
items.extract: The Pride of the Avernic is one of five books needed to collect for What Remains is Written. It is located in the far eastern ruin in Silverthorn Keep next to an archery target on some boxes.

items.name: The Radiant's Heart
items.description: The heart of an unpleasant red dragon, still smouldering. Hedric - The Hunter will want to see this.
items.extract:
The radiant's heart is a quest item obtained during Icthlarin's Little Helper after defeating the red dragon found in the Manafem Plains. Subsequent defeats will award more hearts, but the quest giver will not take them and they cannot be destroyed.
Assuming one defeats the other 4-5 red dragons (the one northeast of the pyramid only spawns at night) each time they respawn, this item can be a useful tally to keep track of your kill count while grinding for the amulet of glory.

items.name: The Wrath of Baba Potterington
items.description: A sinister book of truly nasty curses.
items.extract: The Wrath of Baba Potterington is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. The book is found in the crumbled stone house near a nature grove north of the 'sil' of Silverthorn Keepon the map. There is a chest nearby, slightly to the north.

items.name: Thick Pillar
items.extract: A thick pillar is a beam, used to build stability with walls and other vertical structures.

items.name: Thin Pillar
items.extract: A thin pillar is a beam, used to build stability with walls and other vertical structures.

items.name: Tin Ore
items.description: Mined from tin deposits. It can be smelted at a Furnace.
items.extract: Tin ore is a basic Mining material mined from tin ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Copper to produce bronze bars.

items.name: Titan's Wrath
items.description: This sword is now thrice-owned: by you, the Black Knight Titan and Lord Rasmodel.
items.extract:
Titan’s wrath is a power level 6 greatsword received from the quest Black Knight's Fortress and found in the Black Knight's Fortress reward pack or created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by acquiring the broken Titan's Wrath by defeating the Black Knight Titan. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
This weapon has three special effects: Its special attack is called Baptism of Fire, which deals damage and applies Burning to all enemies (and the player) within a 5 meter radius. Kills with this attack trigger Burning Execution which causes the weapon to become enchanted with fire magic, and further kills refresh the effect. However, this is an Enchanted Weapon, and additional enchantments cannot be cast on this weapon, whether Enchant Weapon: Fire or Enchant Weapon: Air.
This weapon has higher damage ranges than the shadow sword or other greatswords, but its incompatability with Enchant Weapon: Air means it misses out on the extra damage and attack speed from that enchantment. Similarly, Baptism of Fire is certainly cool, but Enchant Weapon: Fire is far easier to proc and maintain, and the forward momentum and spin of most other greatswords special actions will be hard to pass up.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * FLAMES OF RAGE Trigger FIRE EFFECT around you, dealing DAMAGE to all enemies and triggering BURNING on them * BURNING EXECUTION KILLING an enemy with the SPECIAL ATTACK ENCHANTS the sword with FIRE. Killing an enemy REFRESHES the ENCHANTMENT effect * ENCHANTED WEAPON You cannot cast additional ENCHANTMENTS on this weapon

items.name: Toadflax
items.description: A spicy tasting herb used in resistance potions.
items.extract: Toadflax is found by harvesting the Toadflax plants in the Bloodblight Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

items.name: Toadflax Seeds
items.description:
Toadflax seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Ghornfell plots.
items.extract: Toadflax seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Toadflax seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild toadflax (plant).

items.name: TokTz-Ket-Xil
items.description: A jagged shield of obsidian, shaped to deflect and punish in equal measure. Its edges are as dangerous as the blows it stops.
items.extract:
The toktz-ket-xil is a power level 7 shield that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench after studying the unyielding obsidian construct vestige, a 1/20 drop from Tok-Xils. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect increases melee damage after a parry by 15%. This only increases melee damage; it does not increase magic or ranged damage. This effect is more powerful than it seems though as all damage increases like this are multiplicative: With all of them active, damage done can easily triple. For more info, see combat.
This shield has 6 less block than most other shields at the same power level, but no damage is taken or stamina consumed with a parry. By adding this shield to all of the other damage increases, the adamant mace (for example) will deal 50 more damage every parry, with no cooldown. Compare that to the dragonblight shield at power level 7, which will do 6 poison damage per second for 15 seconds, a total of 90 damage, but only once every 20 seconds. Poison damage also does not provide Attack XP.

items.name: Toktz-Mej-Tal
items.description: Forged from volcanic glass, its pointed tip bleeds fire as though the earth itself burns within. The heat never fades.
items.extract:
The toktz-mej-tal is a power level 7 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the elongated obsidian construct vestige, which can be dropped by KotHaar-Hur and KotHaar-Xil in Umbral Sands with a 2/100 drop rate. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is that it has an increased chance of landing critical strikes, although the exact chance is unknown. If it functions similarly to other weapons that have an extra chance to crit, then it would be 15%. However, it also has reduced durability, 300 less than other staves from Ghornfell, Fellhollow, and Umbral Sands, and 600 less than staves from Dowdun Reach.
With a rune damage multiplier of 8.4, it is 0.3 and 0.4 less than the staff of light and the necromancer's staff, respectively, when ascended to power level 7. However, as we have calculated with the draconic staff (which has 15% additional chance to crit), the multipliers would need to increase to 12.x for the increased chance to crit to provide an average increase in overall damage done. And again, although durability is trivial to manage with Magical Mending, the extended duration of the fight caves may warrant a different choice.

items.name: Toktz-Xil-Ak
items.description: A double-pointed sword that is extremely efficient at finding the weak spots in your enemies.
items.extract:
Toktz-xil-ak is a power level 7 melee weapon that can be unlocked by studying the shattered black blade (Umbral Sands) dropped by KotHaar-Kals with a 2/100 drop rate. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is a 2% increased critical strike chance, but a 25% decreased durability when compared to other adamant tier gear. Most other weapons that have an increased chance to crit like the Skullsplitter or dragonbone dagger increase the chance by 15%, so 2% is underwhelming.
That being said, this weapon has the same damage range as the wooden training sword and the black sword, and higher durability than the wooden training sword but lower than the black sword. The black sword therefore wins out when fighting mages, but even the adamant sword with 400 more durability might be considered over this sword for something like the Fight Caves as long as the benefit is only a mere 2% crit chance increase.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: INCREASED chance of landing CRITICAL HITS Reduced DURABILITY

It rewards 500 experience each in Attack, Ranged, and Magic.

items.extract:
The Tome of the Titan is a reward from completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest.
It rewards 750 experience each to Magic, Ranged, and Attack.

items.description: A powerful tome containing ancient techniques of warfare. Grants a large amount of experience in the [[Attack]], [[Magic]] and [[Ranged]] skills.
items.extract: The Tome of Volcano is an item given to the player upon opening the Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack. It gives the player +750 experience in the Attack, Magic, and Ranged skills.

items.description: A book filled with knowledge on how best to chop down trees. Awards a small amount of Woodcutting XP.
items.extract: Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 1 is a skill tome that is one of four rewards given after completing the Restless Ghosts quest and is a reward after the Rune Mysteries quest. It can also be received occasionally from chests. When read, the tome gives 100 Woodcutting experience.

items.description: A book filled with knowledge on how best to chop down trees. Awards a decent amount of Woodcutting XP.
items.extract: Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Woodcutting experience.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A trusty light source.
items.extract:
Torch is a tool item that can be wielded in the off-hand to help light up areas around the player, making it easier to see. A player can still block while wielding it, but it will only account for the blocking of the weapon in the player's main hand, and so the torch may be positioned awkwardly. Whilst wielding the torch, the durability will dwindle by 1pt/second, which will take 1800 seconds (30 minutes) before it fully degrades. When creating a new character, a torch will be spawned within the inventory.
The spell Fire Spirit largely obsoletes the use of a torch, as it frees up the offhand for a shield or allows for the use of two-handed weaponry, like bows and staves. The spell also does not use up any inventory space or encumbrance.

items.name: Torn Tapestry
items.description: A piece of cloth torn from one of Dowdun Reach's tapestries.
items.extract: The torn tapestry is a vestige that is found in a buried chest in Dowdun Reach. Upon studying the vestige, players can create the Dowdun Reach cape.

items.name: Training Dummy
items.extract: A training dummy is a  constructed object, unlockable at level 37 Attack, that acts as a non-combative NPC with 400 hitpoints. Upon losing all its hitpoints, the training dummy will be knocked down for a few seconds, pop up again, and restart at full health. Note that bows and staves will lose regular durability as if attacking a monster. However, melee weapons do not lose durability, even if using the melee weapon's special attack.

items.name: Triangular Foundation
items.extract: Triangular foundations are a constructed object where players can place an equilateral triangle-shaped foundation on the ground.

items.name: Triangular Tile
items.extract: Triangular tiles are constructed objects where players can place an equilateral triangle-shaped foundation on the ground.

items.name: Twilight Lily
items.description: A  strange, glowing lily, with magical properties.
items.extract: A twilight lily is an quest item you collect during the Biohazard quest. It is located under Dowdun Reach, in front of the anima tree within The Lake.

items.name: Twtiching Antenna
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: The Twtiching Antenna is a vestige that unlocks the kalphite carapace helmet.

items.name: TzHaar-Ket-Om
items.description: A massive warhammer of obsidian hue. Each swing carries the weight of something ancient.
items.extract:
TzHaar-ket-om is a power level 7 two-handed warhammer that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bludgeoning obsidian construct, which can be dropped by KotHaar-Ket in Umbral Sands. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is that it builds up a Bleed effect on targets, dealing 56 damage after getting 5 hits in a short time, but it also has 25% reduced durability. There is also currently a known bug where it displays a combo of 21 and one where you cannot hit more than once on servers where you are not the host.
This weapon has the same damage range as an adamant warhammer, but its so much lower than the granite maul at power level 7 (196 - 283) even taking the Bleed damage into consideration that the granite maul is the clear choice of which two-handed warhammer to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * HITS cause BLEED build up on targets * Reduced DURABILITY

items.name: Ultra Compost
items.description: Fertilizing a plot with this is beneficial to its yield. Like, suspiciously beneficial. Wow!
items.extract: Ultra compost is an item made at the ultra compost bin at a rate of 10 units per item composted, which can be gathered and used via the compost bucket. Applying ultra compost to a patch provides 50 Farming experience, decreases the disease chance to 12.5%, and multiplies the yield by 2.5.

items.name: Ultra Compost Bin
items.extract: An ultra compost bin is a buildable object unlocked at level 69 Farming.

items.name: Ulv's Longbow
items.description: Once the bow of a silent hunter. Deals additional damage to unaware targets.
items.extract:
Ulv's longbow is a power level 5 longbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Mirror, Mirror quest. It can then be crafted from a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is 15% increased damage against unsuspecting targets, i.e. ones not yet in combat. Interestingly, this is the same damage bonus as trick shot, meaning that this weapon can deal the same damage on the first hit on a target as follow up trick shots on the same target.
Once the player can no longer continue aiming (to dodge an attack, for example), the trick shot is lost and another arrow will have to be fully drawn and fired to get it back. This makes the hunter stagbow's 10% faster draw speed more appealing, as it can loose and get back to trick shots faster.

items.name: Umbral Kebab
items.description: A garou delicacy, ideal for those night-time munchies.
items.extract: Umbral kebab is a consumable food item that provide 80 health and 90 sustenance, as well as the perks Frosted Flavours and Soul Food, which reduces Scorch buildup and restores 8 health every 5 seconds for 300 seconds. It is made with seared cactus steak, bread, roast pumpkin, and steak in a cooking range.

items.name: Umbral Sands Arena Tapestry
items.extract: Umbral Sands Arena Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Umbral Sands Cape
items.description: A light desert cape designed to shield against sun and sand. Offers comfort during long journeys across the dunes.
items.extract: Umbral Sands cape is a armour piece located in Umbral Sands. Players can find the recipe for this cape in the hills, north-east of the pyramid in the Dunes of Uzzer.

items.name: Umbral Sands Landscape Tapestry
items.extract: Umbral Sands Landscape Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Umbral Sands Pit Tapestry
items.extract: Umbral Sands Pit Tapestry is a decoration.
