items.extract: Umbral Sands Ruins Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Umbral Sands Tower Tapestry
items.extract: Umbral Sands Tower Tapestry is a decoration.

items.name: Umbral Vulture Perch
items.extract: Umbral Vulture Perch is a decoration.

items.name: Undead Bone
items.description: Dropped from the restless dead. Use as a crafting material, or process at a grindstone.
items.extract: Undead bones are drops from enemies in Fellhollow.

items.name: Undead Chicken
items.description: Manktongue asked for an Undead Chicken.
items.extract: Undead chickens  is a quest item required for Animal Magnetism. It was meant to be released with Fellhollow as part of the 0.10 update, but instead, one was released following the 0.11.1 update, which ends up being an ingredient for the Animal Magnetism to create the Ava's accumulator.

items.name: Undead Delight
items.description: Made by combining fried grilled undead bass and grilled tomato. Grants the Sea Life perk.
items.extract: Undead delight is a consumable food item that provides 180 health and 70 sustenance as well as the perk Sea Life, which restores 3 health every second for 1,200 seconds. It is made with grilled undead bass and grilled tomatoes in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Undead Draconic Visage
items.description: Dragon Visage
items.extract: The undead draconic visage is an award obtained from Death in exchange for Imaru's head, which is obtained by killing Imaru during or after the quest Withering Heights. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragoncurse shield.

items.name: Undead Meat
items.description: Obtained from undead beasts. Can be cooked for ... interesting results.
items.extract: Undead meat is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into cauterised undead steak starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt undead steak at level 50. It is dropped by zombie cows, zombie rats, and rotridden rats in Fellhollow.

items.name: Undead Ranger's Bow
items.description: This bow still fires with undeadly precision.
items.extract:
The undead ranger's bow is a power level 5 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned from a dragonkin effigy in Skekven Kara, the dragonkin vault in eastern Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is listed as increased damage but reduced durability. The reduced durability works as this weapon has 1,050 compared to the willow shortbow's 1300, however it has the same damage, both listed and actual.
It fires faster but deals the same damage as the crystal bow, which also has shattershot. However, the wild scout's shortbow has 10% faster draw speed with only 1-5% lower damage, increasing with higher power levels, making it the ideal shortbow to ascend.

items.name: Undead Spade
items.description:
A strangely spooky spade.

Used to clear farming plots.
items.extract: The undead spade is a power level 5 spade unlocked by studying the rotten farming tool vestige and craftable at a blacksmith's bench. It shares the same stats as a steel spade, and consumes 10 stamina with every digging attempt.

items.name: Unholy Symbol
items.description: A necklace that proudly displays the Zamorak symbol. Don't wear it to church.
items.extract:
The unholy symbol is an amulet that can be crafted at a jeweler's bench. It provides a 15% increase in damage for all combat styles, but reduces health by 15%.
The vestige for the unholy symbol can be unlocked via the quest Wanted! that is given by Vannaka in Dowdun Reach.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: Increases DAMAGE but reduces HEALTH while worn

items.name: Unholy Water
items.description: Water blessed by the priests of Zamorak.
items.extract: Unholy water is a quest item players gather during the Biohazard quest. Within The Cathedral's yard, look west of the Shard of the Dreaming stone, there is a statue with water flowing from its hands. You can only interact with it while doing the quest and only once.

items.name: Unusual Trout
items.description: This trout has seen things. You almost feel apologetic for catching it.
items.extract: Unusual Trout is a raw ingredient that can be captured by grabbing it from the pool of fish for OffalFoot in The Lake far beneath The Courtyard. The area in which to grab it is accessed through the catacombs beneath the The Cathedral. Give it to OffalFoot to receive a Shard of the Dreaming Stone in return.

items.name: Unyielding Obsidian Construct
items.description: Perhaps you could learn from it[sic]
items.extract: Unyielding obsidian construct is a vestige that is dropped by the Tok-Xil and unlocks the toktz-ket-xil shield.

items.name: Vault Core
items.description: A dragonkin energy source, found only within dragonkin vaults.
items.extract: A vault core can be found on pedestals in dragonkin vaults. Their primary use is to make lodestones, which serve as a teleport location that can be travelled to from any other lodestone the player has placed on the map. They are also components of several masterworks, such as the abyssal whip and dragonblight shield. Note that these respawn in their plinths every three in-game days, so their quantity is not limited.

items.name: Vault Core (Decoration)
items.extract: A vault core is a decoration that is unlocked after picking up a Vault Core.

items.name: Vault Shard
items.description: Stone imbued with remnants of dragonkin magic. Found only in dragonkin vaults.
items.extract: Vault shards are items used in crafting several items and can be obtained from vault guardians found in dragonkin vaults.

items.name: Vault Shard (Decoration)
items.extract: A Vault Shard is a decoration that is unlocked after picking up a Vault Shard.

items.name: Vegan Fryup
items.description: All of the calories, none of the guilt.
items.extract: Vegan fryup is a consumable food item that provides 70 health and 70 sustenance. It is made with baked potato, fried cabbage, and grilled tomatoes in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Vegan Fryup (decoration)
items.extract: A vegan fryup is a decoration that is unlocked after successfully cooking a vegan fryup.

items.name: Vegetable Soup
items.description: A tasty soup, good for the soul.
items.extract: Vegetable soup is a consumable food item that provides 40 health and 50 sustenance. It is made with fried cabbage and baked potato in a stone range or a cooking range, however a player must interact with a stone range first to learn the recipe.

items.name: Velgar's Head
items.description: Proof of your triumph over the dragon general. It's dripping blood everywhere, you should probably get rid of it...
items.extract: Velgar's head is a unique item obtained by killing Velgar at the end of Dragon Slayer. The player can hand the head over to the Wise Old Man to receive a noxious draconic visage, anti-dragon shield, and Tome of the Dragon Slayer, along with the recipe to make the dragonblight shield.

items.name: Vertical Thick Beam
items.extract: Vertical thick beams are constructed objects that do not require a foundation and do not need to be built indoors or outdoors. The thin beam is 4 metres long by approximately 0.62 metres in diameter, since it would take 6.5 thin beams to cover the whole length of a regular 4m wall. Building a beam in between walls and floors maintains the structure of nearby walls and floors in case a wall gets damaged from a goblin raid.

items.name: Vertical Thin Beam
items.extract: Vertical thin beams are constructed objects that do not require a foundation and do not need to be built indoors or outdoors. The thin beam is 4 metres long by 0.32 metres in diameter, since it would take 12.5 thin beams to cover the whole length of a regular 4m wall. Building a beam in between walls and floors maintains the structure of nearby walls and floors in case a wall gets damaged from a goblin raid.

items.name: Vial
items.description: An empty glass vial.
items.extract: A vial is a resource that is currently not released in the game. In addition, there is no current recipe to build an empty vial.

items.name: Vial Shelf
items.extract: A vial shelf is a constructed shelf that is unlocked by learning its recipe, PLAN: vial shelf. Building it requires 4 clay decorations and one ash log, creating a shelf with four different coloured vials.

items.name: Victoria Sponge Cake
items.description: A delicious sponge cake, thankfully without the goblin version of frosting.
items.extract: Victoria sponge cake is a consumable food item that provides 85 sustenance and 50 health, as well as the perk Sugar Rush, which reduces rest drain by 25% for 300 seconds. It is made with 2 dried redberries, 2 eggs, 2 redberry infusions, and 4 wheat in a stone range or a cooking range after receiving the recipe from the Cook's Assistant quest.

items.name: Vile Ashes
items.description: Remains of a demonic creature. A crafting material used to make demonic oil.
items.extract: Vile ashes are a processed material required for making demonic oil and giant krill bait.

items.name: Vine Root
items.description: A fibrous root with unique properties.
items.extract: A vine root is an item that cannot be obtained in the game.

items.name: Vis Cloth
items.description: Spun on a loom from vis fibres and draconic vis wax. Now it's time to make some mage armour.
items.extract: Vis Cloth is a processed material created at a Loom and is primarily used for power level 8 armour.

items.name: Vis Fibres
items.description: Spun on an advanced spinning wheel. Threads that can be spun into vis cloth on a loom.
items.extract: Vis Fibres is a processed material created at an Advanced Spinning Wheel from Harmonised Compound and Ground Rune Essence

items.name: Wall
items.extract: A wall is a structure that is used to provide adequate shelter for the player and for the respawn point (either a bed roll or a bed). This requires at least one point of contact to be connected to a surface. Building a wall does not require a foundation and does not require a roof upon construction. Note that the wall is 4 metres long in both the horizontal and vertical directions.

items.name: Wall With Door Frame
items.extract: Wall with door frame is a constructed item that is not required to have a roof and does not require a stable foundation. This wall has four points of contact and requires only one to be connected. This wall can fit only cabin and cottage doors.

items.name: Wall With Double Door Frame
items.extract: Wall with double door frame is a constructed item where players can fit two doors that can be either power level 1 or power level 2. Players can mix and match between the two tiers, where one side can be power level 1 and the other side be power level 2.

items.name: Wall With Double Window Frame
items.extract: Wall with double window frame is a constructed item where players can fit two windows that can be either Cabin or Cottage. Players can mix and match between the two tiers, where one side can be Cabin and the other Cottage.

items.name: Wall With Window Frame
items.extract: Wall with window frame is a constructed object where players can fit windows.

items.name: Wall-mounted Torch
items.extract: A wall-mounted torch is a constructed object that does not require a roof to be built, but requires a foundation that includes either a wall, thick/thin beam, or any vertically built object. Players can choose to build either the cabin-like or the baroque-like version with the same requirements.

items.name: Warped Feathers
items.description: Beautiful feather used to power the Gyrhawk Amulet, which grants additional experience for exploration.
items.extract: Warped feathers is a basic Agility material that can be found from Agility courses reward packs. Warped feathers can create the gyrhawk amulet along with coarse thread. However, players will need more feathers to charge the amulet to gain Agility experience whilst running, jumping, and dodging.

items.name: Water Barrel
items.extract: The water barrel is a buildable object unlocked at level 24 Farming, which can hold either clean or dirty water (only from watering cans and not the drinks), but players cannot mix the two types of water inside the barrel.

items.name: Water Rune
items.description:
A symbol of flowing waters, essential for water-based magic and other spells.

Runes are retained if you happen to die.
items.extract:
Water runes are runes imbued with water, found in certain mob drop packs like goblin packs and garou packs. They can be crafted at a rune altar at level 11 (or higher) Runecrafting or created by siphoning water anima vents.
With the release of Umbral Sands, water runes can be used in combat if the player has unlocked the Water Magic skill perk.

items.name: Water Rune (Decoration)
items.extract: Water rune is a decoration that is unlocked once the player has received a water rune in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Watermelon
items.description: A juicy watermelon.
items.extract: Watermelons are a consumable food item that provides 15 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 4 resource, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into watermelon jerky starting at Cooking level 41, and not be burnt into burnt watermelon at level 50. They can also be used to make a scarecrow. They can be gathered from Watermelon (Farming) grown from watermelon seeds. Watermelons cannot be used as an item in a compost bin, however can be used as an item in a super compost bin.

items.name: Watermelon Jerky
items.description: A juicy watermelon, sans juice.
items.extract: Watermelon jerky is a power level 4 item that is made by cooking watermelon on a campfire.

items.name: Watermelon Seeds
items.description:
Watermelon seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best Planted in Fellhollow plots.
items.extract: Watermelon seeds are a type of Fellhollow seed, used in the Farming skill. Watermelon seeds can be used to grow watermelon plants in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in a willow farming plot. Planting watermelon seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming.

items.name: Weak Antipoison Potion
items.description:
PERK: Antipoison

Negates and grants RESISTANCE to POISON effects
items.extract: Weak Antipoison potion grants the perk Antipoison, which removes Poison stacks and grants 33% resistance from Poison buildup for 5-minutes (300 seconds). It is made with marrentil, bittercap mushroom, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Agility Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Agility

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the Agility Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Agility potions grant the perk Focused Agility, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Agility skill. It is made with marrentill, bronze leaf, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Artisan Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Artisan

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ARTISAN Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Artisan potion grants the perk Focused Artisan, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Artisan skill. It is made with marrentil, redberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Attack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Attack

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the ATTACK Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Attack potion grants the perk Focused Attack, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Attack skill. It is made with marrentil, small animal fang, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Construction Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Construction

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the CONSTRUCTION Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Construction potion grants the perk Focused Construction, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Construction skill. It is made with marrentil, flax, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Cooking Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Cooking

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the COOKING Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Cooking potion grants the perk Focused Cooking, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Cooking skill. It is made with marrentil, cabbage, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Farming Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Farming

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the FARMING Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Farming potion grants the perk Focused Farming, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Farming skill. It is made with marrentil, weeds, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Fishing Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Fishing

Grants a boost to your Fishing XP for a short period of time.
items.extract: Weak Focused Fishing potion grants the perk Focused Fishing, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Fishing skill. It is made with marrentil, sauteed shrimp, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Mining Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Mining

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the MINING Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Mining potion grants the perk Focused Mining, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Mining skill. It is made with marrentil, animal bone, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Runecrafting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Runecrafting

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the RUNECRAFTING Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Runecrafting potion grants the perk Focused Runecrafting, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Runecrafting skill. It is made with marrentil, coarse animal fur, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Focused Woodcutting Potion
items.description:
PERK: Focused Woodcutting

Grants a 15% XP BOOST for the WOODCUTTING Skill
items.extract: Weak Focused Woodcutting potion grants the perk Focused Woodcutting, which provides a 5-minute (300-second) +15% XP boost for the Woodcutting skill. It is made with marrentil, feathers, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Healing Potion
items.description: A potion that restores a small amount of health.
items.extract: Weak healing potion is a potion that instantly heals 40 health points upon consumption. It is made with harralander, redberries, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Lumberjack Potion
items.description:
PERK: Lumberjack

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of WOODCUTTING by 33%
items.extract: Weak Lumberjack potion grants the perk Lumberjack, which reduces the stamina cost of Woodcutting by 33% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with harralander, antler, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weak Quarrymaster Potion
items.description:
PERK: Quarrymaster

REDUCES the STAMINA cost of Mining by 33%
items.extract: Weak Quarrymaster potion grants the perk Quarrymaster, which reduces the stamina cost of Mining by 33% for 5 minutes (300 seconds). It is made with harralander, clay, and clay vessel in a brewing cauldron.

items.name: Weapon Barbs
items.description:
Pointy!

Used to craft Barbed Arrows or to coat your equipped melee weapon with barbs that cause Bleed buildup for a short duration.
items.extract: Weapon barbs are an item unlocked at level 22 Ranged, allowing players to either craft barbed arrows or imbue their held melee weapon (except for basic tools such as axes or pickaxes) with the Bleed debuff for two minutes.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Barbs, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Bleed or to craft Barbed Arrows.

items.name: Weapon Poison
items.description:
A vial of Weapon Poison.

Used in crafting Poison Arrows or to coat your equipped Melee Weapon with Poison for a short time.
items.extract: Weapon poison is a potion that can be created at level 15 Ranged. This allows the player to poison their weapon (excluding tools such as pickaxes or logging axes), making their melee weapon or ranged ammunition poisonous for two minutes.

unlockedBy.description: Unlocks the recipe for Weapon Poison, which can be used to imbue melee weapons with Poison or to craft Poisonous Arrows.

items.name: Weapon Rack
items.extract: The weapon rack is an unlockable type of furniture at level 27 Attack, and can display up to 6 weapons or tools. This includes axes, pickaxes, melee weapons, ranged weapons, magic weapons, and masterwork weapons.

items.name: Weeds
items.description: A bunch of weeds.
items.extract: Weeds are a Farming item, dug from Farming patches when nothing is growing on them. Players will need a spade to harvest this item, and can place it into a compost bin to convert to compost.

items.name: Weighted Training Band
items.description: You can feel it pulling away from you. Perhaps you could learn from it.
items.extract: The weighted training band is a consumable item that unlocks creation of the amulet of strength.

items.name: Well
items.extract: A well is a buildable object unlocked at level 32 Farming. Players can store clean water and transfer it over to a water barrel or an empty watering can. This well must be built outdoors and on top of land for it to be placed. The well replenishes to its full capacity at midnight, and players cannot destroy the well whilst there is water stored inside.

items.name: Wheat
items.description: A sheaf of wheat.
items.extract: Wheat is a power level 2 raw ingredient. It can be harvested from wheat (farming) after it has fully grown. Wheat seeds can be used in any farming plot to grow the source plant, but planting the Wheat seeds in a Ash Farming Plot will decrease the chance of disease.

items.name: Wheat Seeds
items.description:
Some Wheat Seeds. Equip and use them to scatter these into a farming plot and start growing!

Best planted in Brynmoor plots.
items.extract: Wheat seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Wheat seeds can be used to grow wheat in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot. Planting wheat seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Wheat seeds can be obtained from goblin packs, and the Wise Old Man will give three wheat seeds to the player when starting the Growing Pains side-quest.

items.name: Whetstone
items.description: Use this to hone your equipped melee weapon.
items.extract: A whetstone can be used to give a 15% damage multiplier on a player's equipped melee weapon for 10 minutes, and can be used in conjunction with damage-boosting spells, such as Enchant Weapon: Fire. Its recipe is unlocked after reaching level 40 in the Attack skill.

items.name: Whispering Cape
items.description: A cloak that makes you shiver, even as it protects against the cold.
items.extract: The whispering cape is a craftable armour piece.  The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Whispering Cape Pattern, found in a chest near the waterfall in the Whispering Swamp.

items.name: Whispering Elbow Pad
items.description: The remnants of a Zamorakian mage robe. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The whispering elbow pad is a vestige that unlocks the Zamorak robes. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 400 infernal fragments.

items.name: White Adventurer's Cape
items.description: A simple, yet stylish accessory.
items.extract: The white adventurer's cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft.

items.name: White Desert Cape
items.description: A White cape, stitched in an ancient desert style. Its patterns reflect a long-standing mastery of life beneath the scorching sun.
items.extract: The white desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the white memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

items.name: White Full Helm
items.description: A helmet worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights. It is pure white
items.extract:
White full helm is a power level 5 melee armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the corroded white visor vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: White Memory of Menaphos
items.description: Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The white memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the white desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

items.name: White Platebody
items.description: White Platebody worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights.
items.extract:
White platebody is a power level 5 melee armour that can be created at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the Dented White Pauldron vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: White Platelegs
items.description: White Platelegs worn by a member of the Holy Order of White Knights.
items.extract:
White platelegs is a power level 5 melee armour that can be created at an armour bench.
The recipe is unlocked by purchasing and studying the Crushed White Cuisse vestige from the Death's Exchange shop.

items.name: Wild Anima
items.description: Raw magical essence, extremely useful in magical recipes and equipment. Refined by herblore masters from anima-infused bark.
items.extract: Wild anima can be made with anima-infused bark in a kiln.

items.name: Wild Anima (Decoration)
items.extract: Wild anima is a constructed object decoration that is unlocked once the player has received wild anima in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Wild Archer Body
items.description: Durable armour worn by a Wild Knight archer.
items.extract:
Wild archer body is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Wild Archer Chaps
items.description: Durable leg armour worn by a Wild Knight archer.
items.extract:
Wild archer chaps is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Wild Archer Cowl
items.description: A helmet worn by a Wild Knight archer.
items.extract:
Wild archer cowl is a power level 4 ranged armour that can be crafted at an armour bench.
The recipe can be obtained from Kletterbuja Kara, a dragonkin vault.

items.name: Wild Pie
items.description: A triumph of man over nature.
items.extract: Wild pie is a consumable food item that provides 90 health, 110 sustenance as well as the perks Knowledgable Nourishment and Grounded, which increases experience gain in all skills by 10%, and reduces the amount of shock damage taken for 600 seconds. It is made with fried onions, baked potato, dried dwellberries, and bread in a cooking range and learned by unlocking Adept Culinaromancer at level 36 Cooking.

items.name: Wild Scout's Shortbow
items.description: A bow used by a Wild Knight scout. Maintaining balance, one arrow at a time.
items.extract:
The wild scout's shortbow is a power level 3 shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned from a dragonkin effigy in Takla Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fractured Plains. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is 10% increased draw speed, making this weapon draw faster than other shortbows. This does not affect quick actions.
The crystal bow and the undead ranger's bow have slightly higher base damage at all power levels, but they are supposed to have much higher base damage than they do (the undead ranger's bow's special effect is supposed to be increased damage after all), but they fire slower, the crystal bow especially so. They also have the same durability, which means that as long as the crystal bow's shattershot is not being used, then this weapon is the ideal shortbow to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: * Increased DRAW SPEED with RANGED ATTACKS * Reduced DAMAGE

items.name: Willow Farming Plot
items.extract:
The willow farming plot can be used to grow plants with seeds through the Farming skill. To obtain the recipe, you must interact with the crafting table after obtaining willow logs.
It is the best farming plot to plant the following: 

avantoe seeds
cadavaberry seeds
corpse cotton seeds
irit seeds
pumpkin seeds
watermelon seeds

items.name: Willow Logs
items.description: A highly efficient fuel. Required for smelting more advanced metals.
items.extract: Willow logs are obtained by chopping down willow trees. An iron logging axe (or better) is required to chop down willow trees.

items.name: Willow Longbow
items.description: An agile Longbow crafted from Willow.
items.extract: The willow longbow is a power level 5 longbow that can be crafted from a fletching bench.

items.name: Willow Rod
items.description: A professional-looking fishing rod, effective in Fellhollow.
items.extract: The willow rod is a power level 5 Fishing tool crafted at the blacksmith's bench.

items.name: Willow Shortbow
items.description: An agile Shortbow crafted from Willow.
items.extract: The willow shortbow is a power level 5 Shortbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench.

items.name: Willow Tree Seed
items.description:
Willow Tree Seeds.
< br />Plant this directly into the ground to grow your own Tree!
items.extract:
A willow tree seed is a type of seed, used with the Farming skill to grow a willow tree. 
Willow tree seeds have a power level of 1.

items.name: Window
items.extract: Windows are constructed objects which can only be placed in a wall with window frame, a wall with double window frame, or a half wall with window frame.

items.name: Window Box
items.extract: A window box is a type of decoration that is unlocked by receiving ash planks in the player's inventory for the first time. The window box can hold small decorations inside and can be placed either indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Winged Kalphite Queen Trophy
items.extract: The Winged Kalphite Queen Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Wintumber Tree
items.extract: The Wintumber tree is a seasonal decoration that can be either built indoors or outdoors.

items.name: Wither Water
items.description: A source of hydration, tainted by the realm of Imaru.
items.extract: Wither water is a drink that can be collected from ponds or any accessible body of water affected by wither in Fellhollow. Drinking it increases hydration by 10, but will increase Wither status by 15.

items.name: Withered Heart
items.description: Dropped from withered enemies. Used as a crafting ingredient.
items.extract: Withered heart is a drop from rotsworn creatures in Fellhollow, and can be converted to three ectoplasms in a kiln.

items.name: Withering Heights Reward Pack
items.description: A cloth shoulder bag.
items.extract: A Withering Heights reward pack is a reward from completing the Withering Heights quest. Players who open the pack will receive one dragoncurse shield, one undead draconic visage, and one Tome of the Undying.

items.name: Wizard Hat
items.description: A stylish hat, popular with spellcasters.
items.extract: Wizard hat is a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. Unlocked via acquiring rough cloth.

items.name: Wizard Robe Legs
items.description: Lightweight magical armour.
items.extract: Wizard robe legs are a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. Unlocked via acquiring rough cloth.

items.name: Wizard Robes
items.description: Lightweight magical armour.
items.extract: Wizard robes are a power level 3 magic armour that can be crafted at an armour bench. Unlocked via acquiring rough cloth.

items.name: Wizard's Kneecap
items.description: The remnants of Zamorakian mage robe legs. Perhaps you could learn something from it.
items.extract: The wizard's kneecap is a vestige that unlocks the Zamorak robe legs. It is obtained through Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments.

items.name: Wolf Trophy
items.extract: The Wolf Trophy is a decoration.

items.name: Wolfbane Dagger
items.description: A silver dagger that brings fear to all those who howl in the night.
items.extract:
The wolfbane dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is acquired from a dragonkin effigy found in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is 25% increased damage against wolves, which includes wolves, dire wolves, dragonwolves, ghost wolves and hellhounds.
Although keris has 2 higher max hit at power level 7, this dagger when ascended has the same stats as the dragonbone dagger, and so when not attacking either kalphites or wolves, the dragonbone dagger is the ideal one-handed stabbing weapon to ascend.

items.name: Woodcutting Cape
items.description: Congratulations! Reaching level 99 in Woodcutting is an astonishing feat. Wear this cape with pride.
items.extract:
The Woodcutting cape is a Cape of Accomplishment able to be crafted and worn at level 99 Woodcutting. It can be crafted at the mystic forge. 
Trimmed version of the cape can be crafted the same way if you have more than one skill at 99.

items.name: Wooden Arrow
items.description: A very basic arrow.
items.extract: Wooden arrows were proposed to be power level 1 ammunition, crafted at a crafting table. According to the cache, the recipe for making wooden arrows is unlocked after receiving ash logs for the first time. However, the wooden arrows are not in the game; they were just used as an old spell prototype.

items.name: Wooden Barrel
items.extract: A wooden barrel is a decorative item unlocked by learning the PLAN: wooden barrel recipe. The open wooden barrel does not need a foundation and can be placed either indoors or outdoors. Players can stack up to three barrels on top of each other before the stack becomes unstable.

items.name: Wooden Bin
items.extract: A wooden bin is a decoration that is unlocked after receiving ash logs in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Wooden Bin Pile
items.extract: A wooden bin pile is a decoration that is unlocked after receiving ash logs in their inventory for the first time.

items.name: Wooden Club
items.description: A basic melee weapon. Handy in a pinch.
items.extract: The wooden club was a power level 1 one-handed mace that is currently not in the game.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.description: Basic protection for those seeking to block and parry more efficiently.
items.extract: The wooden shield is a power level 1 shield that can be crafted at a crafting table.

items.name: Wooden Spade
items.description:
A rudimentary spade made from Ash wood.

Used to clear farming plots.
items.extract: A wooden spade is a power level 1 spade that can be crafted at a crafting table. When used to dig a farming plot, players will use 10 stamina and progress by 20% to the next plot clearing stage. Therefore, it will take five digs to progress one stage.

items.name: Wooden Training Sword
items.description: Causes damage to their self esteem more than anything really.
items.extract:
The wooden training sword is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the an educational blade, found in a chest atop the eastern roof of the church in Temple Woods. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Unlike many other ascendable vestige and masterwork weapons and armour, this weapon does not have a special effect.
This means that when compared to other swords like the black sword or toktz-xil-ak, they will often be the better choices to ascend.

items.name: Wooden Watering Can
items.extract:
The wooden watering can is a tool created at the crafting table. It is used to hydrate farming plots and has a capacity of 200 water and has a water rate of 10 per action. The can may be filled with either dirty water or clean water, but not both at the same time. When the can is filled, it may not be filled with the opposite type until it is emptied. Players can empty the can at any time and refill it with a different water type.
To fill the can, the can must be filled at a water source. Players cannot use the physical items dirty water or clean water to fill the can.
Along with bodies of water, players may fill the can at the rain catcher, well, water barrel, or large water barrel.

items.name: Woodsman Ring
items.description: No effect
items.extract: The woodsman ring is an unobtainable jewellery slot item found in the game files. Currently, it cannot be obtained legitimately. It shares its only effect of adding 400 carry capacity with every other early access ring.

items.name: Wool Cloth
items.description: A strong and lightweight crafting material.
items.extract: Wool cloth is created in a loom using three wool thread.

items.name: Wool Cloth Bin

items.name: Zamorak Staff
items.description: Standard issue for any mage in Dowdun Reach.
items.extract:
The zamorak staff is a power level 6 staff that can be crafted with a mystic forge. This staff and its recipe are unlocked after completing What's Theirs is Mine!, the nodestone quest in Dowdun Reach. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect, Burning Ambition, increases burning damage caused by fire magic by 33%. At power level 6, that's an increase from 15 to 20 per tick, and at power level 7 an increase from 17 to 23 per tick. Burning damage ticks once every second for 6 seconds. This weapon's special action, Flames of Zamorak, uses 18 stamina and charges up an attack that then slams the staff down to cause a significant area of effect of damage that also instantly causes burning on enemies. This attack deals 18 base rune damage, or 123 damage (plus burning) at power level 6 with a rune damage modifier of 6.8 and 150 damage (plus burning) at power level 7 with a rune damage modifier of 8.3. However, due to the other effect, Elemental Imbalance, this weapon deals only half damage with air magic, water magic, and earth magic.
This staff is therefore incredibly powerful as long as only fire magic is being used. Even being 0.4 - 0.5 rune damage modifier lower than the staff of light and necromancer's staff, the burning damage will surpass the rune damage. Not to mention, the special action deals an exceptional amount of damage all around the user, instantly burning enemies as well, which covers a staff's weakness when multiple enemies get close. However, using any other form of magic is a significant damage loss, and unfortunately a number of enemies are resistant to fire and burning (like the knights and mages of Dowdun Reach) or completely immune (like the KotHaar). Assuming one can manage the weight and inventory slot, taking this staff for fire magic and another for the others is a viable strategy. Also, although the fire cape doesn't have great synergy (since it requires blocking or taking damage to cause burning and only melee kills on burning targets restore stamina), the zamorak cape on the other hand will cause Afterimage to explode, for those mages with a penchant for explosives.

items.name: Zombie Arm
items.description: A zombie's arm with electrifying properties. High five!
items.extract:
The zombie arm is a power level 4 melee weapon that is awarded to the player after completing The Great Body Robbery, and can then be crafted using a blacksmith's bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores. 
It is not clear what this weapon's special effect is as its "electrifying properties" are ambiguous. When a player receives the Shocked debuff, their stamina is completely drained, but since enemies do not have stamina, and as there are no visible effects or extra damage done, it does not appear to do anything to them. It also does not seem to prevent the player or cause enemies to be struck by lightning.
It has the same damage values and attack style as the Skullsplitter, so that weapon's +15% critical strike chance is better, but the higher base damage and additional slash damage of the zombie axe wins out overall when considering weapons to ascend.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: ATTACKS cause SHOCK BUILD UP on targets

items.name: Zombie Axe
items.description: Made in the style of an ancient axe often found in the hands of zombies, it is capable of dealing both Crush and Slash damage at the same time. There seems to be more to this axe though...
items.extract:
The zombie axe is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The axe and its recipe are received by completing Doric's Quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.
Its special effect is that it deals both crush and slash damage simultaneously. Both damage types are taken into account when considering monsters' weaknesses and resistances. This weapon is effective against enemies that are weak to crush but not resistant to slash (including vault guardians, putrid rats, garou thanes, skeletal marauders, and skeletal necromancers). However, against enemies that are weak to crush but resistant to slash damage (including skeletal hoplites, zogres, black knight guardians, black knight warriors, and the black knight titan), this weapon will deal slightly less damage to them because resistances lower damage (-33%) more than weaknesses increase it (+25%). Note that this damage is additive rather than multiplicative, unlike other damage modifiers (i.e. it will lower damage by a factor of 0.92 rather than 0.8375).
This weapon has a higher base damage than other similar one-handed crush weapons, but that benefit is lost against enemies that are also resistant to slash, making Skullsplitter with its +15% critical strike chance more valuable. This weapon also uses the mace moveset, which hits slower than the sword, scimitar, or whip move set, therefore against enemies that are weak to slash but not resistant to crush (including abyssal demons, lost souls, zombies, Zamorakian acolytes, and mages of zamorak), weapons like the black sword, Imaru's talon, or abyssal whip may be better choices.

stats.label: Special effect
stats.value: Deals increased DAMAGE. Attacks deal both SLASH and CRUSH Damage
